rows.source: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men
rows.output: Livingston 1-0 Rangers: Kwallon Menga ta doke 'yan wasan Gerrard
rows.reference: Livingston 1 da Rangers 0: Cin Menga ya ƙasƙantar da mutanen Gerrard

rows.source: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.
rows.output: An yi wa Rangers wani rashin nasara a ranar da ta gabata, yayin da Dolly Menga ta ci kwallo a raga ta sa Steven Gerrard ya yi rashin nasara a wasan da suka yi da Livingston da ci 1-0.
rows.reference: Rangers ta sami koma baya a lokacin da harin Dolly Menga ya taƙaita gefen Steven Gerrard da ya rabu zuwa ga ci 1 da 0 a Livingston.

rows.source: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.
rows.output: Kungiyoyin Ibrox sun yi niyyar rubuta nasarar farko a waje tun daga nasarar da suka samu a watan Fabrairu 4-1 a St Johnstone, amma Gary Holt's team ya yi rashin nasara a kan Gerrard na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manaja don barinsa a matsayin na takwas a bayan Hearts masu nasara a gasar Ladbrokes Premiership.
rows.reference: Gefen Ibrox suna neman su samar da cinsu na farko ne a kan hanyar tun cin nasara ta 4 da 1 a Fabarairu a St Johnstone, amma ƙungiyar Gary Holt ta janyo doke kawai  Gerrard karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 games a matsayin manaja inda ya bar gefensa da ɗigo-ɗigo takwas a ruguje kan hanyar Ladbrokes shugabannin Hearts na Premiership.

rows.source: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.
rows.output: Menga ya buga mintuna bakwai kafin rabin lokaci ya wuce kuma layin Rangers da ba su da kuzari ba su yi kama da da'awarsu.
rows.reference: Menga sun kai harin ne mintina bakwai kafin rabin lokaci kuma wani bugun gajeren layi na Rangers din a kan jan hankali da bai taɓa kama da yin lebur.

rows.source: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.output: Yayin da Rangers ke saukowa zuwa matsayi na shida, Livingston ya hau na uku kuma kawai bayan Hibernian a bambamcin kwallaye.
rows.reference: Yayin da Rangers yanzu ta sauka ƙasa zuwa ga matsayi na shida, Livingston kuwa ta hau sama ne zuwa ta uku kuma kawai a bayan Hibernian a kan ci na bambanci.

rows.source: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.
rows.output: Kuma akwai yiwuwar ƙarin matsala ga Rangers bayan mai layi Calum Spence ya samu raunuka a kai bayan wani abu da ake zarginsa da jifa daga gefen da ke nesa.
rows.reference: Kuma za a iya samun ƙarin tashin hankali a ajiye ga Rangers bayan da sai da aka yi jinyar mai lura da layi Calum Spence na wani raunin ka bayan da a bayyane aka jefo wani abu daga ƙarshen wurin.

rows.source: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.
rows.output: Gerrard ya yi canje-canje takwas a cikin tawagar da ta yi nasara a kan Ayr zuwa wasan karshe na gasar Betfred.
rows.reference: Gerrard ya yi canje-canje takwas zuwa ga ɓangaren wanda ya jefa Ayr cikin wasannin kafin ƙarshe na Kofin Betfred.

rows.source: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.
rows.output: Holt, a daya bangaren, ya tafi tare da Livi 11 da suka dauko maki daga Hearts a makwanni da suka gabata, kuma ya yi farin ciki da yadda kungiyar da aka horar da su ta yi wa abokansu wahala a kowane lokaci.
rows.reference: Holt, a wani ɓangaren, ya tafi tare da irin Livi 11 ɗin wanda ta cire ɗigo daga Hearts mako da wuce kuma da ya yi murna da irin yadda waɗanda ya horar suka wahalar da masu adawarsu a kowane juyin da aka yi.

rows.source: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.
rows.output: Rangers na iya samun iko da kwallayen amma Livingston ya yi amfani da kwallo da ya samu.
rows.reference: Za a kila ce Rangers sun mamaye kame ƙwallon amma Livingston sun yi abubuwa da yawa da ƙwallon da suka samu.

rows.source: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.
rows.output: Ya kamata su ci mintuna biyu ne kawai lokacin da Menga ya yi watsawa na farko ya aika Scott Pittman ta hanyar Allan McGregor, amma dan wasan tsakiya ya yi kaca-kaca da damarsa.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce sun ci kawai a mintina biyu na farawa lokacin musayar Menga ta farko da ta aika Scott Pittman ta cikin cin Allan McGregor amma mai tsaron tsakiya ya faɗaɗa damarsa babba sosai.

rows.source: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.
rows.output: Wani tsangwamar Keaghan Jacobs ya ci gaba da tashi, sannan ya same shi, Craig Halkett, amma abokin tsaron sa, Alan Lithgow, ya yi yunƙurin buga shi a bayan gida.
rows.reference: Wani dukan da ba tarewa na Keaghan Jacobs sai ya sami gola Craig Halkett amma abokinsa mai tsaro Alan Lithgow ya iya kawai faɗaɗawa ne a bayan matsayar.

rows.source: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.
rows.output: Rangers sun kama iko amma ya yi kama da akwai ƙarin bege fiye da imani game da wasan su a cikin mintin karshe.
rows.reference: Rangers ta dai kama sarrafa amma akwai alamar ƙarin fata maimakon yarda game da wasansu a ukun ƙarshe.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos ya ji cewa ya kamata ya samu bugun daci a minti na 15, lokacin da ya yi karo da Steven Lawless, amma alkalin wasan Steven Thomson ya ki amincewa da rokon Morelos.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos ba shakka ya ji ya kamata a ce ya sami wani bugu daga kai sai gola a makin kashi na uku na rabin sa’a kamar yadda shi da Steven Lawless suka yi karo amma alƙalin wasa Steven Thomson ya manta koke-koke na Colombia.

rows.source: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.
rows.output: Rangers sun yi harbi biyu a farko amma tsohon mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ya yi wa Lassana Coulibaly kwallonsa da kuma harbin Ovie Ejaria.
rows.reference: Rangers ta yi ƙoƙarin kawai buge-buge na rabin farko na biyu a kan abin hari amma tsohon golan Ibrox Liam Kelly bai nuna wata damuwa ba daga bugun kai na Lassana Coulibaly da kuma wani harin sauri na Ovie Ejaria.

rows.source: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.
rows.output: A yayin da Livi ta fara buga kwallo a minti na 34, mai yiwuwa ta kasance a kan hanyar da ta fi dacewa, amma babu wanda zai iya musanta cewa sun cancanci ta saboda kokarinsu kadai.
rows.reference: Yayin da buɗin da Livi ta samu na mintina 34 kila ya zama a kan sake wasa, ba wanda zai iya ƙi sun cancance shi don cinsu da kawai suka samu.

rows.source: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.
rows.output: Koma Rangers sun kasa yin amfani da wani tsangwamar da aka yi da kyau.
rows.reference: Rangers sun sake kasa magance wani hoɓɓasa da Jacobs ya yi.

rows.source: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.
rows.output: Scott Arfield bai yi martani ba yayin da Declan Gallagher ya zare kwallo ga Scott Robinson, wanda ya ci gaba da kasancewa cikin nutsuwa don fitar da Menga don kammala.
rows.reference: Scott Arfield bai yi martani ba inda Declan Gallagher ya sa ƙwallon zuwa ga Scott Robinson, wanda ya yi sanyi ga ɗaukan Menga na ɗan ƙaramin gamawa.

rows.source: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.
rows.output: Gerrard ya yi aiki a lokacin hutun hutun, inda ya musanya Coulibaly da Ryan Kent, kuma canjin ya kawo cikas nan take yayin da dan wasan ya yi wa Morelos. Sai dai Kelly ya yi fice daga layin nasa ya tofa wa dan wasan.
rows.reference: Gerrard ya yi aiki a hutun inda ya sauya Coulibaly da Ryan Kent kuma sauyi ya kusan samar da wani tasirin nan da nan a matsayin mai kai hari ta kusurwa na sakun da ka yi wa Morelos amma mai ban sha’awa Kelly ya yi gudu daga layinsa don ya toshe.

rows.source: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.
rows.output: Amma Livingston ya ci gaba da jan hankalin masu ziyartar su su buga irin wasan da suke jin daɗin yi, tare da Lithgow da Halkett suna tafasa ƙwallon ƙafa bayan ƙwallon.
rows.reference: Amma Livingston ya ci gaba da soka maziyartan zuwa irin ainihin wasan da suke morewa, tare daLithgow da Halkett suna samun doguwar ƙwallo a sama a bayan doguwar ƙwallo.

rows.source: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.
rows.output: Kasashin Holt za su iya kara faɗakarwa a ƙarshen wasan amma McGregor ya yi nasarar hana Jacobs. Daga nan kuma, Lithgow ya yi tsalle daga kusurwar.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Holt da sun faɗaɗa matsayinsu na gaba a cikin matakan ƙarshe amma McGregor ya tsaya sosai ya hana Jacobs kafin Lithgow ya yi bugun ka daga kwanar.

rows.source: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.
rows.output: Wasan Rangers na maye gurbin Glenn Middleton ya yi wani koke na dawowar a minti na karshe yayin da ya yi kaca-kaca da Jacobs amma Thomson ya sake gujewa.
rows.reference: Mai maye gurbi na Rangers twato Glenn Middleton ya sami wani neman ƙarshe na wani fenalti a inda ya yi ta ƙoƙarin tare da Jacobs amma Thomson ya kau da kai.

rows.source: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter
rows.output: Almanac: Mai ƙirƙira na Geiger Counter
rows.reference: Almanac: Wanda ya ƙago Geiger Counter

rows.source: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.
rows.output: Kuma yanzu shafi daga littafin "Sunday Morning" Almanac: 30 ga Satumba, 1882, shekaru 136 da suka wuce a yau, kuma COUNTING ... ranar haihuwa ta masanin kimiyyar lissafi Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger a Jamus.
rows.reference: Kuma yanzu wani shafi ne daga "Sunday Morning" Almanac ɗinmu: 30 ga Satumba, 1882, shekaru 136 a yau, ana kuma CI GABA DA KIRGE ... ranar da aka haifi masanin ilmin yanayin duniya da zai so gaba Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger a cikin Jamus.

rows.source: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.
rows.output: Geiger ya haɓaka hanyar gano da auna radiyo, wanda ya haifar da na'urar da aka sani da Geiger Counter.
rows.reference: Geiger ya gina wata hanya don gane da auna yanayin aikin tururin, wani abin ƙiƙira daga ya kai ga na’urar da aka sani a matsayin Geiger Counter.

rows.source: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:
rows.output: Wani muhimmin abu na kimiyya tun daga lokacin, na'urar Geiger ta zama wani muhimmin abu a al'adar jama'a ma, kamar yadda aka nuna a cikin fim ɗin 1950 "Bells of Coronado," wanda ya nuna wadanda suka yi kama da 'yan kasuwa masu ilimin kimiyya Roy Rogers da Dale Evans:
rows.reference: Wata madogarar kimiyya ne tun wancan lokacin, Geiger Counter ta zama wata madogara a al’adar ta lokaci da ake marmari, inda a fim din 1950 "Bells of Coronado," da waɗanda ba a gani masana ne na kimiyya Roy Rogers da Dale Evans suka fito a taurari:

rows.source: Man: "What in the world is that?"
rows.output: Mutum: "Mene ne a duniya?"
rows.reference: Mutum: "Mene ne a cikin duniyar nan shi ɗin?"

rows.source: Rogers: "It's a Geiger Counter, used to locate radioactive minerals, such as uranium.
rows.output: Rogers: "Wannnan na'urar auna radiyo ce, ana amfani da ita wajen gano ma'adanai masu radiyo, kamar uranium.
rows.reference: Rogers: "Shi ne Geiger Counter, da ake amfani wajen gano albarkatun ƙasa, irin su sinadaran uranium.

rows.source: When you put these earphones on, you can actually hear the effects of the atoms given off by the radioactivity in the minerals."
rows.output: Lokacin da ka sanya waɗannan na'urar sauraro, za ka iya jin tasirin atamun da ake fitarwa daga radioactivity a cikin ma'adanai.
rows.reference: A yayin da ka sa waɗannan na’urorin kunne, za ka iya ainihin jin halayen aiwatar na sinadaran atom da aikin tururin ke samarwa a cikin albarkatun.”

rows.source: Evans: "Say, it sure is popping now!"
rows.output: Evans: "To, da alamu ya yi ta busawa yanzu!"
rows.reference: Evans: "Ka ce, da tabbaci yana fitowa yanzu!"

rows.source: "Hans" Geiger died in 1945, just a few days short of his 63rd birthday.
rows.output: "Hans" Geiger ya mutu a shekara ta 1945, kusan kwanaki kaɗan kafin ya cika shekaru 63.
rows.reference: "Hans" Geiger ya rasu a cikin shekara ta 1945, kawai ‘yan kwanaki dab da cika shekaru 63 da kewayowar ranar haihuwarsa.

rows.source: But the invention that bears his name lives on.
rows.output: Amma ƙirƙirar da ke da sunansa tana ci gaba.
rows.reference: Amma abin da ya ƙago da ke amfani da sunansa yanan nan a raye.

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells
rows.output: Sabon rigakafin cutar daji na iya koya wa tsarin rigakafi ya ga "kwayoyin da suka yi ɓarna"
rows.reference: Sabuwar allurar sankara za ta iya koyar da tsarin kariyar jiki zuwa ‘ganin’ sel-sel masu matsala

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells and kill them
rows.output: Sabon rigakafin cutar daji na iya koya wa tsarin rigakafi ya ga ƙwayoyin da suka yi kutsawa su kuma kashe su.
rows.reference: Sabuwar allurar sankara za ta iya koyar da tsarin kariyar jiki zuwa ‘ganin’ sel-sel masu matsala da kuma kashe su

rows.source: Vaccine teaches immune system to recognise rogue cells as part of treatment
rows.output: Magungunan rigakafin cutar suna koyar da tsarin rigakafin jiki ya gane ƙwayoyin da ba su dace ba a matsayin wani ɓangare na magani.
rows.reference: Allurar takan koyar da tsarin kariya jiki don ganewa sel-sel masu matsala a matsayin ɓangare na kula

rows.source: Method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in lab
rows.output: Hanyar ta haɗa da fitar da ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki daga majiyyaci, da canza su a cikin dakin gwaje-gwaje
rows.reference: Hanyoyin sun haɗa da cirowa sel-sel na kariyar jikin daga wani marar lafiya, jirkita su a cikin ɗakin gwajin kimiyya

rows.source: They can then 'see' a protein common to many cancers and then reinjected
rows.output: Sannan za su iya 'gani' wani furotin da ya yi kama da yawancin ciwon daji sannan kuma an sake shigar da shi
rows.reference: Za su iya sa’an nan ‘ganin’ wani sinadarin abinci mai gina jiki da yawancin sankarori suka sani kuma sa’an nan su sake shigarwa

rows.source: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.
rows.output: Wani gwajin rigakafin ya nuna sakamako mai kyau a cikin marasa lafiya da ke da nau'ikan cututtuka daban-daban.
rows.reference: Wata allurar gwaji tana nuna sakamako mai kyau a jikin marassa lafiya da ke wani ranji na sankarorin.

rows.source: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.
rows.output: Mace ɗaya da aka yi mata magani da rigakafin, wanda ke koyar da tsarin rigakafi ya gane ƙwayoyin da suka yi kuskure, ta ga cutar ovarian ta bace na tsawon watanni 18 da rabi.
rows.reference: Mata ɗaya da aka yi wa jinya da allurar, da ke koyar da tsarin kariyar jikin don gano sel-sel masu matsalar, ta ga sankararta ta mahaifa ta bace na fiye da watanni 18.

rows.source: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.
rows.output: Hanyar ta haɗa da fitar da ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki daga maras lafiya, canza su a cikin dakin gwaje-gwaje don su iya "gani" wani furotin da aka saba samu a yawancin ciwace-ciwace mai suna HER2, sannan a sake shigar da ƙwayoyin.
rows.reference: Hanyar ta hada ne da cirowa sel-sel na kariyar jiki daga wani marar lafiya, inda ake gyara su a cikin dakin gwajin kimiyya yadda za su iya “ganin” wani sinadarin protein mai gina jiki da sankarori masu yawa suka sani da ake kira HER2, inda kuma ake sake shigar da su sel-sel din.

rows.source: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."
rows.output: Farfesan Jay Berzofsky, na Cibiyar Kariya da Cutar Kanjamau ta Amurka a Bethesda, Maryland, ya ce: "Sakamakonmu ya nuna mana cewa muna da rigakafin da ke da alkawari."
rows.reference: Farfesa Jay Berzofsky, na Cibiyar Sankara ta Amurka da ke Bethesda, Maryland, ya ce: “Sakamakonmu yana nuna cewa da wata allura da za ta amfanar."

rows.source: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.
rows.output: HER2 "yana tuka ci gaban nau'ikan ciwon daji da dama," ciki har da ciwon nono, ovarian, huhu da kuma ciwon colorectal, in ji Farfesan Berzofsky.
rows.reference: Farfesa Berzofsky ya yi cewa HERS takan "janyo girman sankarori iri-iri da yawa," da suka haɗa da nono, mahaifa, huhu da ƙaba.

rows.source: A similar approach of taking immune cells out of patients and "teaching" them how to target cancer cells has worked in treating a type of leukaemia.
rows.output: Hanyar da ta yi kama da wannan ta haɗa da cire ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki daga marasa lafiya da "koyawa" su yadda za su yi wa ƙwayoyin cutar kansa.
rows.reference: An yi amfani da irin hanyar ta ɗaukan sel-sel da jikin marassa lafiya da "koyar" da su yadda za su kai hari ga sel-sel na sankara kuma ya yi aiki a wajen jinyar irin cutar fara.

rows.source: Kanye West Embarked on a Pro-Trump Diatribe, Wearing a MAGA Hat, After his SNL Appearance.
rows.output: Kanye West ya fara tafiyarsa ta pro-Trump, yana sanye da hular MAGA, bayan bayyana a SNL.
rows.reference: Kanye West Ya Fara Zagin Masu Ƙin Trump, Sanye da wata Hular MAGA, Bayan Bayyanarsa ta SNL.

rows.source: It Didn't Go Well
rows.output: Ba Tafi Da Kyau Ba
rows.reference: Bai Yi Daida Ba

rows.source: Kanye West was booed in the studio during a Saturday Night Live after a rambling performance in which he praised U.S. President Donald Trump and said he would run for office in 2020.
rows.output: An yi wa Kanye West tsawa a cikin dakin rikodi a lokacin wasan kwaikwayo na daren Asabar bayan wani wasan kwaikwayo da ya yi ya yabawa shugaban Amurka Donald Trump kuma ya ce zai tsayar da shi a zaben 2020.
rows.reference: An yi ihu ga Kanye West a cikin ɗakin watsa shirye-shirye a lokacin Saturday Night Live bayan wani surutu inda ya yabi Shugaban Amurka. Donald Trump kuma ya ce zai neme tsayawa a cikin 2020.

rows.source: After performing his third song of the night, called Ghost Town in which he was wearing a Make America Great cap, he went on a rant against the Democrats and reiterated his support for Trump.
rows.output: Bayan da ya yi waƙarsa ta uku a daren, mai suna Ghost Town, inda ya sanya kabad ɗin Make America Great, ya yi wa Democrats tsawa kuma ya sake tabbatar da goyon bayansa ga Trump.
rows.reference: Bayan yin waƙarsa ta uku da daren, da ake kira Ghost Town inda yake sanye da wata hular Make America Great, ya wuce yana wani surutu a kan 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat da kuma jaddada goyon bayansa ga Trump.

rows.source: "So many times I talk to a white person and they say: "How could you like Trump, he's racist?"
rows.output: "Da yawa na yi magana da farare kuma suna cewa: "Yaya za ka so Trump, shi ne mai nuna wariya?"
rows.reference: "A lokuta da dama na yi magana da wani farin mutum kuma sun ce: "Yaya za a yi kake son Trump, yana da aƙidar bambancin jinsi?"

rows.source: Well, if I was concerned about racism I would've moved out of America a long time ago," he said.
rows.output: To, idan ina damuwa da wariya, da na koma Amurka da dadewa," ya ce.
rows.reference: To, idan da na damu game da bambancin jinsi da na fice daga Amurka tun tuni," inji shi.

rows.source: SNL started the show with a skit starring Matt Damon in which the Hollywood star made fun of Brett Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judicial Committee on sexual assault claims made by Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: SNL ya fara wasan kwaikwayo da wani skit da ya nuna Matt Damon, inda tauraron Hollywood ya yi dariya kan shaidar Brett Kavanaugh a gaban kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattijai kan zargin cin zarafi da Christine Blasey Ford ta yi.
rows.reference: SNL ya fara nuna shirin da wani barkwancin fitowar Matt Damon inda tauraron na Hollywood ya ba da ban dariya a kan shaidar Brett Kavanaugh a gaban Kwamitin Majalisar Dattawa a kan Shari'a game da koke-koken cin zarafin jima'i da Christine Blasey Ford ta yi.

rows.source: Although it was not broadcast, the footage of West's rant was uploaded to social media by comedian Chris Rock.
rows.output: Duk da cewa ba a watsa shi ba, an saka fidda bidiyo na West's rant a shafukan sada zumunta ta hanyar mai barkwanci Chris Rock.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba a watsa ba, amma Chris Rock ne ya ɗora ƙaramin bidiyon surutun na West a kafar sada zumunta.

rows.source: It is unclear if Rock was trying to mock West with the posting.
rows.output: Ba a bayyana ba ko Rock yana kokarin yin dariya da West da wallafa.
rows.reference: Ba a sani ba ko Rock ya yi ƙoƙari ne ya muzanta West da abin da ya fitar.

rows.source: Also, West had complained to the audience that he had got a hard time backstage about his head wear.
rows.output: Haka kuma, West ya yi korafi ga masu sauraro cewa ya samu matsala a bayan fage game da kayan sawar kansa.
rows.reference: Haka kuma, West ya koka a masu sauraron cewa ya sha wahala a bayan fage game da abin da ke kan nasa.

rows.source: "They bullied me backstage.
rows.output: "Suka yi min tsawa a bayan fage."
rows.reference: "Sun zalunce ni a bayan fage.

rows.source: They said, 'don't go out there with that hat on.'
rows.output: Sun ce, 'kar ka fita can da wannan hular a kai.'
rows.reference: Sun ce, 'kar ka fita zuwa can sanye da hular.'

rows.source: They bullied me!
rows.output: Sun yi min tsawa!
rows.reference: Sun zalunce ni!

rows.source: And then they say I'm in a sunken place," he said, according to the Washington Examiner.
rows.output: Sannan sun ce ina wani wuri mai zurfi," in ji shi, a cewar Washington Examiner.
rows.reference: Kuma sun ce ni wani dan kore ne," inji shi kamar yadda  Washington Examiner ta kawo.

rows.source: West went on: "You wanna see the sunken place?" saying that he would "put my superman cape on, because this means you can't tell me what to do. You want the world to move forward?
rows.output: Yamma ya ci gaba da cewa: "Kina son wurin da aka nutse?" yana cewa zai "sanya rigar superman, domin wannan yana nufin ba za ku iya gaya min abin da zan yi ba. Kina son duniya ta ci gaba?
rows.reference: West ya ci gaba: Kuna so ku ga wurin aikin kore ne? yana cewa "zan sa hulata ta babban mutum, saboda yana nufin ba za ka faɗa mun abin da zan yi ba. Kuna son duniya ta ci gaba?

rows.source: Try love."
rows.output: "Ka gwada soyayya."
rows.reference: Gwada soyayya."

rows.source: His comments drew boos at least twice from the audience and SNL cast members appeared to be embarrassed, Variety reported, with one person there telling the publication: "The entire studio fell dead silent."
rows.output: An yi masa tsawa a kalla sau biyu daga masu sauraro, kuma 'yan wasan SNL sun bayyana cewa sun ji kunya, a cewar Variety, inda wani mutum da ke wurin ya ce wa mujallar: "Dakin studio ya yi shuru gaba ɗaya."
rows.reference: Sharhohin nasa sun janyo ihu aƙalla sau biyu da masu sauraro kuma mambobin da suka fito a SNL sun nuna kunyata, a cewar rahoton Variety, tare da mutum ɗaya a can yana fada wa abin da aka wallafar: Gaba daya sutudiyon ya ti tsit."

rows.source: West had been brought in as a late replacement for singer Ariana Grande, whose former boyfriend, the rapper Mac Miller had died a few days ago.
rows.output: An kawo West a matsayin maye gurbin da aka yi wa mawaƙin Ariana Grande, wanda tsohon saurayinta, mawallafin rap Mac Miller ya rasu kwanan nan.
rows.reference: An kawo West ne ciki a matsayin maye gurbin daga ƙarshe na mawaki Ariana Grande, wanda tsohon saurayinta, rapper Mac Miller ya mutu wasu 'yan kwanaki da suka wuce.

rows.source: West puzzled many with a performance of the song I Love it, dressed as a Perrier Bottle.
rows.output: Yamma ya bani mamakin wani wasan waƙar da na so, sanye da kwalbar Perrier.
rows.reference: West ya ba da mamaki ga mutane da yawa da yin wata waka Ilove it, da ya sa tufa kamar wata Kwalbar Perrier.

rows.source: West got backing from head of conservative group TPUSA, Candace Turner who tweeted: "To one of the most courageous spirits: THANK YOU FOR STANDING UP TO THE MOB."
rows.output: Yamma ta samu goyon baya daga shugaban kungiyar masu ra'ayin mazan jiya ta TPUSA, Candace Turner, wanda ya wallafa a shafinta na Twitter: "Ga daya daga cikin ruhohin da suka fi karfinsu: NA GODIYA DA KAKE TSAYAWA GA TURMUTULI."
rows.reference: West ya sami goyon baya daga shugaban gungun masu ra'ayin riƙau na TRUSA, Candace Turner wanda a Twitter ta ce: Zuwa ga daya daga cikin masu karfin hali: MUNA GODIYA DA KA TSAYA BA RUWANKA DA 'YAN HAYANIYA."

rows.source: But talk show host Karen Hunter tweeted that West was simply "being who he is and that's absolutely wonderful."
rows.output: Amma mai gabatar da shirin tuntuba Karen Hunter ya ce West kawai "yake zama wanda yake da shi kuma hakan yana da kyau sosai."
rows.reference: Amma mai karɓar baƙi a shirin Karen Hunter ya faɗa a Twitter cewa kawai West "yana nuna yadda yake ne kuma wannan abu ne ban sha'awa sosai."

rows.source: "But I chose NOT to reward someone (by purchasing his music or clothing or supporting his "art") who I believe is embracing and spewing ideology that is harmful to my community.
rows.output: "Amma na zabi ba zan ba da lada ga wani (ta hanyar sayen kiɗa ko tufafinsa ko tallata "fina-finan sa") wanda na yi imani da shi yana rungumar da kuma yada ra'ayoyi da ke cutarwa ga al'ummata.
rows.reference: "Amma na zaɓi kar na ba da kyauta ga wani (ta sayan waƙarsa ko kaya ko nuna goyon baya ga "hikimarsa") wanda na yi imani yana watsa da tallata aƙida ne da ke cutarwa ga al'ummata.

rows.source: He is free.
rows.output: Yana da 'yanci.
rows.reference: Yana da 'yanci.

rows.source: So are we," she added.
rows.output: Don haka mu ma muna cikin haka," ta kara.
rows.reference: Ta kara da cewa, "Haka muma".

rows.source: Before the show, the rapper announced on Twitter that he had changed his name, saying that he was now "the being formally known as Kanye West."
rows.output: Kafin wasan, mawallafin ya sanar a shafinsa na Twitter cewa ya canza sunansa, yana mai cewa yanzu shi ne "wanda aka sani da sunan Kanye West."
rows.reference: Kafin shirin, rapper ɗin ya sanar ta Twitter cewa ya canza sunansa, yana mai cewa yanzu shi "wani ne da a da aka san ni a matsayin Kanye West."

rows.source: He is not the first artist to change their name and follows in the footsteps of Diddy, also known as Puff Daddy, Puffy and P Diddy.
rows.output: Ba shine mai fasaha na farko da ya canza sunansa ba, kuma yana bin tafarkinsa na Diddy, wanda kuma aka sani da Puff Daddy, Puffy da P Diddy.
rows.reference: Ba shi ne mawaƙi na farko da ya canza sunansa ba kuma ya bi sahun su Diddy, wanda aka san shi da Puff Daddy, Puffy da P Diddy.

rows.source: Fellow rapper, Snoop Dogg has had the name Snoop Lion and of course the late music legend Prince, changed his name to a symbol and then the artist previously known as Prince.
rows.output: Abokin raps, Snoop Dogg ya samu sunan Snoop Lion kuma, ba shakka, shahararren mawallafin waƙa, Prince, ya canza sunansa zuwa alama sannan kuma mai fasahar da aka sani da Prince.
rows.reference: Ɗan uwansa rapper Snoop Dogg a da yana da sunan Snoop Lion sai kuma sanannen mawaƙi Prince, da canza sunansa zuwa wata alama da kuma mawaƙin da aka san shi a da a matsayin Prince.

rows.source: Attempted murder charge over Belfast restaurant stabbing
rows.output: An tuhumar da laifi na yin yunƙurin kisan kai a kan harbin da aka yi a wani gidan cin abinci na Belfast
rows.reference: An yi caji saboda ƙoƙarin kisa da wuƙa a wurin sayar da abinci a Belfast

rows.source: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in a restaurant in east Belfast on Friday.
rows.output: Wani mutum mai shekaru 45 ya fuskanci tuhumar yunƙurin kisan kai bayan an harbe wani mutum a wani gidan cin abinci a gabashin Belfast a ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: An caji wani mutum mai shekaru 45 da ƙoƙarin kisa bayan an caka wa wani mutum wuka a cikin wurin sayar da abinci a Belfast ta gabas a ranar Juma'a.

rows.source: The incident happened in Ballyhackamore, police said.
rows.output: Lamarin ya faru a Ballyhackamore, a cewar 'yan sanda.
rows.reference: Abin ya faru ne a Ballyhackamore, inji 'yan sanda.

rows.source: The defendant is expected to appear before Belfast Magistrates' Court on Monday.
rows.output: An sa ran mai kare zai bayyana a gaban kotun Magistrati ta Belfast a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin wanda ake tuhuman zai bayyana a gaban Kotun Majistare ta Belfast a ranar Litinin.

rows.source: The charges will be reviewed by the Public Prosecution Service.
rows.output: Za a duba laifukan da Sabis ɗin Shari’a na Jama’a ya yi.
rows.reference: Ofishin Tuhumar na Gwamnati zai sake sabunta caje-cajen.

rows.source: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington hits out at toxic masculinity
rows.output: Tauraron wasan Game of Thrones Kit Harington ya yi tsokana kan rashin mutuntawa na maza
rows.reference: Tauraron Game of Thrones wato Kit Harington ya soki aƙidar nuna samartaka

rows.source: Kit Harington is known for his sword-swinging role as Jon Snow in HBO's violent medieval fantasy series Game of Thrones.
rows.output: Kit Harington ya shahara da rawar da ya taka a matsayin Jon Snow a cikin jerin talabijin na fantasy na HBO mai taken Game of Thrones.
rows.reference: An san Kit Harington da nuna rawar da ya taka ta juya takobi a matsayin Jon Snow a cikin jere-jeren shirin HBO na tashin hankali da aka yi a zamanin da a cikin din Game of Thrones.

rows.source: But the actor, 31, has hit out at the stereotype of the macho hero, saying such roles on screen mean young boys often feel like they have to be tough to be respected.
rows.output: Amma dan wasan kwaikwayo, mai shekaru 31, ya soki ra'ayin jarumin maza, yana mai cewa irin wadannan rawar a kan allo yana nufin yara maza kan ji cewa dole ne su zama masu karfi don a girmama su.
rows.reference: Amma mai shirin fim ɗin, da ke shekaru 31, ya soki son gwarzo namiji, yana cewa ire-iren kwaikwayon suna nufin yara ƙanana yawanci sukan ji kamar sai su zama gagara-badau kafin a mutunta su.

rows.source: Speaking to The Sunday Times Culture, Kit said he believes 'something's gone wrong' and questioned how to tackle the problem of toxic masculinity in the #MeToo era.
rows.output: Yana magana da The Sunday Times Culture, Kit ya ce yana ganin "wani abu ya tafi ba daidai ba" kuma ya tambayi yadda za a magance matsalar "maza masu guba" a zamanin #MeToo.
rows.reference: Da yake magana da The Sunday Times Culture, Kit ya ce ya yi imani 'wani kuskure ya faru' kuma ya yi tambaya yadda za a magance matsalar mummunan aƙidar nuna ƙaton namiji a cikin lokacin #MeToo.

rows.source: Kit, who recently married his Game of Thrones co-star Rose Leslie, also 31, admitted he feels 'quite strongly' about addressing the issue.
rows.output: Kit, wanda ya auri 'yar wasan kwaikwayo ta Game of Thrones Rose Leslie, mai shekaru 31, ya yarda cewa yana jin "mafi ƙarfi" game da batun.
rows.reference: Kit, wanda bai jima da auren tauraruwar da suka yi fim ɗin Game of Thrones wator Rose Leslie, ita ma mai shekaru 31, ya tabbatar yana jin 'ƙarfi sosai' game da magance batun.

rows.source: 'I feel personally, quite strongly, at the moment - where have we gone wrong with masculinity?,' he said.
rows.output: Ina jin kaina, a halin yanzu, ina jin kamar mun yi kuskure sosai da namijin halayyarka.
rows.reference: Ina ji a jikina, ƙarfi sosai, a wannan lokacin - a ina muka yi kuskure ne da aƙidar ƙaton namiji?,' inji shi.

rows.source: 'What have we been teaching men when they're growing up, in terms of the problem we see now?'
rows.output: 'Mene ne muka koyar wa maza yayin da suke girma, dangane da matsalar da muke gani yanzu?'
rows.reference: Mene ne muke ta karantar da maza a lokacin da suke girma, idan an yi la’akari da matsalar da muke gani yanzu?'

rows.source: Kit believes television may be partly responsible for the rise in toxic masculinity thanks to its very masculine characters.
rows.output: Kit na ganin talabijin na iya zama wani ɓangare na dalilin da ya sa mace-macen maza suka yi yawa saboda halayen maza masu ƙarfi da ke cikin talabijin.
rows.reference: Kit ya yi imani talabijin kila zai zama yana dan haƙƙi na ci gaban wannan aƙida ta katon namiji saboda 'yan wasa maza masu katon jiki da ake fitarwa.

rows.source: He continued: 'What's innate and what's taught?
rows.output: Ya ci gaba da cewa: 'Me ake da shi tun haihuwa kuma me ake koya?
rows.reference: Ya ci gaba: Mene ne abin da ke jikin mutum da abin da aka koyar?

rows.source: What is taught on TV, and in the streets, that makes young boys feel they have to be this certain side of being a man?
rows.output: Me ake koyar da shi a talabijin, da kan titi, wanda ke sa yara maza su ji cewa dole ne su kasance a wannan gefen zama namiji?
rows.reference: Abin da ake koyar wa a talabijin, da na kan titina, da ke sa ƙananan yara su ji sai dole sun zama kamar gefen wani mutum?

rows.source: I think that's really one of the big questions in our time - how do we change that?
rows.output: Ina ganin wannan na daya daga cikin manyan tambayoyi a zamaninmu - ta yaya za mu canza hakan?
rows.reference: Ina jin wannan ɗaya daga cikin manyan tambayoyi ne na cikin lokacinmu - yaya za mu canja wannan?

rows.source: Because clearly something has gone wrong for young men.'
rows.output: Domin a fili wani abu ya ɓace ga matasa.
rows.reference: Saboda a fili yake wani abu ya lalace ga samari maza.'

rows.source: In the interview he also admitted that he wouldn't be doing any Game of Thrones prequels or sequels when the series comes to an end next summer, saying he is 'done with battlefields and horses'.
rows.output: A cikin hirar ya kuma amince cewa ba zai yi kwalliyar wasan kwaikwayo ko kuma na biyu ba lokacin da jerin ya ƙare a lokacin rani mai zuwa, yana cewa ya gama da fagen fama da dawakai.
rows.reference: A cikin wata intabiyu da ya yi ya kuma tabbatar cewa ba zai ƙara yin fim ɗin na Game of Thrones ba a lokacin da jere-jeren fim da ya zo ƙarshe a cikin damunar gaba, yana cewa ya 'gama da filayen yaƙe-yaƙe da dawakai'.

rows.source: From November Kit will star in a revival of Sam Shepard's True West which is the story of a film producer and his brother, who is a robber.
rows.output: Daga watan Nuwamba Kit zai taka rawa a cikin sake fasalin wasan kwaikwayo na Sam Shepard's True West wanda labarin wani mai shirya fina-finai ne da kuma dan uwansa wanda dan fashin teku ne.
rows.reference: Daga Nuwamba Kit zau fito a cikin wani sake dawowa da True West na Sam Shepard wanda wani labari ne na wani furodusan fim da ɗan uwansa, da yake wani ɓarawo mai sata da makami.

rows.source: The actor recently revealed that he considers meeting his wife Rose to be the best thing to come out of Game of Thrones.
rows.output: Dan wasan ya bayyana kwanan nan cewa yana ganin haduwarsa da matarsa Rose ita ce mafi kyau da ta fito daga Game of Thrones.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan fim ɗin kwana nan ya bayyana cewa yana ɗaukan haɗuwa da matarsa Rose shi ne abu mafi kyau da ya fito daga fim ɗin Game of Thrones.

rows.source: 'I met my wife in this show, so in that way it gave me my future family, and my life from here on in,' he said.
rows.output: Na sadu da matar aure ta a wannan nunin, don haka ta hanyar haka ta ba ni iyali na gaba, kuma rayuwata daga nan.
rows.reference: Na haɗu da matata a cikin wannan shirin, don haka ta wannan hanyar ya ba ni iyalina na nan gaba, kuma rayuwa za ta fara daga nan ne,' inji shi.

rows.source: Rose played Ygritte, the love interest of Kit's character Jon Snow, in the Emmy award-winning fantasy series.
rows.output: Rose ta buga Ygritte, sha'awar Kit's character Jon Snow, a cikin jerin fantasy da suka lashe lambar yabo ta Emmy.
rows.reference: Rose ta fito a Ygritte, sha'awar soyayya ta kwaikwayo na Kit a Jon Snow, a cikin wannan fim da ya sami kyauta ta Emmy.

rows.source: The couple married in June 2018 on the grounds of Leslie's family estate in Scotland.
rows.output: Ma'auratan sun yi aure a watan Yuni 2018 a filin gidan iyali na Leslie a Scotland.
rows.reference: Ma'auratan sun yi aure ne a cikin Yuni na 2018 a cikin farfajiyar gidajen su iyalin Leslie da ke cikin Scotland.

rows.source: HIV/Aids: China reports 14% surge in new cases
rows.output: HIV/Aids: An ba da rahoton karuwar kashi 14% a cikin sababbin shari'o'i
rows.reference: CUTAR ƘANJAMAU/Karya garkuwar jiki: China ta ba da rahoton ƙaruwar kashi 14 cikin ɗari na sababbin kamuwa da cutar

rows.source: China has announced a 14% jump in the number of its citizens who are living with HIV and Aids.
rows.output: Sinawa ta sanar da cewa yawan mutanen da ke zaune a kasar da ke fama da cutar kanjamau da cutar AIDS ya tashi da kashi 14%.
rows.reference: China ta sanar da tsallen kashi 14 cikin ɗari na yawan 'yan ƙasarta da ke rayuwa da ƙanjamu da cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki.

rows.source: More than 820,000 people are affected in the country, health officials say.
rows.output: Fiye da mutane 820,000 sun shafa a kasar, jami'an lafiya sun ce.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane 820,000 ne cutar ta shafa a cikin ƙasar, inji jami'an lafiya.

rows.source: About 40,000 new cases were reported in the second quarter of 2018 alone.
rows.output: Kusan 40,000 sababbin shari'o'i an ruwaito a cikin kwata na biyu na 2018.
rows.reference: An ba da rahoton kusan sababbin kamuwar da cutar 40,000 a cikin kwata ta biyu ta 2018 kawai.

rows.source: The vast majority of new cases were transmitted through sex, marking a change from the past.
rows.output: Mafi yawan sababbin shari'o'in an yi su ne ta hanyar jima'i, wanda ke nuna canji daga baya.
rows.reference: Mafiya yawan sababbin kamuwa da cutar an yaɗa su ne ta hanyar jima'i, abin da ya canja daga da.

rows.source: Traditionally, HIV spread rapidly through some parts of China as a result of infected blood transfusions.
rows.output: A tarihi, cutar kanjamau ta yawaitar da sauri a wasu sassan kasar Sin saboda jinyoyin da suka kamu da cutar.
rows.reference: A gargajiyance, cutar ƙanjamau tana yaɗuwa da sauri a wasu ɓangarori na China a sakamakon shigar da jini da ke da cutar.

rows.source: But the number of people contracting HIV in this way had been reduced to almost zero, Chinese health officials said at a conference in Yunnan province.
rows.output: Amma yawan mutanen da ke kamuwa da cutar kanjamau ta hanyar wannan hanyar ya ragu zuwa kusan sifili, in ji jami'an lafiya na kasar Sin a wani taron a lardunan Yunnan.
rows.reference: Amma yawan mutanen da suka kamu da cutar ƙanjamau ta cikin wannan hanyar ya ragu da kusan sifili, inji jami'an lafiya na a wani tarao a yankin Yunnan.

rows.source: Year-on-year, however, the number of those living with HIV and Aids in China has risen by 100,000 people.
rows.output: A duk shekara, duk da haka, adadin mutanen da ke rayuwa tare da HIV da AIDS a kasar Sin ya karu da mutane 100,000.
rows.reference: Shekara bayan shekara, amma, yawan waɗanda ke rayuwa da ƙanjamau da cutar karya garkuwar jiki a cikin China ya ƙaru da mutane 100,000.

rows.source: HIV transmission through sex is an acute issue in China's LGBT community.
rows.output: Yawaitar cutar HIV ta jima'i wani abu ne mai tsanani a cikin al'ummar LGBT ta kasar Sin.
rows.reference: Yaɗuwar ƙanjamau ta hanyar jima'i wani babban batu ne a cikin al'ummar 'yan luwaɗi da maɗigo na China.

rows.source: Homosexuality was decriminalised in China in 1997, but discrimination against LGBT people is said to be rife.
rows.output: An soke haramcin jima'i a kasar Sin a shekarar 1997, amma ana cewa ana ci gaba da nuna wariya ga mutanen LGBT.
rows.reference: An cire hanin da aka yi a luwaɗi a China ne a cikin 1997, amma an ce bambanci a kan mutane 'yan luwaɗi da maɗigo ya yi ƙamari.

rows.source: Because of the country's conservative values, studies have estimated that 70-90% of men who have sex with men will eventually marry women.
rows.output: Saboda ka'idojin al'umma, an kiyasta cewa kashi 70-90% na maza da suke yin jima'i da maza za su yi aure da mata a ƙarshe.
rows.reference: Saboda al'adun ƙasar na ra'ayin rikau, nazarce-nazarce sun yi kintace cewa kashi 70 zuwa 90 cikin ɗari na maza da suka yi jima'i da maza za su auri mata daga ƙarshe.

rows.source: Many of the transmissions of the diseases come from inadequate sexual protections in these relationships.
rows.output: Yawancin watsawa na cututtuka sun fito ne daga rashin isassun kariya ta jima'i a cikin waɗannan dangantakar.
rows.reference: Mafi yawan yaɗe-yaɗen cutar yana zuwa ne daga rashin isasshun kare-kare na jima'i a waɗannan hulɗoɗi.

rows.source: Since 2003, China's government has promised universal access to HIV medication as part of an effort to tackle the issue.
rows.output: Tun daga shekarar 2003, gwamnatin kasar Sin ta yi alkawari na samun damar samun magani ga cutar kanjamau a matsayin wani bangare na kokarin da take yi na magance matsalar.
rows.reference: Tun 2003, gwamnatin China ta yi alkawari samun iso na ƙasa-da-ƙasa zuwa ga maganin ƙanjamau a matsayin ɓangare na wani ƙoƙari na daƙile batun.

rows.source: Maxine Waters denies staffer leaked GOP senators' data, blasts 'dangerous lies' and 'conspiracy theories'
rows.output: Maxine Waters ta musanta cewa ma’aikatanta sun yi wa ‘yan Republican na majalisar dattijai zagon kawuna, ta yi tsokana kan ‘mugunyar karya’ da ‘maganar kishi’.
rows.reference: Maxine Waters ya ƙi yarda da yoyon bayanin da ake cewa ma'aikacinta ya fitar da bayanan sanatocin GOP, inda a fusace ya kira 'munanan ƙarerayi' da 'batutuwan munafurci'

rows.source: U.S. Rep. Maxine Waters on Saturday denounced allegations that a member of her staff had posted the personal information of three Republican U.S. senators onto the lawmakers' Wikipedia pages.
rows.output: Mataimakiyar majalisar dokokin Amurka Maxine Waters ta yi Allah wadai da zargin cewa wani dan ma'aikata na ta ya wallafa bayanan sirrin 'yan majalisar doki uku na jam'iyyar Republican a shafukan Wikipedia na masu shari'a.
rows.reference: Amurka Ɗan Majalisar Wakilai Maxine Waters a ranar Asabar ya yi watsi da ƙage-ƙagen cewa wani mamban ma'aikatanta ya fitar da bayanin keɓe na sanatocin Amurka 'yan Republican guda uku a kan shafukan 'yan majalisar a cikin Wikipedia.

rows.source: The Los Angeles Democrat asserted that the claims were being pedaled by "ultra-right wing" pundits and websites.
rows.output: Dan Los Angeles mai jam'iyyar Democrat ya yi iƙirarin cewa da'awar ana sayar da su ta "matsakaicin masu ra'ayin hagu" masu sharhi da shafukan yanar gizo.
rows.reference: Jaridar Los Angeles Democrat ta tabbatar da cewa ƙage wasu "masu ra'ayin riƙau" ne da yanonin gizo suke watsa shi.

rows.source: "Lies, lies, and more despicable lies," Waters said in a statement on Twitter.
rows.output: "Karya, ƙarya, da ƙari na ƙaryar da ba ta da kyau," Waters ta ce a wani bayanin da ta yi a Twitter.
rows.reference: Ƙarerayi, ƙarerayi, da kuma ƙarin munanan ƙarerayi, inji Waters sa cikin wata sanarwa a kan Twitter.

rows.source: The released information reportedly included the home addresses and phone numbers for U.S. Sens. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, and Mike Lee and Orrin Hatch, both of Utah.
rows.output: An ruwaito cewa bayanan da aka saki sun hada da adiresoshin gida da lambobin waya na 'yan majalisar dattawan Amurka Lindsey Graham na Kudu Carolina, da Mike Lee da Orrin Hatch, duka Utah.
rows.reference: Bayanin da aka fitar din an ce ya hada da adiresoshin gida da lambobin tarho don Majalisar Dattawa ta Amurka. Lindsey Graham na Carolina ta Kudu, da Mike Lee da Orrin Hatch, dukkansu na Utah.

rows.source: The information appeared online Thursday, posted by an unknown person on Capitol Hill during a Senate panel's hearing on the sexual misconduct allegations against Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: An bayyana bayanan a kan layi a ranar Alhamis, wanda wani mutum da ba a sani ba ya wallafa a kan Capitol Hill a lokacin da Majalisar Dattijai ta yi zaman ta kan zarge-zargen cin zarafi da aka yi wa dan takarar Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Bayanin ya fito ne ta yanar gizo a ranar Alhamis, wanda wani da ba a sani ba a Capitol Hill a lokacin wani jin bahasi na Majalisar Dattawan a kan ƙage-ƙagen cin zarafin jima'i a kan wanda aka zaɓi sunan nasa zuwa Kotun Kolin Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: The leak came sometime after the three senators had questioned Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Fitarwar ta zo ne bayan da 'yan majalisar dattijai uku suka yi wa Kavanaugh tambayoyi.
rows.reference: Yoyon ya zo ne wani lokaci bayan sanatoci uku sun yi tambaya a Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Conservative sites such as Gateway Pundit and RedState reported that the IP address that identifies the source of the posts was associated with Waters" office and released the information of a member of Waters' staff, the Hill reported.
rows.output: Shafukan masu ra'ayin mazan jiya kamar Gateway Pundit da RedState sun ruwaito cewa adireshin IP da ke nuna asalin rubutun ya shafi ofishin Waters kuma sun fitar da bayanan wani dan ma'aikatan Waters, a cewar rahoton Hill.
rows.reference: Wuraren shafin yanar gizo kamar su Gateway Pundit da RedState sun kawo rahoto cewa adireshin IP da ya gano kafar ta fitarwa na da alaƙa tare da ofishin Waters" da ya fitar da bayanin na wani mamba na ma'aikatan Waters, inji rahoton  Hill.

rows.source: "This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie," Waters continued.
rows.output: "Wannnan ikirari mara tushe gaba ɗaya ƙarya ce kuma ƙarya ce," Waters ya ci gaba.
rows.reference: Wannan ƙagen da ba shi tushe gaba ɗaya ƙarya ne kuma wata cikekkiyar ƙarya ce, Waters ya ci gaba.

rows.source: "The member of my staff - whose identity, personal information, and safety have been compromised as a result of these fraudulent and false allegations - was in no way responsible for the leak of this information.
rows.output: "Ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikac
rows.reference: Mamban na ma'aikatana - wanda shaida, bayanin keɓe, da kariya an narkar da su a sakamakon waɗannan zambo da ƙage-ƙagen ƙarya - ba su ne suka haddasa yoyon wannan bayanin ba.

rows.source: This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie."
rows.output: Wannan zato mara tushe ba gaskiya ba ne kuma ƙarya ce.
rows.reference: Wannan ƙage da ba tushe gada ɗaya ƙarya ne kuma wata cikekkiyar ƙara a fili."

rows.source: Waters' statement quickly drew criticism online, including from former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer.
rows.output: Bayanan Waters sun yi sauri sun jawo suka a kan layi, ciki har da tsohon mai magana da yawun White House, Ari Fleischer.
rows.reference: Jawabin Waters ya ja suka ta yanar gizo, da ya haɗa da tsohon sakataren yaɗa labarai na fadar White House wato Ari Fleischer.

rows.source: "This denial is angry," Fleischer wrote.
rows.output: "Wannnan kin amincewa da fushi ne," Fleischer ya rubuta.
rows.reference: Wannan kin yana da ban haushi, a rubutun Fleischer.

rows.source: "This suggests she doesn't have the temperment to be a Member of Congress.
rows.output: "Wannnan yana nuna cewa ba ta da yanayin da za ta zama 'yar majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Wannan yana nuna ba ta hali da za ta zama wata Mamba ta Majalisar Dokoki ba.

rows.source: When someone is accused of something they didn't do, they must not be angry.
rows.output: Idan aka zarge wani da wani abu da bai aikata ba, dole ne su yi shuru.
rows.reference: A yayin da aka tuhumi wani da yin wani abu da ba su yi ba, dole ba za su ɓata rai ba.

rows.source: They must not be defiant.
rows.output: Ba su da wani abu.
rows.reference: Ba za su dole jajirce ba.

rows.source: They must not question the motives of the accuser.
rows.output: Ba za su iya tambayar dalilan mai zargi ba.
rows.reference: Ba za su dole tambayi manufofin wanda ake tuhumar ba.

rows.source: They must be calm and serene."
rows.output: Dole ne su kasance cikin nutsuwa da nutsuwa."
rows.reference: Dole su kwantar da hankali kuma su nitsu."

rows.source: Fleischer was appearing to compare Waters' reaction to the Democrats' criticism of Judge Kavanaugh, who was accused by critics of seeming too angry during Thursday's hearing.
rows.output: Fleischer ya bayyana cewa ya zo ya kwatanta martanin Waters ga sukar 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat ga Alkalin Kavanaugh, wanda masu sukar sa suka ce yana bayyana fushi a lokacin da aka yi masa tambayoyi a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Fleischer yana fitowa ne don kwatanci ga martanin Waters zuwa ga sukar Democrats ga Alƙali Kavanaugh, wanda aka masu suka na kasancewa kamar mai ɓacin rai sosai a lokacin jin bahasi na ranar Alhamis.

rows.source: Omar Navarro, a Republican candidate running to unseat Waters in the midterm elections, also voiced his thoughts on Twitter.
rows.output: Omar Navarro, dan takarar jam'iyyar Republican da ke neman tsayar da Waters a zaben tsaka-tsaki, ya kuma bayyana tunaninsa a shafukan Twitter.
rows.reference: Omar Navarro, wani dan takara da ke neman kwace kujerar Waters a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango, shi ma ya furta tunaninsa a kan Twitter.

rows.source: "Big if true," he tweeted.
rows.output: "Big if true," ya wallafa a shafinsa na Twitter.
rows.reference: "Babba idan gaskiya ne," inji shi ta Twitter.

rows.source: In her statement, Waters said her office had alerted "the appropriate authorities and law enforcement entities of these fraudulent claims.
rows.output: A cikin bayanin ta, Waters ta ce ofishinta ya sanar da "hukumomin da suka dace da kuma jami'an tsaro na wariyar launin fata game da wadannan da'awar karya.
rows.reference: A cikin jawabinta, Waters ta ce ofishinta ya faɗakar da ita "hukumomi da suka dace da hukumomin zartar da doka na waɗannan koke-koke na zambo.

rows.source: "We will ensure that the perpetrators will be revealed," she continued, "and that they will be held legally liable for all of their actions that are destructible and dangerous to any and all members of my staff."
rows.output: "Muna tabbatar da cewa masu aikata laifuka za a bayyana su," ta ci gaba, "kuma za a sanya su a kan doka bisa dukkan ayyukan da suke da illa da kuma illa ga kowane memba na ma'aikatan da ke ƙarƙashin ni."
rows.reference: Za mu tabbatar da cewa an bayyana masu yin abin, ta ci gaba, "kuma za a kama su da haƙƙi na aikatawa don dukkan ayukansu da ke rusarwa da cutarwa zuwa ga kowa da dukkan mambobi na ma'aikatana."

rows.source: Johnny English Strikes Again review - underpowered Rowan Atkinson spy spoof
rows.output: Johnny English Strikes Again bita - rashin ƙarfi na Rowan Atkinson spy spoof
rows.reference: Johnny English Ya Sake Dawowa sharhi - Rowan Atkinson mai leƙen asiri da aka fi karfi

rows.source: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.
rows.output: Yanzu al'ada ce a duba ma'anar Brexit a duk wani sabon fim mai jigo na Birtaniya, kuma hakan ya yi kama da wannan sake farfadowar jerin barkwanci na aikata laifuka - wanda ya fara a 2003 da Johnny English da kuma sake farfadowa a 2011 da Johnny English Reborn.
rows.reference: Yanzu wata al'ada ce a duba amfanin Brexit a cikin kowane fim tare da wani dan Birtaniyya kuma wannan ba ya nufi zai gudana ne ga wannan sake dawo da barkwancin Johnny English ba - wanda aka fara tun a 2003 tare da Johnny English da kuma aka dawo da shi a raye a cikin 2011 tare da Johnny English Reborn.

rows.source: Will tongue-in-cheek self-satire on the subject of how obviously rubbish we are be the nation's new export opportunity?
rows.output: Shin zagi da ban dariya kan yadda muka kasance a fili mun fi munanan abubuwa zata zama sabon damarmar fitar da kaya a kasar?
rows.reference: Shin da zolayar kai a kan batun na yadda yake a bayyane shirme ne za a ce mu ne sabuwar ƙasar da ke da damar shigo da kaya?

rows.source: At any rate, the pop-eyed, rubber-faced incompetent Johnny English has had his licence to cock things up renewed for the second time - that name of his signalling more than anything else that he is a broad comic creation designed for non-English-speaking cinemagoing territories.
rows.output: A kowane hali, Johnny Ingilishi mai idanun pop da fuska mai roba ya sami lasisin yin kuskure na biyu - wannan sunan nasa ya nuna fiye da komai cewa shi ne wani babban abin barkwanci da aka yi niyya ga kasashen da ba na Ingilishi ba - masu kallo.
rows.reference: A kowane irin yanayi, idon ya fito ga fuskar roba ta Johnny English da bai iya ba da ya sami lasisinsa don tsara abubuwa sababbi don lokaci na biyu - wannan sunan nasa ya nuna abu fiye da kome cewa shi wani ƙirƙirar wasa ne mai fadi da aka tsara don masu zuwa silima a wuraren da ba sa magana da Turanci.

rows.source: He is of course the daft secret agent who despite his bizarre pretensions to smoothie glamour has got a little bit of Clouseau, a dash of Mr Bean and a dollop of that chap contributing a single note to the Chariots of Fire theme tune at the London 2012 Olympics opening ceremony.
rows.output: Shi mutum ne mai ban dariya wanda, duk da irin wannan halinsa na musamman na sha'awar sha'awar sha'awar sha'awar sha'awar sha'awar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar
rows.reference: Shi kuwa haƙiƙa wani wawan dan leƙen asiri ne duk da cewa irin yadda yake nunawa wani iri don saukaka ado da ya sa ɗan Clouseau, wani dan aiki na Mista Bean da kuma wani aiki na wannan mutumin da ke ba da gudunmawa a matsayin rubutu guda ɗaya ga jigon sauti na Chariots of Fire a buɗe bikin Olympics a 2012 a Landan.

rows.source: He's also originally based on the traveller and international man of mystery Atkinson once played in the now forgotten Barclaycard TV ads, leaving chaos in his wake.
rows.output: Haka kuma ya samo asali ne daga mai tafiya da mutumin duniya mai ban mamaki Atkinson ya taka rawa a cikin tallan talabijin da aka manta da Barclaycard, yana barin rudani a cikin tafiyarsa.
rows.reference: Kuma shi ma na asali ne a bisa kan matafiya da kuma mutum na kasa-da-kasa mai ban mamaki Atkinson ya taɓa wasa a cikin tallace-tallacen talabijin na Barclaycard da yanzu aka manta, yana mai barin tashin hankali a farkawarsa.

rows.source: There are one or two nice moments in this latest JE outing.
rows.output: Akwai wani ko biyu daga cikin abubuwan da suka faru a wannan tafiya ta JE ta baya-bayan nan.
rows.reference: Akwai daya ko biyu kyawawan yanayi a cikin wannan fitar ta JE mafi sabuwa.

rows.source: I loved Johnny English approaching a helicopter while dressed in a medieval suit of armour and the rotor blades briefly clanging against his helmet.
rows.output: Na so Johnny English yana kusantar da helikwafta yayin da yake sanye da kayan ado na zamanin da kuma jujjuyawar jujjuyawar sun yi karan da kansa.
rows.reference: Ina son yadda  Johnny English ke kusantar wani helikwafta a lokacin da ya sa tufa a cikin kayan sulke na wani zamanin da kuma da wuƙaƙen rotor suna da sanye a jikin hular kwanon nasa.

rows.source: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.
rows.output: Kyautar Atkinson ga wasan barkwanci na zahiri tana bayyana, amma dariyan yana jin kamar ba shi da ƙarfi sosai kuma yana da ban mamaki, musamman yayin da fina-finan "mai tsanani" kamar 007 da Mission Impossible suka fara ba da dariya a matsayin wani abu.
rows.reference: Ana nuna kyautar fasahar Atkinson ta barkwanci a zahiri a fili, amma ban dariyar tana zama kamar ba ta da ƙarfi sosai kuma da shirme, musamman idan aka duba sanannun fina-finai "da ba wasa" irin su nau'ukan 007 da Mission Impossible su da kansu suna yanzu da ƙarfin gwiwa samar da barkwanci a matsayin ɗanɗanonsu.

rows.source: The humour feels as if it is pitched at kids rather than adults, and for me Johnny English's wacky misadventures aren't as inventive and focused as Atkinson's silent-movie gags in the persona of Bean.
rows.output: Humour ɗin yana jin kamar yana da alaƙa da yara maimakon manya, kuma a gare ni, abin ban dariya na Johnny English's wacky misadventures ba su da kirkira da mayar da hankali kamar gungu na Atkinson's silent-movie gags a cikin Bean's persona.
rows.reference: Ana jin ban dariyar kamar an danganta ne da ga yara maimakon manya, kuma a gare ni mummunan abin da Johnny English ya gani ba su zama na ƙagowa ba kuma sun fuskanci shirun Atkinson ne a cikin hali na Bean.

rows.source: The perennially topical premise now is that Great Britain is in serious trouble.
rows.output: Matsayin da ke da alaƙa da shi a yanzu shine cewa Birtaniya na cikin mawuyacin hali.
rows.reference: Abin da ake fada na tattaunawa shi ne Babbar Birtaniyya tana cikin babban tashin hankali.

rows.source: A cyber-hacker has infiltrated Britain's super-secret web network of spies, revealing the identities of all Britain's agents in the field, to the dismay of the agent on duty - a regrettably small role for Kevin Eldon.
rows.output: Wani mai kutse na yanar gizo ya shiga cikin hanyar sadarwar yanar gizo ta Birtaniya mai sirri, ya bayyana asirin dukkan 'yan leken asirin Birtaniya a fagen, wanda ya haifar da damuwa ga jami'in da ke kan aikin - wani karamin rawa ga Kevin Eldon.
rows.reference: Wani mai kutsen yanar gizo ya shiga hanyar sadarwa ta yanar gizo ta hukumar leƙen asiri ta Birtaniyya, yana mai bayyana shaidar dukkan wakilan Birtaniyya a cikin ɓangaren, cikin kunyata wakilin da ke aiki - wata 'yar matsala da ake jin takaicinta ga ƙaramin aiki na Kevin Eldon.

rows.source: It's the last straw for a prime minister who is a pompous and embattled figure, already suffering a complete meltdown of political unpopularity: Emma Thompson does her very best with this quasi-Teresa-May character but there's nothing much in the script to work with.
rows.output: Wannan shine karsashin da zai iya zama na Firaminista wanda mutum ne mai girma da kuma wanda ya yi ta fama da rashin nasara a siyasance: Emma Thompson ta yi kokarin ta mafi kyau da wannan halin da ya yi kama da Teresa-May amma babu komai mai yawa a cikin rubutun da za a yi aiki da shi.
rows.reference: Shi ne matsala ƙarshe ga wata firaminista wanda ke da ji da kai kuma mai son fitina, tuni cikin shan wahala narkewa ta rashin farin jinin siyasa: Emma Thompson ta yi abin da tafi iyawa tare da wannan irin halin da ba na Teresa May ba amma ba wani abu sosai a cikin tsarin aikin.

rows.source: Her intelligence advisers inform her that as every single active spy has been compromised, she will have to bring someone out of retirement.
rows.output: Mataimakan hankalinta sun sanar da ita cewa, tun da duk 'yan leken asirin da ke aiki a yanzu sun yi satar bayanai, za ta bukaci ta kawo wani daga ritaya.
rows.reference: Masu ba ta shawara ta fuskar asiri sun fada mata cewa kusan an lalata kowane mai leken asiri, dole sai ta kawo wani daga cikin ritaya.

rows.source: And that means bumbling Johnny English himself, now employed as a schoolmaster in some posh establishment, but giving off-the-record lessons in how to be an undercover operative: some nice gags here, as English offers a School of Rock-type academy of spying.
rows.output: Kuma hakan yana nufin Johnny Ingilishi mai ban dariya, yanzu ma'aikaci ne a wani babban makarantar sakandare, amma yana ba da darussa ba bisa ka'ida ba kan yadda za a yi aiki a matsayin mai leken asiri: wasu barkwanci masu kyau a nan, yayin da Ingilishi ke ba da makarantar Rock-type na leken asiri.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan yana nufin Johnny English shi da kansa, yanzu da ke aiki a matsayin malamin makaranta a cikin wata ma'aikata mai kyau, amma yana barin darussan a cikin yadda zai zama wani mai aikin leƙen asiri: wasu kyawawan gags a nan, kamar yadda English ya samar da wani karatu na leƙen asiri wani iri.

rows.source: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.
rows.output: An dawo da Ingilishi zuwa Whitehall don wani taro na gaggawa kuma an sake haɗuwa da tsohon abokin aiki na dogon lokaci Bough, wanda Ben Miller ya sake buga shi.
rows.reference: An jawo English baya zuwa ga Whitehall don wani bayanin gaggawa da kuma sake haɗewa tare da tsohon mai taimaka masa a gefe Bough, da aka yi a kan Ben Miller.

rows.source: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.
rows.output: Yanzu Bough ya yi aure, an haɗa shi da kwamandan jirgin ruwa, wani rawa na hockey-jolly-sticks wanda Vicki Pepperdine ya yi kadan.
rows.reference: Bough yanzu wani mutum ne da ke aure, da ke haɗe da wani kwamandan jirgin ruwa, wata irin rawar takawa marar daɗi inda Vicki Pepperdine ya zama wani ɗan ɓata lokaci.

rows.source: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.
rows.output: Don haka, Batman da Robin na yin abubuwa da ba daidai ba a Sabis ɗin Sirrin Sarauniyar, sun sake shiga aiki, suna fuskantar kyawun Ophelia Bulletova na femme fatale Olga Kurylenko.
rows.reference: Don haka Batman da Robin suna yi kuskure mummuna a kan Hukumar Leƙen Asiri ta Sarauniya sun dawo bakin aiki, suna haɗuwa da kyakkyawar matsalar mace Ophelia Bulletova ta Olga Kurylenko.

rows.source: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.
rows.output: A lokacin da Firaminista ya yi hatsari sosai a ƙarƙashin sihirin mai fasaha mai ban sha'awa wanda ya yi iƙirarin zai warware matsalolin kwamfutar Birtaniya: Jason Volta mai ban tsoro, wanda Jake Lacy ya buga.
rows.reference: A yanzun haka, firaministan yana gazawa cikin haɗari a ƙarƙashin ikon biloniya da ake so mai kayan fasaha wanda ya ce zai iya warware bala'in kwamfuta na Birtaniyya: wato sinister Jason Volta, da Jake Lacy ya rera.

rows.source: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.
rows.output: Turanci da Bough sun fara tafiyarsa ta ban dariya: an yi musu ado a matsayin masu hidima, sun kunna wuta a wani gidan cin abinci na Faransa mai ban mamaki; sun haifar da hargitsi suna shawo kan jirgin ruwa na Volta mai alfarma; kuma Turanci ya haifar da rudani yayin da yake kokarin amfani da na'urar gani ta zahiri don sanin cikin gida na Volta.
rows.reference: English da Bough sun fara duba tsarinsu: da aka ɓoye kamar masu jira, sun cinna wuta ga wani hasken wurin sayar da abinci na Faransa; sun ƙirƙiri hayaniya inda suke sumogar kansu ta cikin jin daɗi jirgin ruwa na Volta; kuma English sun zaburar da rashin bin doka a inda yake ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare don amfani da wata na'urar kai ta Virtual Reality don fahimtar da kansa da cikin gidan na Volta.

rows.source: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.
rows.output: Duk tsayuwa sun yi tsalle sosai don wannan jerin na ƙarshe, amma duk da haka yana da kyau kuma yana da ban sha'awa, akwai 'yan talabijin da yawa game da dukkan abubuwan da suka faru.
rows.reference: Haƙiƙa an ciro dukkan tsaye-tsaye don jerin ƙarshe, amma duk da kyawu da girman yadda yake, akwai dan talabijin na yara game da gaba ɗaya abin.

rows.source: Pretty moderate stuff.
rows.output: Abun da ya dace.
rows.reference: Matsakaicin kyakkyawan tsari.

rows.source: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?
rows.output: Kuma kamar yadda sauran fina-finan Johnny English suka yi, ba zan iya daina tunanin ba: shin masana'antar fina-finan Birtaniya za su iya ba Rowan Atkinson wani rawa da ya dace da basirarsa?
rows.reference: Kuma da sauran fina-finan Johnny English ba zan iya daina tunani ba: shin me zai hana masana'antar fim ta Birtaniyya ta ba wa Rowan Atkinson wata rawa da zai taka wanda a zahiri za yi adalci ga hikimarsa?

rows.source: Labour denies it is devising a plan for Britons to work a four day week but be paid for five days
rows.output: Labour ta musanta cewa tana shirin tsara tsarin aiki na kwanaki hudu ga 'yan Birtaniya, amma za su samu albashi na kwanaki biyar
rows.reference: Labour ta ki yarda tana shirya wani shiri ne ga 'yan Birtaniyya su yi aiki na makon kwana huɗu amma a biya su kwanaki biyar

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is to consider a radical plan which will see Britons working a four day week - but getting paid for five.
rows.output: Jam'iyyar Labour ta Jeremy Corbyn za ta yi la'akari da wani shiri mai ban sha'awa wanda zai sa 'yan Birtaniya su yi aiki na kwanaki hudu - amma su samu albashi na kwanaki biyar.
rows.reference: Jam'iyyar Labour ta Jeremy Corbyn za ta duba wani babban shirin wanda zai ga 'yan Birtaniyya suna yin aiki na kwana huɗu a mako - amma su sami biya na kwana biyar.

rows.source: The party reportedly wants company bosses to pass on savings made through the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution to workers by giving them an extra day off.
rows.output: Jam'iyyar tana son shugabanni su ba ma'aikatan su ranar hutu ta karshenta ta hanyar yin amfani da fasahar basirar wucin gadi (AI).
rows.reference: A cewar rahoto jam'iyyar tana son shugabannin kamfani su mika kuɗaɗen da aka adana ta cikin juyin juya halin hikimar da ba ta asali ba (AI) ga ma'aikata ta ba su ƙarin hutu kwana guda.

rows.source: It would see employees enjoy a three-day weekend - but still take home the same pay.
rows.output: Zai ga ma'aikata suna jin daɗin hutu na kwanaki uku - amma har yanzu suna samun kuɗin da suka saba.
rows.reference: Zai ga ma'aikata suna more wani ƙarshen na kwana uku - amma har yanzu su sami irin kuɗin da ake biyansu.

rows.source: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.
rows.output: An ce ra'ayin zai yi daidai da shirin tattalin arzikin jam'iyyar da kuma shirin saukaka kasar ga ma'aikata.
rows.reference: Kafofin sun ce hikimar za ta 'dace' tare da ajandar tattalin arziki ta jam'iyyar da shirye-shirye da za su juya ƙasar zuwa abin da ma'aikata ke so.

rows.source: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.
rows.output: Canza zuwa mako hudu na aiki an amince da shi da kungiyar Kwadago ta kasa a matsayin hanyar da ma'aikata za su yi amfani da canje-canje a tattalin arziki.
rows.reference: Matsaya zuwa wani kwana huɗu na mako ya sami yardar Majalisar Ƙungiyar 'Yan Ƙwadago a matsayin wata hanya don ma'aikata su sami fa'ida ta canza tattalin arzikin.

rows.source: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.
rows.output: Wani babban mai ba da shawara a jam'iyyar Labour ya gaya wa The Sunday Times: "Ana sa ran a sanar da bitar manufofi kafin karshen shekarar.
rows.reference: Wata babbar kafa ta Jam'iyyar Labour ta faɗa wa The Sunday Times: Ana tsammanin sake duba ƙudurin da za a sanar kafin ƙarshen shekarar.

rows.source: 'It won't happen overnight but a four-day working week is an aspiration that fits in with the party's approach to rebalancing the economy in favour of the worker as well as the party's overall industrial strategy.'
rows.output: 'Bai kamata ya faru ba cikin dare guda, amma mako hudu na aiki na aiki na iya zama abin da ya dace da ra'ayin jam'iyyar na sake daidaitawa da tattalin arziki a cikin fa'ida na ma'aikata da kuma tsarin masana'anta na jam'iyyar gaba daya.'
rows.reference: Ba zai faru rana ɗaya ba amma wani makon aiki na kwana hudu abin jan hankali ne da ya dace a cikin hanyar jam'iyyar ga sake daidaita tattalin arziki don ma'aikacin har ma da gaba ɗaya dabarar jam'iyyar ta fuska masana'anta.'

rows.source: The Labour Party would not be the first to endorse such an idea, with the Green Party pledging a four-day working week during its 2017 general election campaign.
rows.output: Jam'iyyar Kwadago ba za ta kasance ta farko da za ta amince da irin wannan ra'ayi ba, inda jam'iyyar Green ta yi alkawari na yin aiki na kwanaki hudu a lokacin yakin neman zabenta na 2017.
rows.reference: Jam'iyyar Labour ba za ta zama ta farko da za ta yarda da irin ra'ayin ba, tare da Jam'iyyar Green da alkawarin makon aiki na kwana huɗu a lokacin kamfe ɗinta na zaɓen gama-gari a 2017.

rows.source: The aspiration is currently not being endorsed by the Labour Party as a whole, however.
rows.output: Burin a halin yanzu ba a amince da shi ba daga jam'iyyar Labour a matsayin gaba ɗaya, duk da haka.
rows.reference: A yanzu Jam'iyyar Labour ba ta nuna amincewa da jan hankali gaba ɗaya, amma.

rows.source: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'
rows.output: Wani mai magana da yawun jam'iyyar Labour ya ce: 'Mako hudu na aiki ba manufofin jam'iyyar ba ne kuma ba a duba shi ba.'
rows.reference: Wani mai magana da yawun Jam'iyyar Labour ya ce: Wani mako na aiki na kwana huɗu ba ƙudurin jam'iyya ne kuma jam'iyyar ma ta la'akari da shi.'

rows.source: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.
rows.output: Shugaban inuwa John McDonnell ya yi amfani da taron jam'iyyar Labour na makonnin da suka gabata don bayyana hangensa na juyin juya hali na zamantakewa a tattalin arziki.
rows.reference: Ƙaramin cansala John McDonnell ya yi amfani da taron Labour na makon da ya wuce don nuna abin da yake hange don wani juyin juya hali na aƙidar gurguzu a cikin tattalin arzikin.

rows.source: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.
rows.output: Mr McDonnell ya ce ya yi niyyar dawo da iko daga 'masoyan fuska' da 'masoya riba' a cikin kamfanon amfani.
rows.reference: Mista McDonnell ya ce yana shirye da ya kame iko daga 'daraktocin boye' da 'maciya riba' a kamfanonin amfanin jama'a.

rows.source: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.
rows.output: Shugaba mai inuwa na shirin da ya yi kuma yana nufin masu hannun jari na yanzu a cikin kamfanon ruwa ba za su iya dawo da dukkan jarinsu ba, saboda gwamnatin Labour za ta iya yin 'ragi' bisa ga la'akari da wani laifi.
rows.reference: Shiryen-shiryen ƙaramin cansalan kuma suna nufi masu zuba jari yanzu a cikin kamfanonin ruwa ba za su kila sami dawo da abin da suka sa gaba ɗaya ba saboda wata gwamnatin Labour za ta iya yin 'rage-rage' a bisa dalilai na abin da ake ganin bai dace ba.

rows.source: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.
rows.output: Ya kuma tabbatar da shirin sanya ma'aikata a kan kwamitin gudanarwa da kuma samar da Asusun Mallakar Hadaka don bada kashi 10 cikin 100 na hannun jarin kamfanon da ba na gwamnati ba ga ma'aikata, wadanda za su iya samun riba na shekaru-shekara har zuwa £500.
rows.reference: Ya kuma tabbatar da shirye-shiryen don sa ma'aikata a cikin hukumar kamfani da ƙirƙirar Asusunan Mallaka Ba Kowa don ba da kashi 10 cikin ɗari na daidaito kamfanonin ɓangaren 'yan kasuwa zuwa ga ma'aikata, waɗanda za su iya samun ribobi na shekara har kusan zuwa Euro 500.

rows.source: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds
rows.output: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy sun gaya wa "60 Minutes" ko bincike da FBI ta yi kan Kavanaugh zai canza ra'ayinsu.
rows.reference: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy sun faɗa wa "60 Minutes" ko binciken FBI na Kavanaugh zai iya canza zuciyarsu.

rows.source: The FBI investigation into accusations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed a final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court by at least a week, and raises the question of whether the bureau's findings could sway any Republican senators into pulling their support.
rows.output: Binciken FBI kan zarge-zargen da ake yi wa Alkalin Brett Kavanaugh ya jinkirta zaben karshe na mukaminsa na Kotun Koli da aƙalla sati guda, kuma ya haifar da tambayar ko sakamakon bincike na hukumar zai iya rinjayar duk wani Sanatan Republican da ya janye goyon bayansa.
rows.reference: Binciken na FBI na ƙage a kan Alƙali Brett Kavanaugh ya jinkirta kaɗa kuri'a ƙarshen a kan wanda ya zaɓa zuwa Kotun Koli da aƙalla mako ɗaya, kuma ya tayar da tambayoyi ko sakamakon binciken na hukumar zai ja kowaɗanne sanatocin  Republican zuwa cikin goyon bayan nasu.

rows.source: In an interview airing Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pelley asked Republicans Sens. John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham whether the FBI could unearth anything that would lead them to change their minds.
rows.output: A cikin hirar da za ta fito a ranar Lahadi, mai ba da rahoto na "60 Minutes" Scott Pelley ya tambayi 'yan Republican Senators John Kennedy da Lindsey Graham ko FBI za ta iya gano wani abu da zai sa su canza ra'ayoyinsu.
rows.reference: A cikin wata intabiyu da aka wasa Lahadi, mai kawo rahoto na "60 Minutes" Scott Pelley ya tambayi Sanatan Republican John Kennedy da Lindsey Graham ko FBI za ta iya tsamo wani abu da zai kai su canza zuciyoyinsu.

rows.source: Kennedy appeared more open than his colleague from South Carolina.
rows.output: Kennedy ya bayyana ya fi budewa fiye da abokin aikinsa daga Kudu Carolina.
rows.reference: Kennedy ya bayyana shi ba rufa-rufa fiye da abokin aikinsa daga Carolina ta Kudu.

rows.source: "I mean, of course," said Kennedy.
rows.output: "Na nufin, ba shakka," in ji Kennedy.
rows.reference: Ina nufin, ba shakka, inji Kennedy.

rows.source: "I said going into the hearing, I said, I've talked to Judge Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Na ce a lokacin da na shiga zaman, na ce, na yi magana da Alkalin Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: "Na ce zan shiga cikin wurin jin bahasin, inji ni, na yi magana da Alƙali Kavanaugh.

rows.source: I called him after this happened, that allegation came out, said, 'Did you do it?'
rows.output: Na kira shi bayan wannan ya faru, wannan zato ya fito, ya ce, 'Ka yi hakan?'
rows.reference: Na kira shi bayan wannan ya faru, cewa kage ya bayyana, na ce, 'Ka aika abin?'

rows.source: He was resolute, determined, unequivocal."
rows.output: Ya kasance mai tsayayya, mai himma, ba tare da shakkun ba.
rows.reference: Ya kasance a tsinake, shirye, kuma ba girgiza."

rows.source: Graham's vote, however, appears set in stone.
rows.output: Kuri'ar Graham, duk da haka, tana bayyana a fili.
rows.reference: Zaben Graham, amma, ya bayyana an shirya za a yi.

rows.source: "My mind's made up about Brett Kavanaugh and it would take a dynamite accusation," he said.
rows.output: "Zuciyata ta yanke hukunci game da Brett Kavanaugh kuma zai ɗauki wata zato mai ƙarfi," in ji shi.
rows.reference: "Zuciyata ta shirya game da Brett Kavanaugh kuma zai ɗauki wata 'yar babbar tuhuma," inji shi.

rows.source: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett denied it vigorously," Graham added, referring to Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: "Dr. Ford, ban sani ba abin da ya faru, amma na san wannan: Brett ya musanta shi da ƙarfi," Graham ya kara da cewa, yana nufin Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.reference: "Dokta Ford, ban san abin da ya faru ba, amma na san wannan: Brett ya musanta abin sosai," Graham ya ƙara da cewa, yana dangantawa zuwa ga Christine Blasey Ford.

rows.source: "And everybody she names couldn't verify it.
rows.output: Kuma dukkan wanda ta ambaci ba zai iya tabbatar da hakan ba.
rows.reference: "Kuma duk kowa da da ta fadi sunaye ta gagara tantance shi.

rows.source: It's 36 years old.
rows.output: Shekarunta 36 ne.
rows.reference: Shekaru 36 ne.

rows.source: I don't see anything new changing."
rows.output: Ba na ganin wani abu da ya canza."
rows.reference: Ban ga kowane abu sabo da ke canjawa."

rows.source: What is the Global Citizen Festival and Has it Done Anything to Decrease Poverty?
rows.output: Menene bikin Global Citizen kuma ya yi wani abu don rage talauci?
rows.reference: Mene ne Bikin 'Yan Ƙasa na Duniya kuma Shin Ya Yi Wani Abu na Rage Talauci?
