rows.output: "Zan ce wannan -- idan ba ya faɗa gaskiya ga Majalisar Dokoki ko ga FBI, to ba shi da cancanta ba kawai ya kasance a Kotun Koli ba, har ma ya kasance a kotun da yake yanzu."
rows.reference: "Zan ce wannan - idan bai fadi gaskiya ga majalisa ko FBI ba, to, ba kawai koyun koli ne bai dace da shi ba, amma harda kotun da yake a yanzu," in ji Pelos.

rows.source: Kavanaugh is currently a judge on the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals.
rows.output: Kavanaugh a halin yanzu shi ne alkalin kotun daukaka da kuma daukaka a cikin birnin Washington.
rows.reference: Yanzu haka Kavanaugh ya zama mai hukunci akan D.C. Zagayayyen kotun daukaka kara.

rows.source: Pelosi added that as a Democrat she was concerned about potential Kavanaugh rulings against the Affordable Care Act or Roe v. Wade, as he is considered to be a conservative justice.
rows.output: Pelosi ta kara da cewa a matsayin 'yar jam'iyyar Democrat, tana da damuwa game da yiwuwar hukunci da Kavanaugh zai yanke kan Dokar Kima ko Roe v. Wade, domin ana ganin shi a matsayin alkalin shari'a na masu ra'ayin mazan jiya.
rows.reference: Pelosi ta kara da cewa a matsayin ta na yar Democrat ta damu da yiwuwar yanke hukuncin Kavanaugh akan Dokar Kulawa tagari ko Roe v. Wade, Kamar yadda ake alkintawa ya zama alkali mai ra’ayin gargajiya.

rows.source: In his confirmation hearings, Kavanaugh sidestepped questions on whether he would overturn certain Supreme Court decisions.
rows.output: A lokacin da aka tabbatar da shi, Kavanaugh ya guji tambayoyi kan ko zai so ya soke wasu shawarwarin kotun koli.
rows.reference: A cikin tabbacin saurare, Kavanaugh ya yi wasu tambayoyi gafe game da ko zai soke wasu hukuncin Kotun Koli.

rows.source: "It's not time for a hysterical, biased person to go to the court and expect us to say, 'isn't that wonderful,'" Pelosi said.
rows.output: "Ba lokaci ba ne ga mutum mai hargowa da son zuciya ya je kotu ya yi tsammani mu ce, 'ba abin mamaki ba ne,'" in ji Pelosi.
rows.reference: "Ba lokaci ba ne don raha, wanda ba'a so ya je kotun kuma yana fata mu ce, 'ba abin ban mamaki ba ne,' in ji Pelos.

rows.source: And Women Need to Wield It.
rows.output: Kuma Mata suna buƙatar amfani da shi.
rows.reference: Kuma Mata Su na Buƙatar Yin Amfani Da Shi.

rows.source: It is a righteous diatribe, months and years of fury spilling over, and she can't get it out without weeping.
rows.output: Wannan diatribe ce mai adalci, da ta yi ta nuna fushi da fushi da fushi, kuma ba ta iya fitar da shi ba sai da kuka.
rows.reference: Yana da ladabi mai adalci, watanni da shekaru na fushi ya wuce, kuma ba ta iya fitarwa ba, ba tare da kuka ba.

rows.source: "We cry when we get angry," Ms. Steinem said to me 45 years later.
rows.output: "Muna kuka idan muka yi fushi," Ms. Steinem ta ce min shekaru 45 bayan haka.
rows.reference: “Mu na kuka idan mu na fushi, "Ms. Steinem ta ce min shekaru 45 daga baya.

rows.source: "I don't think that's uncommon, do you?"
rows.output: "Ban yi tunanin hakan ba ne na yau da kullun, ko ku?"
rows.reference: "Ba na zaton wannan shi ne ba daidadi, ka sani?"

rows.source: She continued, "I was greatly helped by a woman who was an executive someplace, who said she also cried when she got angry, but developed a technique which meant that when she got angry and started to cry, she'd say to the person she was talking to, "You may think I am sad because I am crying.
rows.output: Ta ci gaba, "Na samu babban taimako daga wata mata wacce ta kasance mai kula da wani aiki, wadda ta ce kuma ta yi kuka lokacin da ta yi fushi, amma ta haɓaka wani fasali wanda ke nufin lokacin da ta yi fushi kuma ta fara kuka, za ta ce ga mutumin da take magana da shi, "Zaka iya tunanin ina cikin baƙin ciki saboda ina kuka.
rows.reference: Ta ci gaba da cewa, "Na samu taimako daga wata wacce shugaba a wani guri, wanda ta ce tana kuka yayin da ta yi fushi, amma ta ci gaba da yin amfani da fasaha wanda yake nufin lokacin da ta yi fushi kuma ta fara kuka, ta ce wa mutumin tana magana da ita, "Kana iya tunanin ina bakin ciki domin ina kuka.

rows.source: I am angry."
rows.output: Na yi fushi."
rows.reference: Ina cikin fushi."

rows.source: And then she just kept going.
rows.output: Sannan ta ci gaba da tafiya.
rows.reference: Sai kuma ta cigaba da tafiya.

rows.source: And I thought that was brilliant."
rows.output: Kuma na yi tunanin hakan ya kasance mai hazaƙa."
rows.reference: Kuma nayi tsammanin wannan abu ne mai kyau. "

rows.source: Tears are permitted as an outlet for wrath in part because they are fundamentally misunderstood.
rows.output: Ana yarda da hawaye a matsayin hanyar fitar da fushi saboda ana ganin ba su da kyau.
rows.reference: kwalla na fitowa sanadiyar laifi a sashe domin kuskuren fahimta.

rows.source: One of my sharpest memories from an early job, in a male-dominated office, where I once found myself weeping with inexpressible rage, was my being grabbed by the scruff of my neck by an older woman - a chilly manager of whom I'd always been slightly terrified - who dragged me into a stairwell.
rows.output: Ɗaya daga cikin tunanin da na fi so daga wani aiki na farko, a ofishi da maza suka mamaye, inda na sami kaina yana kuka da fushi mara misaltuwa, shi ne lokacin da wani tsohon mutum ya kama ni da wuya ya kai ni cikin wani matakala.
rows.reference: Daya daga cikin abun tunawa mafi girma daga aiki na farko, a cikin ofishin maza suka mamaye, inda na taba yin kuka tare da fushi marar iyaka, sai wata tsohuwa ta kamani a wuya - sai shugaban mai saukin kai wanda nake shakku ko da yaushe- ya jani zuwa matakala.

rows.source: "Never let them see you crying," she told me.
rows.output: "Kada ka taɓa barinsu su ga ka kuka," ta gaya min.
rows.reference: “kar ki taba bari su ganki kina kuka,” ta ce min.

rows.source: "They don't know you're furious.
rows.output: "Ba su san kana fushi ba.
rows.reference: Ba su san cewa kina fushi sosai ba.

rows.source: They think you're sad and will be pleased because they got to you."
rows.output: Sun yi tunanin kana bakin ciki kuma za su yi farin ciki saboda sun kai maka hari."
rows.reference: Su na tunanin kina bakin ciki kuma za su ji dadi saboda sun same ki."

rows.source: Patricia Schroeder, then a Democratic congresswoman from Colorado, had worked with Gary Hart on his presidential runs.
rows.output: Patricia Schroeder, wadda a lokacin ta kasance 'yar majalisar wakilai ta jam'iyyar Democrat daga Colorado, ta yi aiki tare da Gary Hart a kan yunƙurin neman takarar shugabancinta.
rows.reference: Patricia Schroeder, sa'an nan kuma yar majalisar dimokuradiyya daga Colorado, ta yi aiki tare da Gary Hart a kan neman shugabancin kasa.

rows.source: In 1987, when Mr. Hart was caught in an extramarital affair aboard a boat called Monkey Business and bowed out of the race, Ms. Schroeder, deeply frustrated, figured there was no reason she shouldn't explore the idea of running for president herself.
rows.output: A shekarar 1987, lokacin da Mista Hart ya kama a cikin wani al'amari na aure a kan wani jirgin ruwa mai suna Monkey Business kuma ya yi murabus daga gasar, Ms. Schroeder, wadda ta ji haushi sosai, ta yi tunanin cewa babu wani dalili da ya sa ba za ta iya bincika ra'ayin tsayawa takara a matsayin shugaban kasa ba.
rows.reference: A shekarar 1987, lokacin da aka kama Mr Hart a hulda zina a cikin wani kwale-kwale mai suna Monkey Business sai ya fice daga tseren, Ms. Schroeder ya yi takaici sosai, ya bayyana cewa babu wani dalili da ya kamata ya hanna a fadada tunanin da zai sai ta nemi takarar shugaban kasa da kanta.

rows.source: "It was not a well-thought-out decision," she said to me with a laugh 30 years later.
rows.output: "Ba wani tunani mai kyau ba ne," ta ce min da dariya shekaru talatin bayan haka.
rows.reference: "Ba wata shawara ce mai kyau ba," in ji ta tana dariya shekaru 30 daga baya.

rows.source: "There were already seven other candidates in the race, and the last thing they needed was another one.
rows.output: "Da akwai 'yan takara bakwai a gasar, kuma abin da suka fi buƙata shi ne wani.
rows.reference: "Akwai wasu 'yan takara bakwai da suka kasance a cikin tseren, kuma abin da suke bukata shi ne wani.

rows.source: Somebody called it "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.""
rows.output: Wani ya kira shi "Farin Gashi da Dwarfs Bakwai."
rows.reference: Wani ya kira shi "Farin Dusar Kankara da Wadanni Bakwai.""

rows.source: Because it was late in the campaign, she was behind on fund-raising, and so she vowed that she wouldn't enter the race unless she raised $2 million.
rows.output: Saboda lokacin ya yi kusa da yakin neman zabe, tana da matsala wajen tara kudi, don haka ta yi alkawari cewa ba za ta shiga zaben ba sai ta tara dala miliyan 2.
rows.reference: Domin ya makara a cikin yaƙin neman zaɓe, ta kasance a baya a kan samun kuɗi, don haka ta yi alƙawarin cewa ba za ta shiga tseren ba sai dai idan ta tara miliyan $2.

rows.source: It was a losing battle.
rows.output: Ya zama yakin da aka yi asara.
rows.reference: Wannan yaki ne damuke rasawa.

rows.source: She discovered that some of her supporters who gave $1,000 to men would give her only $250.
rows.output: Ta gano cewa wasu daga cikin masu goyon bayan ta da suka ba da dala 1,000 ga maza za su ba ta dala 250 kawai.
rows.reference: Ta gano cewa wasu daga cikin magoya bayanta sun ba da $1,000 ga maza zasu ba ta kawai $ 250.

rows.source: "Do they think I get a discount?" she wondered.
rows.output: "Shin sun yi tunanin ina samun rangwame?" ta yi tunanin.
rows.reference: “Kana ganin na samu sauki?” tana mamaki.

rows.source: When she made her speech announcing that she would not launch a formal campaign, she was so overcome by emotions - gratitude for the people who'd supported her, frustration with the system that made it so difficult to raise money and to target voters rather than delegates, and anger at the sexism - that she got choked up.
rows.output: Lokacin da ta yi jawabin da ta sanar cewa ba za ta fara yakin neman zabe ba, ta yi ta fama da yanayin zuciyarta - godiya ga mutanen da suka tallafa mata, fushi da tsarin da ya sa ya yi wahala a tara kudi da kuma mayar da hankali kan masu zaɓe maimakon masu zaɓe, da kuma fushi da jinsin da ta yi.
rows.reference: Lokacin da ta gabatar da jawabinta cewa ba za ta kaddamar da yakin takara ba, sai ta fada cikin tausayi - godiya ga mutanen da suka goyi bayanta, takaici ga tsarin da ya zo da wahalar samun kudi da kuma zartar da masu jefa kuri'a maimakon wakilai, da kuma fushi a kan jinsi - cewa ta gamsu da hakan.

rows.source: "You would have thought I'd had a nervous breakdown," recalled Ms. Schroeder about how the press reacted to her.
rows.output: "Za ka yi tunanin na yi fargaba," in ji Ms. Schroeder game da yadda kafafen yada labarai suka yi mata martanin.
rows.reference: "Za ka yi tunanin na samu raunin hankali," ta tuna Ms. Schroeder game da yadda 'yan jarida suka matsa mata.

rows.source: "You'd have thought Kleenex was my corporate sponsor.
rows.output: "Za ka yi tunanin Kleenex shine mai tallata ni.
rows.reference: "Kuna tsammani Kleenex ya kasance mai tsarin daukar nauyi na ko.

rows.source: I remember thinking, what are they going to put on my tombstone?
rows.output: Ina tuna tunanin, me za su rubuta a kan kabarina?
rows.reference: Na tuna wannan tunanin, mai zasu je sakawa akan kabarina?

rows.source: "She cried"?""
rows.output: "Ta yi kuka"?
rows.reference: “Tayi kuka”?””

rows.source: How the US-China trade war may be good for Beijing
rows.output: Yadda yakin kasuwanci na Amurka da Sin zai iya zama mai kyau ga Beijing
rows.reference: Yadda yakin kasuwancin Amurka-Sin zai iya zama alheri ga Beijing

rows.source: The opening salvos of the trade war between the US and China were deafening, and while the battle is far from over, a rift between the countries may be beneficial to Beijing in the long term, experts say.
rows.output: Farkon harbe-harben yakin kasuwanci tsakanin Amurka da Sin sun yi yawa, kuma duk da cewa yakin ba ya ƙarewa, rabuwa tsakanin kasashen na iya zama mai amfani ga Beijing a dogon lokaci, in ji masu sharhi.
rows.reference: Makusudin fara yakin kasuwancin a tsakanin Amurka da Sin masu karfi ne, kuma matsala ba mai tsayawa yanzu bane, a tsakanin kasashen biyu kuma zai iya zama alheri ga Beijing na tsawon lokaci, in ji masana.

rows.source: Donald Trump, the US President, fired the first warning earlier this year by taxing key Chinese exports including solar panels, steel and aluminium.
rows.output: Donald Trump, shugaban Amurka, ya fara gargadin farko a farkon wannan shekarar ta hanyar harajin muhimman kayayyakin da kasar Sin ke fitarwa ciki har da firintin hasken rana, karfe da aluminium.
rows.reference: Donald Trump, shugaban kasar Amurka, yayi gargadin farko a farkon wannan shekarar ta hanyar sanya haraji kayayyakin fitarwa muhimmnai na kasar Sin, ciki har da feifen sola, karfe da dalma.

rows.source: The most significant escalation rolled in this week with new tariffs affecting $200 billion (£150 billion) worth of items, effectively taxing half of all goods coming into the US from China.
rows.output: Mafi girman ci gaba a wannan makwanni shi ne sababbin haraji da suka shafi dala biliyan 200 (£150 biliyoyi) na kayayyaki, wanda ya haifar da harajin rabin duk kayayyaki da ke shiga Amurka daga kasar Sin.
rows.reference: Babban haɓakar da aka yi a wannan makon tare jadawalin kuɗin fito da suka shafi dala biliyan 200 (£150 biliyan) kimanin kayan, ta yadda za a biya kashi ɗaya daga cikin kayayyaki da ke zuwa Amurka daga kasar Sin.

rows.source: Beijing has retaliated each time in kind, most recently slapping tariffs of five to ten per cent on $60 billion of American goods.
rows.output: Beijing ya mayar da martanin da ya dace a kowane lokaci, a cikin kwanan nan ya sanya haraji na biyar zuwa goma cikin ɗari akan dala biliyan 60 na kayayyaki daga Amurka.
rows.reference: Beijing ta rama duk acikin nau'i daya, cikin kwanan nan sun kara jadawalin kuɗin fito daga kashi biyar zuwa kashi goma a cikin dala biliyan 60 na kayan Amurka.

rows.source: China has pledged to match the US shot-for-shot, and the world's second largest economy is unlikely to blink anytime soon.
rows.output: Sinawa ta yi alkawari da ta yi daidai da harbin Amurka, kuma tattalin arzikin na biyu mafi girma a duniya ba zai yi kome ba nan ba da jimawa ba.
rows.reference: Kasar Sin sunyi alkawarin amfani da tsarin Amurka na harbe ni-in harbe ka, kuma kasar wace itace to biyu a duniyan tatalin arziki ba su shirya jenyewa ba nan kusa.

rows.source: Getting Washington to back down means caving into demands, but publicly bowing to the US would be far too embarrassing for Xi Jinping, China's president.
rows.output: Samun Washington ya yi murabus yana nufin yin sulhu da bukatu, amma yin biyayya ga Amurka a bainar jama'a zai yi wa Xi Jinping, shugaban kasar Sin, wani abu mai ban tsoro.
rows.reference: Sanya Washington to janye kuma yana nufin kumawa cikin nema, amma janye wa Amurka a bainar jama’a zai fi zama abun kunya ga Xi Jinping, Shugaban Kasar Sin.

rows.source: Still, experts say if Beijing can play its cards right, US trade war pressures could positively support China over the long term by lowering the inter-dependence of the two economies.
rows.output: Har yanzu, masu ilimin kimiyya sun ce idan Beijing ta yi amfani da katinta da kyau, matsi na yakin kasuwanci na Amurka kan iya taimakawa kasar Sin ta samu ci gaba a dogon lokaci ta hanyar rage dogaro da tattalin arzikin kasashensu.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, masana sun ce idan Beijing za ta iya buga katunansa daidai, Amurka za ta iya tallafawa kasar Sin cikin dogon lokaci ta hanyar rage- dogaro na tattalin arziki.

rows.source: "The fact that a quick political decision in either Washington or Beijing could create the conditions that start an economic tailspin in either country is actually a lot more dangerous than onlookers have acknowledged before," said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the Center for New American Security, a think tank.
rows.output: "Al'amari ne mai ban sha'awa cewa yanke shawara na siyasa cikin sauri a Washington ko Beijing na iya haifar da yanayin da zai haifar da faduwar tattalin arziki a kowace kasa.
rows.reference: "Gaskiya cewa a yanke shawarar siyasa cikin sauri a Washington ko Beijing zai iya haifar da yanayin da zai rage tattalin arziki a kowace kasa ya zama mafi haɗari fiye da yadda masu kallo suka amince a gabanin haka," in ji Abigail Grace, wani mai bincike da ke kula da Asiya. Cibiyar Sabon Tsaro ta Amurka, mai tankin tunanin.

rows.source: Syria 'ready' for refugees to return, says Foreign Minister
rows.output: Suriya 'shiri' ga 'yan gudun hijira su dawo, in ji Ministan Harkokin Wajen.
rows.reference: Siriya ta “shirya” don dawo da 'yan gudun hijira, in ji ministan harkokin waje

rows.source: Syria says it's ready for the voluntary return of refugees and is appealing for help to rebuild the country devastated by a more than seven-year long war.
rows.output: Suriya ta ce tana shirya karbar 'yan gudun hijira da su kaɗa kansu, kuma tana roƙon taimakon gina ƙasar da ta lalace saboda yakin da ya fi shekaru bakwai.
rows.reference: Siriya tace ashirye take su karbi yan gudun hijira da suka sa kansu dawowa kuma su na rokon neman taimakon sake gina kasar da ya ruguje sakamakon yakin da dauki fiye da shekara bakwai.

rows.source: Speaking to the United Nations General Assembly, Foreign minister Walid al-Moualem said conditions in the country are improving.
rows.output: A yayin da yake magana da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Ministan Harkokin Waje Walid al-Moualem ya ce yanayin kasar na inganta.
rows.reference: Da suke magana da Babbar Majalisar Dinki Duniya, ministan harkokin waje Walid al-Moualem yace yanayin kasar na kara inganta.

rows.source: "Today the situation on the ground is more stable and secure thanks to progress made in combating terrorism," he said.
rows.output: "A yau yanayin da ke ƙasa ya fi dorewa kuma ya fi kariya saboda ci gaban da aka samu wajen yaki da ta'adda," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ya ce, "Yau halin da ake ciki a cikin ƙasa ya kasance mafi karko da kuma tabbatar da godiya ga cigaban da aka samu wajen yaki da ta'addanci," inji shi.

rows.source: The government continues to rehabilitate the areas destroyed by terrorists to restore normalcy.
rows.output: Gwamnatin na ci gaba da gyara yankunan da 'yan ta'adda suka lalata domin a dawo da zaman lafiya.
rows.reference: Gwamnati ta ci gaba da sake gyara wuraren da 'yan ta'adda suka ruguza don dawo da zaman lafiya.

rows.source: All conditions are now present for the voluntary return of refugees to the country they had to leave because of terrorism and the unilateral economic measures that targeted their daily lives and their livelihoods.
rows.output: Yanzu duk sharuɗɗan sun kasance a shiri don dawo da 'yan gudun hijira da son rai zuwa ƙasar da suka bar ta saboda ta'addanci da kuma matakin tattalin arziki na unilateral da suka yi wa rayuwarsu da kuma hanyarsu ta rayuwa.
rows.reference: Dukkan yanayi sun kasance yanzu don dawo da 'yan gudun hijirar zuwa kasar sun fita ne saboda ta'addanci da kuma matakan tattalin arziki da suka shafi rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum da muhallin su.

rows.source: The UN estimates that more than 5.5 million Syrians have fled the country since the war began in 2011.
rows.output: An kiyasta cewa sama da miliyan 5.5 'yan Siriya sun tsere daga kasar tun bayan da yakin ya fara a shekarar 2011.
rows.reference: Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta kiyasta cewa fiye da mutane miliyan 5.5 sun tsere daga kasar tun lokacin da aka fara yakin shekarar 2011.

rows.source: Another six million people still living in the country are in need of humanitarian assistance.
rows.output: An kuma akwai mutane miliyan shida da ke zaune a kasar da ke buƙatar taimakon jin kai.
rows.reference: Wasu mutane miliyan shida da ke zaune a kasar su na bukatar taimakon agaji.

rows.source: Al-Moualem said the Syrian regime would welcome help in rebuilding the devastated country.
rows.output: Al-Moualem ya ce gwamnatin Siriya za ta maraba da taimakon sake gina kasar da ta lalace.
rows.reference: Al-Moualem ya ce gwamnatin Siriya za ta maraba da taimako wajen sake gina ƙasar da aka rushe.

rows.source: But he stressed that it would not accept conditional assistance or help from countries that sponsored the insurgency.
rows.output: Amma ya jaddada cewa ba zai amince da taimakon da aka sanya sharadi ko kuma daga kasashe da suka dauki nauyin tayar da tarzoma ba.
rows.reference: Amma, ya jaddada cewa, ba zai yarda da tallafi ba, ko taimako daga kasashen da suka tallafa wa tashin hankalin.

rows.source: Europe clinches Ryder Cup victory in Paris
rows.output: Turai ta samu nasara a gasar Ryder Cup a birnin Paris.
rows.reference: Turai taci gasar kofin Ryder a Paris

rows.source: Team Europe has won the 2018 Ryder Cup defeating Team USA by a final score of 16.5 to 10.5 at Le Golf National outside Paris, France.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar Turai ta lashe gasar cin kofin Ryder na 2018, inda ta doke Ƙungiyar Amurka da maki 16.5 zuwa 10.5 a Le Golf National a wajen Paris, Faransa.
rows.reference: Kungiyar Turai ta lashe gasar cin kofin Ryder Cup da cin kungiyar Amurka a wasan karshe na 2018 wasan ya kammalla da maki 16.5 zuwa 10.5 a Le Golf National waje Paris, Faransa.

rows.source: The US has now lost six consecutive times on European soil and has not won a Ryder Cup in Europe since 1993.
rows.output: Amurka ta yi rashin nasara a jere shida a kan ƙasa ta Turai kuma ba ta ci gasar Ryder Cup a Turai tun 1993.
rows.reference: A yanzu haka Amurka ta rasa sau shida a jere akan kasar Turai kuma ba ta lashe kofin Ryder a Turai tun 1993.

rows.source: Europe regained the crown as the Danish captain Thomas Bjorn's team reached the 14.5 points they required to beat the United States.
rows.output: An dawo da sarautar Turai a matsayin tawagar Denmark ta Thomas Bjorn ta kai maki 14.5 don cin nasarar Amurka.
rows.reference: Turai ta sake komawa kambi da dan wasan Denmark kyaftin Thomas Bjorn wanda ya kai maki 14.5 da suke buƙata na doke Amurka.

rows.source: US star Phil Mickelson, who struggled most of the tournament, plunked his tee-shot into the water at the par-3 16th hole, conceding his match to Francesco Molinari.
rows.output: Tauraron Amurka Phil Mickelson, wanda ya yi fama da gasar mafi yawan lokacin, ya jefa kwallonsa a cikin ruwa a rami na 16, ya yi rashin nasara a wasan da Francesco Molinari.
rows.reference: Fitaccen jarumi Amurka Phil Mickelson, wanda ya ka attaka komai a wasan, ya jefa kwallo a cikin ruwa a par-3 rami na 16, inda ya barwa Francesco Molinari wasan shi.

rows.source: The Italian golfer Molinari shined in all of his rounds, becoming 1-of-4 players to ever go 5-0-0 since the tournament's current format begun in 1979.
rows.output: Dan wasan golf na Italiya Molinari ya yi fure a dukkan zagayen sa, ya zama ɗaya daga cikin 'yan wasan 4 da suka taba yin 5-0-0 tun lokacin da aka fara amfani da tsarin da ake amfani da shi a yanzu a shekarar 1979.
rows.reference: Golfer Molinari na Italiya ya haskaka a cikin dukan raga, ya zama dan wasa 1-daga-4 da za su ci gaba da ci 5-0-0 tun lokacin da aka fara gasar a shekarar 1979.

rows.source: American Jordan Spieth was blown out 5&4 by the lowest-ranked player on the European team, Thorbjorn Olesen of Denmark.
rows.output: Dan Amurka Jordan Spieth ya sha kashi 5&4 daga dan wasan da ya fi karamci a tawagar Turai, Thorbjorn Olesen na Denmark.
rows.reference: Dan wasan Amurka Jordan Spieth ya fita akan 5&4 daga cikin 'yan wasa mafi ƙasƙanci a tawagar Turai, Thorbjorn Olesen na Denmark.

rows.source: The world's top-ranked player, Dustin Johnson, fell 2 and 1 to Ian Poulter of England who may have played in his final Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Dan wasan da ya fi kowa a duniya, Dustin Johnson, ya sha kashi da ci 2 da 1 a hannun Ian Poulter na Ingila, wanda wataƙila ya buga wasan karshe na gasar Ryder.
rows.reference: Dustin Johnson, dan wasan gaba na duniya, ya fadi ne 2 da 1 zuwa Ian Poulter na Ingila wanda ya taka leda a gasar cin kofin Ryder na karshe.

rows.source: A veteran of eight Ryder Cups, Spaniard Sergio Garcia became the tournaments all-time winningest European with 25.5 career point.
rows.output: Wani tsohon sojan Ryder Cup na takwas, ɗan ƙasar Spain Sergio Garcia ya zama wanda ya fi kowa nasara a gasar ta Turai da maki 25.5 a aikinsa.
rows.reference: Tsohon dan wasa gasar Ryder na takwas, Serbia Garcia ya zama dan wasan da ya lashe gasar cin kofin Turai a kowane lokaci da maki 25.5.

rows.source: "I don't usually cry but today I can't help it.
rows.output: "Ba na yawaita kuka ba, amma yau ba zan iya jurewa ba.
rows.reference: Ban cika yin kuka ba amma a yau ba zan iya rikewa ba.

rows.source: It's been a rough year.
rows.output: Shekarar ta kasance mai wahala.
rows.reference: Shekara ce mai tsanani.

rows.source: So thankful for Thomas to pick me and believe in me.
rows.output: Na gode wa Thomas da ya zaɓeni ni kuma ya yarda da ni.
rows.reference: Ina godiya sosai da Thomas ya dauke ni kuma ya yarda da ni.

rows.source: I am so happy, so happy to get the cup back.
rows.output: Ina matukar farin ciki, ina matukar farin ciki da dawo da kofin.
rows.reference: Ina farin ciki, farin ciki sosai da na kara dawo da kofin.

rows.source: It's about the team., and I'm happy I was able to help," said an emotional Garcia following the European victory.
rows.output: Yana da al'amura da kungiyar, kuma na yi farin ciki da na iya taimakawa," in ji wani mutum mai tausayi Garcia bayan nasarar Turai.
rows.reference: Game da kungiyar ne., Kuma ina mai farin ciki na iya taimakawa, "cewar Garcia cikin yanayin tausayi bayan nasarar Turai.

rows.source: He passes the torch to his fellow countryman John Ram who took down US golf legend Tiger Woods 2&1 in singles play on Sunday.
rows.output: Ya ba da wutar ga abokan aikinsa John Ram wanda ya doke shahararren dan wasan golf na Amurka Tiger Woods da ci 2&1 a wasan karshe a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Ya mika fitilar ga dan kasarsa, John Ram, wanda ya kaddamar da wasan kwallon kafa ta Amurka Tiger Woods 2 & 1 a wasan daidaiku na ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: "The incredible pride I feel, to beat Tiger Woods, I grew up watching that guy," said 23-year-old Rahm.
rows.output: "Ba zan iya bayyana yadda nake alfahari da wannan nasara ba, na yi alfahari da Tiger Woods, na girma ina kallon wannan mutumin," in ji Rahm mai shekaru 23.
rows.reference: “Babban girman kai da nake ji, in bugi Tiger Woods, na girma ina kallon wannan mutumin, "cewar Rahm mai shekaru 23.

rows.source: Woods lost all four of his matches in France and now has a record of 13-21-3 career Ryder Cup record.
rows.output: Woods ya yi rashin nasara a dukkan wasanni hudu a Faransa kuma yanzu yana da tarihin nasara 13-21-3 a gasar Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Woods ya rasa duk wasanninsa hudu a Faransa kuma yanzu yana da tarihin 13-21-3 na tarihin kofin career Ryder.

rows.source: A strange statistic by one of the greatest players of all-time, having won 14 major titles second to only Jack Nicklaus.
rows.output: Wani abu mai ban mamaki da daya daga cikin manyan 'yan wasa a tarihi, wanda ya lashe kofunan 14 na manyan gasanni na biyu kawai bayan Jack Nicklaus.
rows.reference: Wani kididdiga mai ban mamaki daga daya daga cikin manyan 'yan wasa na duk lokuta, ya lashe kyauta 14 na biyu da Jack Nicklaus kawai.

rows.source: Team USA struggled all weekend to find the fairways with the exception of Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas and Tony Finau, who played high-calibre golf throughout the entire tournament.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar Amurka ta yi gwagwarmaya duk ƙarshen mako don samun hanyoyin da suka dace sai dai Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas da Tony Finau, wadanda suka buga golf mai inganci a duk lokacin gasar.
rows.reference: Kungiyar Amurka ta yi gwagwarmaya a karshen mako don gano hanyoyi masu kyau da ba tare da Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas da Tony Finau, waɗanda suka buga wasan golf mai girma a cikin duka wasannin.

rows.source: US captain Jim Furyk spoke after a disappointing performance for his squad, "I'm proud of these guys, they fought.
rows.output: Kyaftin ɗan Amurka Jim Furyk ya yi magana bayan wani aikin da ya yi rashin nasara ga tawagar sa, "Na yi alfahari da wadannan mutane, sun yi yaƙi.
rows.reference: Kyaftin din Amurka Jim Furyk yayi magana bayan takaicin wasan ga tawagarsa, "Ina alfahari da wadannan mutanen, sun yi fada.

rows.source: There was time this morning when we put some heat on Europe.
rows.output: Da safe, akwai lokaci da muka sanya zafafa kan Turai.
rows.reference: Akwai lokaci wannan safiyar lokacin da muka sanya zafi kan Turai.

rows.source: We scrapped.
rows.output: Muka ruga.
rows.reference: Mun goge.

rows.source: Hats off to Thomas.
rows.output: Girman kai ga Thomas.
rows.reference: Huluna zuwa ga Thomas.

rows.source: He is a great captain.
rows.output: Shi babban kwamanda ne.
rows.reference: Shi babban kyaftin ne.

rows.source: All 12 of his players played very well.
rows.output: Dukkan 'yan wasan 12 sun taka rawa sosai.
rows.reference: Duka yan wasan shi 12 sunyi wasa da kyau sosai.

rows.source: We'll regroup, I'll work with the PGA of America and our Ryder Cup Committee and we'll move forward.
rows.output: Za mu sake taruwa, zan yi aiki tare da PGA ta Amurka da kuma kwamitin gasar Ryder Cup kuma za mu ci gaba.
rows.reference: Za mu sake haɗewa, zan yi aiki tare da PGA na Amurka da kwamitinmu na Ryder Cup kuma za mu ci gaba.

rows.source: I love these 12 guys and I'm proud to serve as captain.
rows.output: Ina son waɗannan maza 12 da kuma alfahari da zama kyaftin.
rows.reference: Ina son wadannan mutanen 12 kuma ina alfaharin yin hidima a matsayin kyaftin.

rows.source: You have to tip your cap.
rows.output: Kuna buƙatar ku yi wa kwalkwali.
rows.reference: Dole ka rankwafa hular ka.

rows.source: We got outplayed."
rows.output: Mun yi rashin nasara."
rows.reference: An buga mu sosai

rows.source: Red Tide Update: Concentrations decrease in Pinellas, Manatee and Sarasota
rows.output: Sabuntawa: An samu raguwar yawan jama'a a Pinellas, Manatee da Sarasota
rows.reference: Ingancin Jan Igiyar Ruwa Sinadarai na raguwa a Pinellas, Manatee da Sarasota

rows.source: The newest report from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Commission shows a general decrease in Red Tide concentrations for parts of the Tampa Bay area.
rows.output: Rahoton da aka fi sani daga Hukumar Kifi da Namun Daji ta Florida ya nuna raguwar Red Tide a wasu sassan yankin Tampa Bay.
rows.reference: Sababbin rahotanni daga Hukumar Florida Fish da wildlife na nuna raguwar sinadaran Jar Igiyar Ruwa a sassan yankin Tampa Bay.

rows.source: According to the FWC, patchier bloom conditions are being reported in areas of Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte and Collier counties - which suggests decreasing concentrations.
rows.output: Bisa ga FWC, an ba da rahoton yanayin fure mai launuka a yankunan Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte da Collier - wanda ke nuna raguwar yawan su.
rows.reference: A cewar FWC,ana samun rahoton yanayin tsagewar kyalli bayar a yankunan Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte da Collier - wanda yake nuna rage yawan sinadarai.

rows.source: A bloom the Red Tide extends approximately 130 miles of coastline from northern Pinellas to southern Lee counties.
rows.output: Wani fari mai launin ja yana mamaye kusan mil 130 na gabar teku daga arewa Pinellas zuwa kudu Lee.
rows.reference: Kyallin Jar Igiyar Ruwa na kara yaduwa kimanin kilomita 130 na coastline daga kasashen arewacin Pinellas zuwa kudancin Lee.

rows.source: Patches can be found about 10 miles offshore of Hillsborough County, but at fewer sites relative to last week.
rows.output: Ana iya samun ramuka kusan mil 10 a cikin teku daga gundumar Hillsborough, amma a wurare kaɗan idan aka kwatanta da makwanni biyu da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Ana iya samun tsagewa kimanin kilomita 10 daga bakin takun kasar Hillsborough, amma a yankuna kadan da suke da alaka da makon da ya gabata

rows.source: Red Tide has also been observed in Pasco County.
rows.output: An ga Ruwan Ja a gundumar Pasco.
rows.reference: An kuma lura da Jar Igiyar Ruwa a kasar Pasco.

rows.source: Medium concentrations in or offshore of Pinellas County have been reported in the past week, low to high concentrations offshore of Hillsborough County, background to high concentrations in Manatee County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Sarasota County, background to medium concentrations in Charlotte County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Lee County, and low concentrations in Collier County.
rows.output: Matsakaiciyar yawan ruwa a ko kusa da Pinellas County an ba da rahoton a makonnin da suka gabata, ƙananan zuwa manyan adadin a bakin tekun Hillsborough County, bango zuwa manyan adadin a Manatee County, bango zuwa manyan adadin a ko kusa da Sarasota County, bango zuwa matsakaicin adadin a Charlotte County, bango zuwa manyan adadin a ko kusa da Lee County, da ƙananan adadin a Collier County.
rows.reference: An bayar da rahoton samuwar sinadarai matsakaita a bakin teku da ke kasar Pinellas a cikin makon da ya gabata, ƙananan zuwa mafi girman sinadai a bakin tekun a kasar Hillsborough, baya zuwa mafi girman sindarai a cikin ko bakin teku a kasar Manatee, baya zuwa gagarumin sindarai a cikin ko bakin tekun yammacin kasar Sarasota, baya zuwa matsakaicin sinadarai a kasar Charlotte, baya zuwa babban sinadarai a ciki ko bakin tekun na kasar Lee, da kuma ƙananan sinadarai a kasar Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation continues to be reported in Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, and Collier counties.
rows.output: Tashin zuciya na numfashi ya ci gaba da bayyana a cikin Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, da Collier.
rows.reference: An cigaba da samun rahoton Raunin numfashi a kasashen Pinellas, Manatee, Lee, da Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation was not reported in Northwest Florida over the past week.
rows.output: Rashin numfashi ba a ba da rahoton a Arewa maso Yamma na Florida a cikin makonnin da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Ba a ruwaito raunin numfashi ba a Northwest Florida a cikin makon da ya gabata.

rows.source: Macedonia's PM Zoran Zaev, his wife Zorica and his son Dushko cast their ballot for the referendum in Macedonia on changing the country's name that would open the way for it to join NATO and the European Union in Strumica, Macedonia September 30, 2018.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Zoran Zaev, nwunye ya Zorica na nwa ya nwoke Dushko na-atụ vootu maka referendum na Macedonia gbasara ịgbanwe aha obodo ahụ nke ga-eme ka ọ banye NATO na European Union na Strumica, Macedonia, Septemba 30, 2018.
rows.reference: PM nke Macedonia Zoran Zaev, nwunye ya Zorica na nwa nwoke ya Dushko tinyere akwụkwọ ntuli aka ha maka nhọpụta ahụ na Macedonia maka ịgbanwe aha nke obodo ahụ nke ga-emepe ụzọ maka ya isonye NATO yana Europenan Union in Strumica, Macedonia Septemba 30, 2018.

rows.source: In front of parliament in Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, was preparing a small stage and pulling up chairs in front of tents set up by those who will boycott the referendum.
rows.output: N'ihu ụlọ omebe iwu na Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, na-akwadebe obere ogbo na ịkwagide oche n'ihu ogige ndị e debere maka ndị ga-azọpụta referendum ahụ.
rows.reference: N’ihu nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu na Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov 54, nọ na akwadobe obere nyiwe, na ebute oche n’ihu ụlọ akanya nke ndị chọrọ igbochi nhọpụta ahụ tọrọ.

rows.source: "We are for NATO and EU, but we want to join with our heads up, not through the service door" Kavadarkov said.
rows.output: "Anyị bụ maka NATO na EU, mana anyị chọrọ isonye na isi elu, ọ bụghị site n'ụzọ ụlọ ọrụ" ka Kavadarkov kwuru.
rows.reference: “Anyị kwụnyere NATO na EU, mana anyị chọrọ iji ugwu wee banye, ọbụghị site n’ụzọ ọrụ” Kavadarkov kwuru.

rows.source: "We are a poor country, but we do have dignity.
rows.output: "Anyị bụ obodo ogbenye, mana anyị nwere ịdị mma.
rows.reference: “Anyị bụ obodo na enweghị ego, mana anyị nwere ugwu.

rows.source: If they don't want to take us as Macedonia, we can turn to others like China and Russia and become part of Euro-Asia integration."
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ha achọghị ịnakwere anyị dị ka Masedonia, anyị nwere ike ịgwa ndị ọzọ dị ka China na Russia ka anyị bụrụ akụkụ nke njikọ Euro-Asia."
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ha achọghị ịnabata anyị ka Macedonia, anyị nwere ike ịchọ ndị ọzọ dị ka China na Russia ma bụrụ akụkụ nke ngwakọta Euro-Asia.”

rows.source: Prime Minister Zaev says NATO membership will bring much needed investment to Macedonia, which has an unemployment rate of more than 20 percent.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Zaev kwuru na ịbata NATO ga-eweta itinye ego dị mkpa na Macedonia, nke nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ enweghị ọrụ karịrị 20%.
rows.reference: Praịm Minista Zaev kwuru nsonye NATO ga-ebute ntinye ego achọrọ na Macedonia, nke nwere oke enweghị ọrụ karịrị pasentị 20.

rows.source: "I believe the huge majority will be in favor because more than 80 percent of our citizens are in favor of EU and NATO," Zaev said after casting his ballot.
rows.output: "Ekwenyesiri m na nnukwu ndị mmadụ ga-akwado ya n'ihi na ihe karịrị 80 pasent nke ụmụ amaala anyị na-akwado EU na NATO," Zaev kwuru mgbe ọ tụbara votu ya.
rows.reference: “Ekwenyere m n’ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ ga-amasị ya n’ihi karịa pasentị 80 nke ndị amaala anyị chọrọ EU na NATO,” Zaev kwuru ka ọ tụchara akwụkwọ ya.

rows.source: He said that a "yes" result would be "confirmation of our future."
rows.output: O kwuru na "ee" ga-abụ "ikwenye na ọdịnihu anyị."
rows.reference: O kwuru na nsonaazụ “ee” ga-abụ “nkwenye nke ọdịnihu anyị.”

rows.source: A poll published last Monday by Macedonia's Institute for Policy Research said between 30 and 43 percent of voters would take part in the referendum - below the required turnout.
rows.output: Otu nyocha e bipụtara n'izu gara aga site na ụlọ ọrụ nyocha nke Macedonia kwuru na pasent 30 ruo 43 nke ndị na-azọ ọkwa ga-azọ ọkwa n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi - n'okpuru ọnụ ọgụgụ a chọrọ.
rows.reference: Nyocha ebipụtara na Mọnde gara aga sitere n’aka Ewumewu maka Nyocha Iwu nke Macedonia kwuru n’etiti pasentị 30 na 43 nke ndị ntuli aka ga-esonye na nhọpụta ahụ - na erughi mpụta achọrọ.

rows.source: Another poll, conducted by Macedonia's Telma TV, found 57 percent of respondents planning to vote on Sunday.
rows.output: Ntuziaka ọzọ, nke Telma TV nke Macedonia mere, chọpụtara na 57 pasent nke ndị zaghachirinụ na-eme atụmatụ ịtụ vootu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Nyocha ọzọ, Telma TV nke Macedonia mere, hụrụ na pasentị 57 nke ndị nzaghachi na ahazi ituli aka na Sọnde.

rows.source: Of those, 70 percent said they would vote yes.
rows.output: N'ime ha, pasentị iri asaa kwuru na ha ga-azọpụta ee.
rows.reference: Na nke ahụ, pasentị 70 kwuru na ha ga-atụnye ee.

rows.source: For the referendum to be successful turnout needs to be 50 percent plus one vote.
rows.output: Iji mee ka ntuli aka ahụ mee nke ọma, a ga-enwe 50 pasentị na otu votu.
rows.reference: Ka nhọpụta ahụ gaa nke ọma ndị ga-apụta kwesịrị ịbụ pasentị 50 gbakwunye otu ntuli aka.

rows.source: A failure in the referendum would represent the first serious blow to policy of the pro-Western government since it took over in May last year.
rows.output: Mgbagha na ntuli aka ga-egosi mgbagha mbụ dị njọ na amụma nke ọchịchị gọọmentị na-akwado West kemgbe o were ọchịchị n'ọnwa Mee afọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọdịda na nhọpụta ahụ ga-egosi nnukwu nsogbu izizi maka iwu nke gọọmentị na akwado ndị Odịda Anyanwụ kemgbe ọ nọchiri na Mey afọ gara aga.

rows.source: Watch: Manchester City's Sergio Aguero navigates through entire Brighton defense for goal
rows.output: Nleba anya: Sergio Aguero nke Manchester City na-agba ọsọ n'ime ndị nche Brighton niile maka goolu
rows.reference: Lelee: Sergio Aguero nke Manchester City gafere ndị defensị Brighton niile maka goolu

rows.source: Sergio Aguero and Raheem Sterling dispatched of the Brighton defense in Manchester City's 2-0 win on Saturday at Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England.
rows.output: Sergio Aguero na Raheem Sterling gburu ndị nche Brighton na mmeri Manchester City 2-0 na Satọdee na Etihad Stadium dị na Manchester, England.
rows.reference: Sergio Aguero na Raheem Sterling tufuru defensị Brighton na mmeri 2-0 nke Manchester City na Satọde na Ama Egwuregwu Etihad na Manchester, England.

rows.source: Aguero made it look ridiculously easy on his score in the 65th minute.
rows.output: Aguero mere ka ọ dị mfe n'ụzọ dị egwu n'ihe mgbaru ọsọ ya na nkeji 65.
rows.reference: Aguero mere ka ọ dị nnukwu mfe iji nye goolu na nkeji nke 65.

rows.source: The Argentine striker received a pass at midfield at the start of the sequence.
rows.output: Onye na-agba bọọlụ Argentine nwetara pase n'etiti etiti n'oge mmalite nke usoro ahụ.
rows.reference: Strịka nwa Argentina ahụ nwetara bọọlụ n’etiti ama egwuregwu na mbido nke usoro ahụ.

rows.source: He raced between three Brighton defenders, before slashing into the open field.
rows.output: Ọ gbara ọsọ n'etiti ndị na-eche nche Brighton atọ, tupu ọ gbatịa n'ime mpaghara mepere emepe.
rows.reference: Ọ gbara ọsọ n’etiti defensi Brighton atọ, tupu ọ gbabanye n’ogige mepere emepe.

rows.source: Aguero then found himself surrounded by four green shirts.
rows.output: Aguero wee chọta onwe ya gbara anọ n'ụdị uwe ndị ojii.
rows.reference: Aguero hụrụ onwe ya ka ndị yi uwe elu na acha agba akwụkwọ ndụ gbara ya okirikiri.

rows.source: He pushed around one defender before outrunning several more at the edge of the Brighton box.
rows.output: O mere ka ọkpọiso onye nche otu tupu ọ gafee ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ n'akụkụ igbe Brighton.
rows.reference: Ọ kwapụrụ otu defensị tupu ọ gbanarị ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ n’isi nke bọksị Brighton.

rows.source: He then pushed a pass to his left, finding Sterling.
rows.output: O wee tụgharịa pasee n'aka ekpe ya, chọta Sterling.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ ọ gbara bọọlụ n’akaekpe ya, chọta Sterling.

rows.source: The English forward used his first touch in the box to give the ball back to Aguero, who used his right boot to beat Brighton keeper Mathew Ryan with a shot into the right side of the net.
rows.output: Onye na-agba bọọlụ n'ihu Bekee ji nkwubi aka ya mbụ n'ime igbe ahụ nye bọọl ahụ n'aka Aguero, onye ji ụkwụ aka nri ya merie onye na-echebe Brighton Mathew Ryan na ọkpọ n'akụkụ aka nri nke net.
rows.reference: Nwa Bekee ahụ jiri mmetụ izizi ya n’ime bọksị ahụ iji nyeghachi Aguero bọọlụ ahụ, onye nke ji akpụkpụ ụkwụ akanri ya iji gafere kipa Brighton bụ Mathew Ryan site na iji otu ọgbụgba gara n’akụkụ akanri nke net ahụ.

rows.source: "Aguero is struggling with some problems in his feet," City manager Pep Guardiola told reporters.
rows.output: "Aguero na-agbasi mbọ ike na nsogbu ụfọdụ n'ụkwụ ya," onye njikwa obodo Pep Guardiola gwara ndị nta akụkọ.
rows.reference: “Aguero nwere ụfọdụ nsogbu n’ụkwụ ya,” Onye njikwa City Pep Guardiola gwara ndị nta akụkọ.

rows.source: "We spoke about him playing 55, 60 minutes.
rows.output: "Anyị kwuru maka ya na-awụlikwa elu nkeji iri ise na ise, iri isii.
rows.reference: “Anyị kwuru maka ya ịgba ya nkeji 55, 60.

rows.source: That's what happened.
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere.

rows.source: We were lucky he scored a goal in that moment."
rows.output: Anyị nwere chioma na ọ gbara goolu n'oge ahụ."
rows.reference: Anyị nwere ihu ọma na ọ nyere goolu ahụ n’oge ahụ.”

rows.source: But it was Sterling who gave the Sky Blues the initial advantage in the Premier League scuffle.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ Sterling nyere Sky Blues uru mbụ na asọmpi Premier League.
rows.reference: Mana ọ bụ Sterling bụ onye nyere Sky Blues uru izizi na asọmpi Premier League.

rows.source: That goal came in the 29th minute.
rows.output: Ebum n'ụzọ ahụ bịarutere n'ime nkeji iri abụọ na itoolu.
rows.reference: Goolu ahụ bịara na nkeji 29.

rows.source: Aguero received the ball deep in Brighton territory on that play.
rows.output: Aguero nwetara bọọl ahụ n'ime mpaghara Brighton na egwuregwu ahụ.
rows.reference: Aguero nwetara bọọlụ n’ime ogige Brighton n’egwuregwu ahụ.

rows.source: He sent a beautiful through ball along the left flank to Leroy Sane.
rows.output: O zipụrụ bọọlụ mara mma n'akụkụ ekpe gaa Leroy Sane.
rows.reference: O zigara ọmarịcha bọọlụ n’akụkụ akaekpe gakwuru Leroy Sane.

rows.source: Sane took a few touches before leading Sterling toward the far post.
rows.output: Sane were obere ntụgharị tupu ọ durụ Sterling gaa n'akụkụ dị anya.
rows.reference: Sane metụrụ ya ole ma ole tupu o duru Sterling gaa n’isi post ahụ.

rows.source: The Sky Blues forward tapped the ball into the net just before sliding out of bounds.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe n'ihu Sky Blues kụrụ bọọlụ ahụ n'ime net tupu ọ pụọ n'oghere.
rows.reference: Onye ihu Sky Blues ahụ kụbanyere bọọlụ ahụ n’ime net tupu ọ mịpụ n’ogige atọrọ.

rows.source: City battles Hoffenheim in Champions League group play at 12:55 p.m. on Tuesday at Rhein-Neckar-Arena in Sinsheim, Germany.
rows.output: Ndị otu obodo na-agba Hoffenheim n'asọmpi Champions League na otu egwuregwu na 12:55 p.m. na Tuzdee na Rhein-Neckar-Arena dị na Sinsheim, Germany.
rows.reference: City ga-ezute Hoffenheim n’ọkwa izizi nke Champions League na 12:55 ehihie, na Tusde na Rhein-Neckar-Arena dị na Sinsheim, Germany.

rows.source: Scherzer wants to play spoiler vs. Rockies
rows.output: Scherzer chọrọ ịkpọasị vs. Rockies
rows.reference: Scherzer chọrọ izute spoiler vs. Rockies

rows.source: With the Nationals eliminated from playoff contention, there wasn't much reason to force another start.
rows.output: N'ime ndị Nationals kwụsịrị n'ịchọ ọkwa, ọ dịghị ihe mere e ji mee ka ọzụzụ ọzọ dị.
rows.reference: Ka ewepuru Nationals na asọmpi onye mmeri, enweghịzị ihe ga-eme iji kwanye mbido ọzọ.

rows.source: But the ever-competitive Scherzer hopes to take the mound on Sunday against the Colorado Rockies, but only if there are still playoff implications for the Rockies, who hold a one-game lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL West.
rows.output: Ma onye na-asọ mpi mgbe niile Scherzer na-atụ anya ịbata n'ámá n'ụbọchị Sọnde megide ndị Colorado Rockies, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ka nwere ihe gbasara asọmpi.
rows.reference: Mana onye nnukwu asọmpi Scherzer na atụ anya irigo akwa na Sọnde n’egwuregwu yana Colorado Rockies, mana naanị ma ọ bụrụ na enwere ndapụta egwuregwu onye mmeri maka Rockies, ndị ji otu mmeri egwuregwu n’elu Los Angeles Dodgers na NL West.

rows.source: The Rockies clinched at least a wild-card spot with a 5-2 win over the Nationals on Friday night, but are still looking to lock up their first division title.
rows.output: Ndị Rockies nwetara ebe na-enweghị isi na mmeri 5-2 ha meriri ndị Nationals n'abalị Fraịde, mana ha ka na-achọ ijide aha nke mbụ ha.
rows.reference: Rochies ritere opekata mpe ohere kaadị nhọrọ site na iji mmeri 5-2 n’elu Nationals n’abalị Fraịde, mana ha ka na achọ ịkwechiri iko ngalaba izizi ha.

rows.source: "Even though we're playing for nothing, at least we can be able to toe the rubber knowing that the atmosphere here in Denver with the crowd and the other team would be playing at probably the highest level of any point I would face this year.
rows.output: Ọbụna n'agbanyeghị na anyị na-egwu maka ihe ọ bụla, ma ọ dịkarịa ala anyị nwere ike ịmụba n'ikpere rọba na-amata na ikuku ebe a na Denver na ndị na-akwado ya na otu ndị ọzọ ga-abụ n'ogo kachasị elu nke m ga-eche ihu n'afọ a.
rows.reference: “Ọbụlagodi na anyị enweghi ihe anyị na achụ, opekata mpe anyị nwere ike igwu egwu mara na okirikiri ebe a na Denver dị n’etiti igwe mmadụ yana ndị otu ndị ọzọ ga-abụ igwu egwuregwu dị n’ọkwa kachasị n’oge ọ bụla m ga-ezute n’afọ a.

rows.source: Why wouldn't I want to compete in that?"
rows.output: Gịnị mere m ga-eji achọghị ịsọ mpi n'ime nke ahụ?"
rows.reference: Gịnị kpatara na m agaghị achọ isonye na nke ahụ?”

rows.source: The Nationals have yet to announce a starter for Sunday, but are reportedly inclined to let Scherzer pitch in such a situation.
rows.output: Ndị Nationals akwụsịbeghị onye ga-amalite na Sọnde, mana a na-ekwu na ha na-achọ ka Scherzer gbaa n'ọnọdụ dị otú ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị Nationals ka na eche ikwupute onye mbido maka Sọnde, mana ekpesara na dabere na Scherzer tinye ọnụ n’ọnọdụ ahụ.

rows.source: Scherzer, who would be making his 34th start, threw a bullpen session on Thursday and would be pitching on his normal rest Sunday.
rows.output: Scherzer, onye ga-eme egwuregwu nke iri atọ na anọ ya, tụbara nnọkọ n'ụbọchị Tọzdee, ga-azọpụta n'izu ya na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Scherzer, onye nke ga-eme mbido nke 34 ya, tinyere oge mgbatị ahụ na Tọsde, ọ ga-atụ bọọlụ na Sọnde bụ oge izu ike ya.

rows.source: The Washington right-hander is 18-7 with a 2.53 ERA and 300 strikeouts in 220 2/3 innings this season.
rows.output: Onye na-ahọpụta aka nri Washington dị afọ 18-7 na ERA 2.53 na 300 strikeouts na innings 220 2/3 n'oge a.
rows.reference: Onye akanri nke Washington bụ 18-7 nwere 2.53 ERA yana nkụpụta 300 na ịnịns 220 2/3 n’afo a.

rows.source: Trump rallies in West Virginia
rows.output: Mgbapụta Trump na West Virginia
rows.reference: Trump gbakọrọ ọhaneze na West Virginia

rows.source: The President obliquely referred to the situation surrounding his Supreme Court pick Brett Kavanaugh while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
rows.output: Onye isi ala kwuru okwu n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi banyere ọnọdụ gbara onye ọ họpụtara n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu ya bụ Brett Kavanaugh, mgbe ọ na-ekwu maka mkpa ndị Republican na-eme ntụliaka na ntuli aka etiti.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala rụtụrụ aka n’ụzọ ọzọ n’ọnọdụ ahụ metụtara nhọpụta Brett Kavanaugh maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị ebe ọ na ekwu maka mkpa nke mpụta ndị Repọblikan na ntuli aka etiti afọ.

rows.source: "All of what we've done is at stake in November.
rows.output: "Ọ bụ ihe niile anyị mere na ihe ize ndụ dị na Nọvemba.
rows.reference: “Ihe niile anyị megoro nwere ike imebisi na Nọvemba.

rows.source: Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
rows.output: Izu ise site na otu n'ime ntuli aka kachasị mkpa ná ndụ anyị.
rows.reference: Izu ise fọdụrụ tupu otu ntuli aka kachasị mkpa na ndụ anyị.

rows.source: This is one of the big, big -- I'm not running but I'm really running that's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates," he said.
rows.output: Nke a bụ otu n'ime nnukwu, nnukwu -- Anaghị m agbapụta mana m na-agba ọsọ nke ukwuu nke bụ ihe mere m ji nọrọnụ na-ebe a na-alụ ọgụ maka ndị na-azọ ọkwa dị mma," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ otu n’ime ihe ndị buru ibu, buru ibu -- anaghị m apụta mana m na apụta ya mere m ji nọrọ n’ebe niile na alụ ọgụ maka ndị ahọpụtara mara oke mma, “o kwuru.

rows.source: Trump continued, "You see this horrible, horrible radical group of Democrats, you see it happening right now.
rows.output: Trump gara n'ihu, "Ị hụrụ otu ndị Democrats a na-adịghị mma, ị hụrụ ya ugbu a.
rows.reference: Trump gara n’ihu, “Ị hụrụ otu ndị nnupu isi a jọrọ oke njọ bụ Demokrats, ị na ahụ ka ọ na eme ugbu a.

rows.source: And they're determined to take back power by using any means necessary, you see the meanness, the nastiness.
rows.output: Na ha na-eme atụmatụ iweghachite ikike site n'iji ụzọ ọ bụla dị mkpa, ị hụla obi ọjọọ, obi ọjọọ.
rows.reference: Ha gbadosiri anya ike na iweghachi ike site n’ụzọ ọ bụla enwere ike, ị hụrụ obi akpọ ha, omume ọjọọ ahụ.

rows.source: They don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over in order to get power and control, that's what they want is power and control, we're not going to give it to them."
rows.output: Ha anaghị echegbu onwe ha onye ha na-emerụ, onye ha ga-agbapụ n'ụzọ iji nweta ike na njikwa, nke bụ ihe ha chọrọ bụ ike na njikwa, anyị agaghị enye ha."
rows.reference: Ha achọghị ịma onye ha mejọrọ, onye ha ga-arị elu iji nweta ike na njikwa, nke ahụ bụ ihe ha chọrọ ike na njikwa, anyị agaghị enye ha ya.”

rows.source: Democrats, he said, are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
rows.output: Ndị Democrats, o kwuru, na-aga n'ụzọ "iguzogide na iguzo n'ụzọ."
rows.reference: Demokrats, o kwuru, nọ na njem iji “gbochie ma kwụchibido.”

rows.source: "And you see that over the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: "Ị hụla nke ahụ n'ime ụbọchị anọ gara aga," ka o kwuru, na-akpọ ndị Democrats "iwe na ihe ọjọọ na ihe ọjọọ na ihe na-adịghị mma na ihe na-adịghị mma."
rows.reference: “Ma ị hụrụ n’ofe ụbọchị anọ gara aga,” o kwuru, na akpọ ndị Demokrats “ndị iwe, obi akpọ, ndị njọ yana ndị na anaghị ekwu eziokwu.’

rows.source: He referenced Senate Judiciary Committee ranking Democratic Sen. Dianne Feinstein by name, which received loud boos from the audience.
rows.output: O kwuru okwu ndị Senate Judiciary Committee, onye isi ndị Democrats bụ Sen. Dianne Feinstein, nke nwetara ụda olu dị egwu n'ìgwé mmadụ.
rows.reference: Ọ kpọrọ aha Demokrat dị elu Ọmeiwu Dianne Feinstein nke Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu, nke nwetere nnukwu mkpu n’aka ndị igwe mmadụ ahụ.

rows.source: "Remember her answer?
rows.output: "Cheta azịza ya?
rows.reference: “Ịchetara azịza ya?

rows.source: Did you leak the document?
rows.output: Ọ̀ dị gị ka ị ga-akọwahie akwụkwọ ahụ?
rows.reference: I kpughepuru akwụkwọ ahụ?

rows.source: Uh, uh, what.
rows.output: Ee, ee, gịnị.
rows.reference: Uh, uh, gịnị.

rows.source: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: Ee, ee, m na-eche otu - nke ahụ bụ ahụmahụ dị njọ - ahụmahụ ahụ dị njọ nke m hụrụla."
rows.reference: Mba, uh mba, m chere otu - enwere ngosi ahụ jọrọ njọ - ngosi ahụ kachasị njọ m hụgoro.”

rows.source: Labour is no longer a broad church.
rows.output: Ọrụ na-adịghịzi ka ụlọ ụka dị.
rows.reference: Labour abughịzị ụka gbasara agbasa.

rows.source: It is intolerant of those who speak their minds
rows.output: Ọ na-emegide ndị na-ekwu okwu ha
rows.reference: Ọ naghị anabata ndị na ekwu uche ha

rows.source: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.
rows.output: Mgbe ndị na-eme ihe n'ụzọ dị iche iche nke Momentum nọ n'otu pati m mere ntuli aka ịkagbu m, ọ bụghị ihe ijuanya.
rows.reference: Mgbe ndị nkwụgide Momentum nọ na ndọrọndọrọ mpaghara m tụnyere aka ka adachie ọnụ m, ọ bụghị ihe ntụmadị.

rows.source: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, a bụ m nke ikpeazụ n'usoro ndị Labour MP ndị a gwara na anyị adịghị mma - niile maka ikwu echiche anyị.
rows.reference: Elee anya, abụ onye nke kachasị ọhụrụ n’ahịrị nke MP ndị Labour agwara na anabataghị - naanị maka ikwu uche anyị.

rows.source: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.
rows.output: Onye omeiwu mụ na Joan Ryan nwetara otu ọgwụgwọ ahụ n'ihi na ọ na-emegide ịkpọasị ndị Juu.
rows.reference: Ka onye otu m na nzụkọ ọmeiwu Joan Ryan nwetara otu omume ahụ n’ihi na ọ kwụdosiri ike n’ịjụ semitism.

rows.source: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.output: N'okwu m, ihe ngabiga ahụ katara m maka ịghọta Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke m, ntimiwu mgbochi ahụ katọrọ m maka ịjụ Jeremy Corbyn.

rows.source: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.
rows.output: N'ihe gbasara amụma akụ na ụba na-ahụ maka ya, n'ihe gbasara nchekwa mba, n'ihe gbasara Europe, n'ụzọ dị iche iche, okwu ndị Jeremy na-emegide ndị isi gara aga.
rows.reference: Na mkpa nke iwu akụnụba obodo ziri ezi, nche obodo, yana Europe, n’ụzọ ọzọ otu nsogbu ndị Jeremy jiri na ekwenyeghị na ndị isi gara aga.

rows.source: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."
rows.output: Nkwupụta maka nzukọ Labour Nottingham East na Fraịde kwuru na "anyị chọrọ ka nzukọ ahụ bụrụ ndị gụnyere na ndị na-emepụta ihe."
rows.reference: Ọkwa maka nzụkọ Nottingham East Labour na Fraịde kwuru na “anyị chọrọ nzụkọ ndị ahụ bụrụ nke dum ma mịpụta mkpụrụ.”

rows.source: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.
rows.output: N'ime afọ asatọ m dị ka onye nnọchi anya Labour na mpaghara, nzukọ GC nke abalị Fraịde na-adịkarị ka nke ahụ.
rows.reference: N’imirikiti afọ asatọ m ka MP Labour mpaghara ahụ, abalị Fraịde nzụkọ GC na abụkarị nke ahụ.

rows.source: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị mwute, taa, ọ bụghị ụda nke ọtụtụ nzukọ na nkwa nke "kọwesịrị, dị nwayọọ" ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị agafeela ogologo oge ma ọ bụrụ na ọ malitere.
rows.reference: Na mwute taa, ọ bụghị olu nke imirikiti nzụkọ yana ndọrọndọrọ “obi ọma, ume ala” ekwere na nkwa bụ ihe ndị echefugoro kemgbe ma ọ bụrụ, n’ezie, o bidoro ma ncha.

rows.source: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.
rows.output: Ọ na-adịwanye ka ọ pụta ìhè na echiche dị iche iche adịghị anabatakari na pati Labour, na a na-enyocha echiche ọ bụla dabere na ma ọ̀ dị mma maka ndị isi pati.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ihe pụtara ihie nke ukwuu na anaghị anabata nghọta dị iche iche na ndọrọndọrọ Labour, ọzọkwa a na ekpezi echiche ọ bụla ma a ga-anabata ya n’ọchịchị ndọrọndọrọ ahụ.

rows.source: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.
rows.output: Nke a malitere obere oge ka Jeremy ghọrọ onye ndu, dịka ndị ọrụ ibe m ndị m chere na m nwere echiche ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị yiri nke ha malitere ịtụnanya m ime mgbanwe U-igodo wee were ọnọdụ ndị m ga-ajụ ka m mee - ma ọ bụ gbasara nchekwa mba ma ọ bụ ahịa otu Europe.
rows.reference: Nke a bidoro ozugbo Jeremy bụrụ onye isi, ndị ọrụ ibe m, ndị m chere na mụ na ha na ekekọrịta otu nghọta ndọrọndọrọ bidoro tụba anya na m ga-atụgharị ozugbo ma were ọnọdụ ndị m ga-agaghị ekwekọrịta na ya otu ọ bụla - ma ọ bụ na nchedo obodo ma ọ bụ otu ahịa EU.

rows.source: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.
rows.output: Mgbe ọ bụla m na-ekwu okwu n'ihu ọha - ọ bụghị ihe ọ bụla m na-ekwu - na-esochi ya na a na-akparị m n'etiti ndị mmadụ na-akparị m, na-ekwu na m kwesịrị ịhapụ pati Labour.
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ bụla m kwuru okwu n’ọhaneze - ọ gaghị agbasata ihe m kwuru - a na enwe nkwụtọ dị ukwuu na esote ozugbo n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze na akpọ maka mwepu, nkatọ ndọrọndọrọ nke etiti, na agwa m na m ekwesịghị ịnọ na ndọrọndọrọ Labour.

rows.source: And that is not just my experience.
rows.output: Na nke ahụ abụghị naanị ahụmahụ m.
rows.reference: Ma nke a abụghị naanị m.

rows.source: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.
rows.output: N'ezie, amaara m na m nwere chioma karịa ụfọdụ ndị ọrụ ibe m, n'ihi na okwu ndị e kwuru m na-emekarị gbasara ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị.
rows.reference: N’ezie, ama m na m ka nwee ihu ọma karịa ụfọdụ ndị ọrụ ibe m n’ihi asịsa ndị ezitere m na abụkarị maka ndọrọndọrọ.

rows.source: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.
rows.output: Ana m ejighị n'aka na nka na mkpebi siri ike nke ndị ọrụ ibe m na-eche ihu na iyi egwu nke ịkpa ókè nwoke na nwanyị ma ọ bụ agbụrụ kwa ụbọchị ma ha anaghị echegbu onwe ha.
rows.reference: Enwere m ntụmanya n’arụmọrụ na mkpebi nke ndị ọrụ ibe m ndị ahụ na enweta nkatọ okike mmadụ ma ọ bụ agbụrụ ya kwa ụbọchị mana ha anaghị agba ọsọ.

rows.source: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.
rows.output: Otu n'ime ihe ndị kasị na-ewute nke oge a nke ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị bụ otú ọkachamara na-ewute ndị mmadụ si bụrụ ihe a na-anabata.
rows.reference: Otu n’ime akụkụ kachasị ada mmụọ nke oge ndọrọndọrọ a bụ otu okwu nkatọ ndị jọrọ njọ si buru ihe nkịtị.

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.
rows.output: Jeremy Corbyn kwuru izu ole na ole gara aga na pati Labour kwesịrị ịkwalite omenala nke ndị na-anabata ibe ha.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn na arịọ n’izu gara aga na ndọrọndọrọ Labour kwesịrị ịmụta omume nke ndidi.

rows.source: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.
rows.output: Ihe e si na ya bụ na anyị aghọọla ụlọ ụka dị warara ma na ọ bụla "enweghị ntụkwasị obi" votu ma ọ bụ mgbanwe nke nhọrọ, otu ahụ na-erughị ala.
rows.reference: Eziokwu bụ na anyị abụghịzị ụka ahụ gbasara agbasa, kwa ụkpụrụ “enweghị ntụkwasị obi” ọ bụla ma ọ bụ mgbanwe nke iwu nhọrọ, ndọrọndọrọ ahụ na akpụkọkwa akpụkọ.

rows.source: I have had lots of advice over the past two years urging me to keep my head down, not to be so vocal and then I would "be all right."
rows.output: N'ime afọ abụọ gara aga, enwere m ọtụtụ ndụmọdụ na-agwa m ka m na-ekpuchi isi m, ka m ghara ikwupụta onwe m nke ukwuu, na mgbe ahụ, a ga m "adị mma."
rows.reference: Enwere m ọtụtụ ndụmọdụ n’ofe afọ abụọ gara aga na agwa m ka m owe isi n’ala, ịhapụ ikwu oke okwu mgbe ahụ ‘m agaghị enwe nsogbu.”

rows.source: But that is not what I came into politics to do.
rows.output: Mana nke ahụ abụghị ihe m banyere ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị.
rows.reference: Mana nke ahụ abụghị ihe m banyere ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị ịme.

rows.source: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.
rows.output: N'ime afọ 32 gara aga, mgbe m sonyere na Labour dị ka nwa akwụkwọ ụlọ akwụkwọ, nke ihe mere gọọmentị Thatcher mere nke na-eleghara ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị m anya nke mere ka klaasị m daa n'ala, m na-achọsi ike ịkwadebe ọrụ ọha ka mma maka ndị chọrọ ha nke ukwuu - ma ọ bụ dị ka onye kansụl obodo ma ọ bụ onye minista gọọmentị.
rows.reference: Kemgbe m sonyere Labour afọ 32 ka nwa akwụkwọ, nke nlegharị anya gọọmentị Thatcher kpalitere, nke hapụrụ ime ụlọ akwụkwọ m na nnukwu mmebi, achọrọ m na mbụ idu ọrụ mara mma nke ọhaneze maka ndị kachasị chọọ ha - ma abụ m onye ndu obere mpaghara ma ọ bụ minista gọọmentị.

rows.source: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.
rows.output: Anaghị m echebe ihe gbasara ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị m, gụnyere na ntuli aka ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Ezobeghị m ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị m na mbụ, gụnyere ntuli aka ikpeazụ.

rows.source: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị onye n'ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ Nottingham nwere ike ịghọta n'ụzọ ọ bụla na atụmatụ m na ebe m na-emegide ndị isi ugbu a.
rows.reference: Ọnweghị onye ọ bụla nọ na Nottingham East ga-enwe mgbagwoju anya gbasara ọnọdụ iwu m yana mpaghara ndị mụ ekwenyeghị n’ọchịchị dị ugbu a.

rows.source: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.
rows.output: N'ime ndị na-akwado mmegharị ahụ na Fraịde, ihe niile m ga-ekwu bụ na mgbe obodo ahụ na-arụ ọrụ n'ụzọ Brexit ga-emerụ ụlọ, azụmahịa na ọrụ ọha, amaghị m ihe kpatara ị chọrọ iji oge na ike na-azọpụta iguzosi ike n'ihe nye onye isi otu Labour.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ahụ kwadoro ụkpụrụ ahụ na Fraịde, ihe niile m nwere ike ikwu bụ na mgbe obodo na aga ịnwe Brexit ga-enwe mmetụta adịghị mma n’ọtụtụ ezinụlọ, azụmahịa na ọrụ ọhaneze anyị, aghọtaghị m agụụ iji gbuo oge na ike maka nkwado m na ndị isi ndọrọndọrọ Labour.

rows.source: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.
rows.output: Mana nke ukwuu ozi m bụ na Nottingham Momentum, ọ bụ nye ndị na-ahụ maka m, ma ndị Labour ma ọ bụ na ọ bụghị: Obi dị m ụtọ na m na-eje ozi gị ma na-ekwe nkwa na ọ dịghị ihe ga-egbochi m ime ihe m chere na ọ bụ ihe kacha mma maka gị niile.
rows.reference: Mana n’eziokwu otu ozi m nwere abụghị maka Nottingham Momentum, ọ bụ maka ndị mmebe m, ma ọ bụ ndị otu Labour ma ha abụghị: Enwere m afọ ojuju ijere unu ozi ma na ekwe nkwa na ọnweghị ihe egwu mwepu ole ma ọ bụ ngwangwa ndọrọndọrọ ga-akwụsị m ịme ihe m kwere kachasị dịịrị unu niile mma.

rows.source: Chris Leslie is MP for Nottingham East
rows.output: Chris Leslie bụ onye omeiwu maka Nottingham East
rows.reference: Chris Leslie bụ MP maka Nottingham East

rows.source: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Unbeaten Ayr go top
rows.output: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr na-aga n'ihu na-enweghị mmeri
rows.reference: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr na ahụbeghị ọdịda agaala n’isi

rows.source: Two late tries may have skewed the final result somewhat, but there is no doubt Ayr deserved to triumph in this wonderfully-entertaining Tennent's Premiership match of the day.
rows.output: Mgbalị abụọ nke oge ikpeazụ nwere ike ime ka nsonaazụ ikpeazụ dị ntakịrị, ma enweghị obi abụọ na Ayr kwesịrị imeri n'asọmpi Tennent's Premiership nke mara mma nke ụbọchị.
rows.reference: Ọnwụnwa abụọ na abịaghị n’oge emebiela nsonaazụ ikpeazụ obere, mana enweghị mgbagha na Ayr kwesịrị imeri na asọmpi nke taa Tennent’s Premiership a tọrọ oke ụtọ.

rows.source: They now top the table, the only unbeaten side of the ten.
rows.output: Ha na-edobe tebụl ahụ ugbu a, naanị otu na-enweghị mmeri n'ime iri.
rows.reference: Ugbu a ha nọ n’isi tebul, naanị otu ndị emeribeghị n’asọmpi iri.

rows.source: In the end, it was their superior defence, as much as their better chance-taking, which carried the home side and coach Peter Murchie had every right to be pleased.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, ọ bụ nchekwa ha ka mma, dị ka ohere ha na-ewere, nke mere ka ndị otu ahụ na onye nchịkwa Peter Murchie nwee ihe mere ha ga-eju afọ.
rows.reference: Na ngwụcha, ọ bụ difensị ha ka sie ike, yanakwa iwere ohere ha ka mma, nke burulu ndị ahụ nọ n’ụlọ, yana onye ndu Peter Murchie nwere ikike niile ịnwe obi ụtọ.

rows.source: "We've been tested over our games this far, and we're still unbeaten, so I have to be happy," he said.
rows.output: "Anyị enwetala ule n'ihe omume anyị ruo ugbu a, anyị ka enweghị mmeri, ya mere, a ga m enwe obi ụtọ."
rows.reference: “Anwaala anyị n’ofe egwuregwu anyị ruo ugbu a, emeribeghị anyị, yabụ obi juru n’anụrị,” ka o kwuru.

rows.source: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."
rows.output: Robyn Christie nke Melrose kwuru: "Ekele nye Ayr, ha were ohere ha karịa ka anyị mere."
rows.reference: Robyn Christie nke Melrose kwuru: “Ekele dịịrị Ayr, ha were ohere ha karịa ole anyị mere.”

rows.source: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.
rows.output: N'ime nkeji iri na anọ, Grant Anderson gbara ọkpọ, nke Frazier Climo gbanwere, wee mee ka Ayr nwee isi, mana kaadị edo edo maka Rory Hughes, onye Scotland, ka e wepụrụ ya n'ụzọ dị egwu, nyere Melrose ohere iji ọnụ ọgụgụ ha merie ma Jason Baggot jidere otu n'ime ya na-enweghị mgbanwe.
rows.reference: Ọnwụnwa nkeji 14 nke Grant Anderson, nke Frazier Climo mezuru n’isi, tinyere Ayr n’ihu, enyere kaadị edo-edo maka onye isi Scotland Rory Hughes, nke ndị Warriors hapụrụ maka egwuregwu ahụ, nyere Melrose ohere ịme ka ọnụọgụ nyere ha aka, ma Jason Baggot nwetere ọnwụnwa emezughi n’isi.

rows.source: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.
rows.output: Climo gbatịpụrụ Ayr lead with a penalty, tupu, n'otu oge na ọkara oge, ọ gbatịpụrụ wee gbanwee otu ọkpọ ya ka ọ bụrụ 17-5 maka Ayr n'oge ezumike.
rows.reference: Climo dọtịrị ndu Ayr ahụ site na iji penalti, tupu, ozugbo n’ọkara oge, ọ nyere goolu wee mezuo ọnwụnwa naanị ya iji mee ya 17-5 nke Ayr na nkejioge.

rows.source: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.
rows.output: Ma Melrose malitere ọkara nke abụọ nke ọma ma ọ bụrụpụta ihe mgbaru ọsọ nke Patrick Anderson, nke Baggot gbanwere, belatara oghere ahụ ruo isi ise.
rows.reference: Mana Melrose bidoro agba nke abụọ nke ọma yanakwa ọnwụnwa Patrick Anderson, nke Bagoot mezuru n’isi, belatara oghere ahụ ka ọ bụrụ akara ise.

rows.source: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.
rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, e nwere ogologo oge maka mmerụ ahụ siri ike nye Ruaridh Knott, onye e bugara n'ụgbọala, na site na mmalite ọzọ, Ayr gara n'ihu n'ihu site na Stafford McDowall, nke Climo gbanwere.
rows.reference: Enwere nnukwu ogbugbu oge maka nnukwu mmerụ ahụ Ruaridh Knott nwetara, onye nke ebupuru, na mmalitegharị, Ayr gatere aka site na ọnwụnwa Stafford McDowall, nke Climo mezuru n’isi.

rows.source: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.
rows.output: Onye isi ndị otu Ayr, Blair Macpherson, ka a na-acha odo odo, na Melrose ji onye ọzọ mee ihe, na Bruce Colvine nwaa, na njedebe nke oge nke nrụgide siri ike.
rows.reference: Osote kaptịn Ayr bụ Blair Macpherson nwetara kaadị edo-edo, ọzọkwa, Melrose mekwara ka nwoke ọzọ baa uru site na ọnwụnwa Bruce Colvine emezughi, na ngwụcha nke oge nnukwu ọkụ ahụ.

rows.source: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.
rows.output: Ndị otu nọ n'ụlọ lọghachiri azụ, ma mgbe a na-ata Struan Hutchinson ka ọ na-ata Climo na-enweghị bọọlụ, site na ahịrị ntụgharị ntụgharị, MacPherson metụrụ aka n'azụ ndị Ayr na-awakpo.
rows.reference: Otu ahụ nọ n’ụlọ laghachitere, kaosiladị, mgbe enyere Struan Hutchinson kaadị edo-edo maka ịgba Climo ụkwụ onye na ejighi bọọlụ, na mpụga nke ahịrị penalti, MacPherson daturu n’azụ nke nsogbu Ayr na abịa ihu.

rows.source: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.
rows.output: Climo gbanwere, dị ka o mere ọzọ n'ụzọ dị iche iche site na mmalite, mgbe Kyle Rowe gbakọrọ David Armstrong's box kick na izipu flanker Gregor Henry pụọ ​​n'aka otu n'ime ihe ise nke ha.
rows.reference: Climo gbanyere ya, dị ka ọ mechara ntakịrị ọzọ na mbidogharị, ka Kyle Rowe jidere ọgbụgba n’ime bọksị nke David Armstrong wee zipu onye nke akụkụ Gregor Henry maka ọnwụnwa nke ise nke otu ahụ nọ n’ụlọ.

rows.source: Still Game star looks set for new career in restaurant industry
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri Still Game na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ ga-enwe ọrụ ọhụrụ na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ
rows.reference: Onye nke Still Game ama ama chọrọ ọrụ ọhụrụ n’ụlọ ọrụ oriri na ọṅụṅụ

rows.source: Still Game star Ford Kieran looks set to move into the hospitality industry after it was discovered he's been named as the director of a licensed restaurants company.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri Ford Kieran nke Still Game yiri ka ọ ga-aga n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ mgbe achọpụtawara na a kpọrọ ya onye isi ụlọ ọrụ ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ nwere ikike.
rows.reference: Onye nke Still Game ama ama bụ Ford Kieran chọrọ ịbanye n’ụlọ ọrụ nlekọta ka achọpụtachara na akpọọla ya ka onye nduzi nke ụlọ ọrụ oriri na ọṅụṅụ enyere ikikere.

rows.source: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri dị afọ 56 na-arụ ọrụ Jack Jarvis na ihe nkiri BBC a ma ama, nke ọ na-ede ma na-eme ihe na onye na-eme ihe nkiri na onye na-eme ihe nkiri ogologo oge Greg Hemphill.
rows.reference: Onye afọ 56 ahụ mere Jack Darvis n’ihe ngosi BBC ama ama, nke ọ dere ma sonyere onye mmekọ ihe ọchị bụ Greg Hemphill.

rows.source: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.
rows.output: Ndị duo ahụ ekwupụtala na usoro nke itoolu na-abịa ga-abụ nke ikpeazụ na ihe ngosi ahụ, ọ dị ka Kiernan na-eme atụmatụ maka ndụ mgbe Craiglang gasịrị.
rows.reference: Mmadụ abụọ ahụ ekwuputela na nsotanso nke itoolu na abịa ga-abụ nke ikpeazụ n’usoro ihe ngosi ahụ, ọ pụtara na Kiernan na ahazi maka ndụ mgbe Craiglang bịara na njedebe.

rows.source: According to official record listings, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.output: Dị ka ndekọ gọọmentị si kwuo, ọ bụ onye isi oche nke Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndepụta ndekọ ziri ezi, ọ bụ onye nduzi nke Adriftmorn Limited.

rows.source: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri jụrụ ịkọriri akụkọ ahụ, ọ bụ ezie na isi mmalite Scottish Sun tụrụ aro na Kiernan na-achọ itinye aka na azụmahịa nri na-eme nke ọma na Glasgow.
rows.reference: Omenka ahụ jụrụ ikwu okwu maka akụkọ ahụ, agbanyeghị onye isi akụkọ Scottish Sun tụnyere na Kiernan na achọ isonye “n’azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ nke Glasgow na eme nke ọma.”

rows.source: 'The sea is ours': landlocked Bolivia hopes court will reopen path to Pacific
rows.output: "Oké osimiri bụ nke anyị": Bolivia na-enweghị nkwu na-atụ anya na ụlọikpe ga-emepe ụzọ ọzọ gaa n'Oké Osimiri Pacific
rows.reference: “Osimiri ahụ bụ nke anyị’: Bolivia ala gbara okirikiri na atụ anya na ụlọ ikpe ga-emepegharị ụzọ gara Pasifik

rows.source: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.
rows.output: Ndị na-anya ụgbọ mmiri na-eleta isi ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri nke nwere ụgbọ mmiri na La Paz.
rows.reference: Ndị ụgbọ mmiri na agagharị isi ụlọ ọrụ ndị agha mmiri ụgbọ juru na La Paz.

rows.source: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọha na eze na-efe ọkachamma na-acha anụnụ anụnụ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọhaneze na efegharị ọkọlọtọ nnukwu osimiri na acha agba eluigwe.

rows.source: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.
rows.output: Bases ụgbọ mmiri site na ọdọ mmiri Titicaca ruo Amazon na-ese ihe na okwu: "Oké osimiri bụ nke anyị site n'ikike.
rows.reference: Ọdụ ndị agha mmiri site na Titicaca ruo Amazon juputara na ekuku: “Osimiri ahụ bụ anyị site n’ikike.

rows.source: To recover it is a duty."
rows.output: Iji weghachi ya bụ ọrụ."
rows.reference: Iweghachite ya bụ ọrụ.”

rows.source: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.
rows.output: N'ime Bolivia nke enweghịụ mmiri, ihe ncheta nke coastline furu efu na Chile n'oge agha akụ na ụba nke narị afọ nke 19 ka dị ndụ - dị ka ọchịchọ ịkwọ ụgbọ mmiri Pacific Ocean ọzọ.
rows.reference: N’okirikiri Bolivia niile ala gbara okirikiri, ncheta nke akụkụ mmiri etufuru n’aka Chile n’esemokwu ekereụwa nke narị afọ 19 jọrọ oke njọ ka pụtara ihie - otu ahụ ka agụụ ịkwọ ụgbọ na Nnukwu Osimiri Pasifik otu ugboro ọzọ si dị.

rows.source: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.
rows.output: Ndị olileanya ndị ahụ nwere ike ịbụ nke kachasị elu n'ime afọ iri, ka Bolivia na-eche mkpebi nke ụlọ ikpe mba ụwa na 1 Ọktoba mgbe afọ ise nke nyocha gasịrị.
rows.reference: Ntụmanya ndị ahụ ikekwe kachasị ugbu a n’ime afọ iri, ka Bolivia na eche mkpebi nke ụlọ ọrụ ofesi nke akwụmọtọ na Ọktoba 1 ka afọ ise nrụrịta ụka gachara.

rows.source: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
rows.output: "Bolivia nwere momentum, mmụọ nke ịdị n'otu na udo, na n'ezie na-atụ anya ya na echiche dị mma maka nsonaazụ," ka Roberto Calzadilla, onye nnọchi anya Bolivia kwuru.
rows.reference: “Bolivia ji agbamume ugbu a, mmụọ nke ịdị n’otu na ume ala, makwa jiri nlele dị mma wee na atụ anya ndapụta ahụ,” nke Roberto Calzadilla kwuru, onye nnọchite anya nke Bolivia.

rows.source: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị Bolivia ga-eleba anya n'ikpe ICJ na nnukwu ihuenyo n'ofe mba ahụ, na-atụ anya na ụlọ ikpe dị na The Hague ga-ahụ na Bolivia nwere ikike ịkpọsa na Chile ga-akparịta ụka inye Bolivia ụzọ dị nsọ na oké osimiri.
rows.reference: Imirikiti ndị Bolivia ga-elele mkpebi ICJ n’ihuenyo buru ibu n’ofe obodo ahụ niile, na atụ anya na ụlọ ikpe ahụ dị na The Hague ga-eme nchọpụta na mmasị nke ebubo nke Bolivia na - ka ọtụtụ afọ iri nke okwu dị mma gachara - Chile nwere mmanye ịkparịta nkata na enye Bolivia ụzọ nnwere onwe gara n’osimiri.

rows.source: Evo Morales, Bolivia's charismatic indigenous president - who faces a controversial battle for re-election next year - also has plenty riding on Monday's ruling.
rows.output: Evo Morales, onye isi ala Bolivia na-adọrọ mmasị nke na-adịghị mma - onye na-eche ọgụ na-adịghị mma maka ịzọ ọkwa ọzọ n'afọ na-abịa - nwekwara ihe dị ukwuu na-emetụ na mkpebi e mere n'ụbọchị Mọnde.
rows.reference: Evo Morales, onye isi ala nke amaala Bolivia na adọrọ mmasị - onye na eche ọgụ siri ike maka nhọpụtagharị ntuli aka n’afọ na esote - nwekwara ọtụtụ ihe ọ na adabere na mkpebi nke Mọnde.

rows.source: "We are very close to returning to the Pacific Ocean," he vowed in late August.
rows.output: "Anyị dị nso n'oge ịlaghachite n'Oké Osimiri Pacific," o kwere n'oge nke 30 Ọgọst.
rows.reference: “Anyị nọ nso na ịlaghachi na Nnukwu Osimiri Pasifik,” ọ ṅwụrụ iyi na Ọgọst gara aga.

rows.source: But some analysts believe that the court is unlikely to decide in Bolivia's favour - and that little would change if it did.
rows.output: Ma ụfọdụ ndị na-enyocha ihe na-eche na ụlọikpe ahụ agaghị ekwe na Bolivia - na na ọ dịghị ihe ga-agbanwe ma ọ bụrụ na ha ekwe.
rows.reference: Mana ụfọdụ ndị nyocha kwenyere na ụlọ ikpe ahụ nwere ike ha agaghị enye mkpebi ga-amasị Bolivia - na obere ihe ga-agbanwe ma ọ bụrụ na ha mere.

rows.source: The Netherlands-based UN body has no power to award Chilean territory, and has stipulated that it will not determine the outcome of possible talks.
