rows.source: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.
rows.output: Iji hụ na ị na-ehi ụra nke ọma, nke dị mma, kwesịrị ịbụ 'ngwá agha' nke onye na-amụ ihe iji luso nrụgide, ike ọgwụgwụ na nchekasị ọgụ, ka o kwuru - ọbụna iji zere ịrụpụta ibu, ebe ịrahụ ụra na-etinyekarị ụbụrụ n'ọnọdụ agụụ, na-eme ka ha na-achọ nri mgbe nile.
rows.reference: Ịgba mbọ hụ na inwetara ụra zuru ezu, dị mma, kwesịrị ịbụ ngwa agha nwata akwụkwọ’ iji chere mgbakasị ahụ, ike ọgwụgwụ na obi mmapụ aka mgba, o kwuru - ọbụlagodi izenari ntinye ahụ, ka arahụghị ụra na-etinye ụbụrụ n’ọnọdụ oke agụụ, na-eme ha agụụ kwa mgbe.

rows.source: Raymond So, a 19-year-old Californian studying chemical and physical biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course, having taken one of his classes last year during his first year at Harvard.
rows.output: Raymond So, onye California dị afọ 19 na-amụ kemịkalụ na physics, nyere Prọfesọ Czeisler aka na imewe usoro ahụ, mgbe ọ gara otu n'ime klas ya n'afọ gara aga n'oge mbụ ya na Harvard.
rows.reference: Raymond So, nwata gbara afọ 19 nke California na-agụ kemikal na fisikal baịyọlọji nyere Ọkammụta Czeisler aka ịhazi mmụta ahụ, ebe o megoro otu klaasị ya n’afọ gara aga n’ime oge afọ izizi ya na Harvard.

rows.source: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.
rows.output: O kwuru na usoro ahụ meghere anya ya ma kpalie ya ka ọ na-agba mbọ maka usoro nke ụlọ akwụkwọ niile.
rows.reference: O kwuru na mmụta ahụ mepere anya ya wee kpalite echiche ya ịkwanye ka mmụta a bụrụ maka ụlọ akwụkwọ niile.

rows.source: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.
rows.output: Usoro ọzọ, ọ na-atụ anya, bụ ịgwa ụmụ akwụkwọ niile na-eme ihe ọmụmụ postgraduate ka ha mezue mmemme ọmụmụ yiri nke a tupu ha abanye n'ụlọ ọrụ asọmpi.
rows.reference: Nke na-esote ya, ọ na-enwe olile anya ịrịọ ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị gụchagoro mmụta izizi ka ha mejuputa mmụta yitebere nke a tupu ha abanye n’ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ.

rows.source: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.
rows.output: Dọkịta Czeisler tụrụ aro na ụmụ akwụkwọ kwesịrị ịtule anya ịtọlite ​​ụra, dị ka ịtọlite ​​oge ị ga-eteta, ma mara ihe ndị na-emerụ ahụ nke 'blue light' na-esi na ihuenyo eletrọnik na ọkụ LED, nke nwere ike ime ka oge ị na-ehi ụra gị daa, na-ebute nsogbu ịrahụ ụra.
rows.reference: Ọkammụta Czeisler kwadoro ka ụmụ akwụkwọ chee banyere itinye otimkpu maka mgbe ha chọrọ ịrahụ ụra, yana mgbe ha chọrọ ikuli, ma marakwa maka nsonazụ mmerụ ahụ ihuenyo ngwa eletrọnịk “ihie agba elu igwe” na-ebute yana ihie LED, nke nwere ike kụpụ usoro ka ahụ gị si akpa agwa, we bute nsogbu ịrahụ ụra.

rows.source: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men
rows.output: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goolụ gbawara ndị otu Gerrard
rows.reference: Livingston 1-0 Rangers: Goolu Menga buturu ndị nke Gerrard

rows.source: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers nwetara mgbaji ọzọ n'oge egwuregwu dị anya ka Dolly Menga gbara goolu, nke mere ka ndị otu Steven Gerrard na-adịghị mma daa 1-0 n'ụlọ Livingston.
rows.reference: Rangers natara ihe mgbu ka ọgbụgba Dolly Menga kwanyere akụkụ Steven Gerrard ghasara aghasa na mmeri 1-0 emeriri ha na Livingston.

rows.source: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.
rows.output: Ndị Ibrox na-achọ ime ka ha nweta mmeri mbụ ha n'okporo ụzọ kemgbe mmeri ha meriri St Johnstone 4-1 na February, ma Gary Holt's team meriri Gerrard nke abụọ ya na egwuregwu 18 dị ka onye njikwa iji hapụ ndị otu ya n'azụ ndị isi Ladbrokes Premiership, Hearts, isi asatọ.
rows.reference: Akụkụ Ibrox ahụ na-achọ inweta mmeri nke izizi ha n’ụzọ kemgbe ha meriri 4-1 na Febuarị na St Johnstone, mana ndị otu Gary Holt nyere Gerrard mmeri nke abụọ emeriri ha n’egwuregwu 18 dịka onye njikwa jiri akara asatọ esegharị n’elu nke ndị mbu na Ladbrokes Premiership, Hearts.

rows.source: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.
rows.output: Menga kụrụ nkeji iri asaa tupu oge 1/2, na ndị Rangers na-enweghị echiche na-enweghị ike ịkwatu.
rows.reference: Menga jiri tupu nkeji asaa nke ọkara oge were gbanye ọkpụ, na ndị Rangers n’enweghị mkpalite mmụọ adịghị ka ndị ga-agbanyekwa nke ha.

rows.source: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.output: Ka Rangers na-ada ala n'isi isii, Livingston na-arị elu n'isi atọ ma naanụ naanị Hibernian n'ụzọ isi.
rows.reference: Ebe ndị Rangers gbadara na ndị nke isii, Linvingston gbagoro na ndị nke atọ ma jiri ndịiche dị na goolu nọrọ naanị n’azụ Hibernian.

rows.source: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.
rows.output: Na enwere ike inwe nsogbu ọzọ maka Rangers mgbe onye na-ahụ maka ahịrị Calum Spence nwetara ọgwụgwọ maka mmerụ ahụ n'isi ya mgbe ihe yiri ka a tụbara ya site n'akụkụ dị anya.
rows.reference: Na enwere ike inwe nsogbu n’ọdịnihu maka ndị Rangers ka agwọchara onye na-akwụ n’akụkụ Calum Spencem merụ ahụ n’isi, mgbe atụchara ihe si n’akụkụ nke ndị ọbịa.

rows.source: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.
rows.output: Gerrard mere mgbanwe asatọ n'otu ndị gbara Ayr n'ime ọkara ikpeazụ nke Betfred Cup.
rows.reference: Gerrard mere mgbanwe asatọ n’akụkụ nke gbafere Ayr were banye n’agba na-esote nke ikpeazụ nke Iko Betfred.

rows.source: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.
rows.output: Holt, n'aka nke ọzọ, gara na Livi 11 nke wepụrụ otu isi na obi nke izu gara aga, ọ gaara enwe obi ụtọ na otu ya nke ọzụzụ nke ọma na-ata ahụhụ na ndị iro ha n'oge ọ bụla.
rows.reference: Holt, n’aka nke ya, jiri otu 11 Livi wee gaa, nke napụrụ ndị Hearts otu akara izu gara aga, na ọ gaara ịmasịkwa ya otu ndị nke ya gbasiri ike siri sogide ndị iro ha n’ebe niile.

rows.source: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers nwere ikeịchịkwa ihe, ma ndị Livingston mere ihe ndị ha nwere.
rows.reference: Rangers nwere ike bụrụ ndị kacha jide bọọlụ mana Livingston kacha jiri bọọlụ ha nwetere wee mere ihe.

rows.source: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.
rows.output: Ha kwesịrị ị nwetagoro goolu abụọ n'ime nkeji abụọ mgbe Menga nyere Scott Pittman oghere iji gaa n'ihu Allan McGregor, ma onye na-agba bọọlụ ahụ tụpụrụ nnukwu ohere ahụ n'ofè.
rows.reference: Ha kwesịrị iji nkeji abụọ ha jiri banye nye goolu mgbe obere ọkpụkpa izizi nke Menga mere zipuru Scott Pittman na goolu nke Allan McGrego, mana onye nke ahụ na-agba n’etiti gbafuru nnukwu oghere ya.

rows.source: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.
rows.output: Mkpọchi Keaghan Jacobs dị omimi wee chọta onye isi Craig Halkett, ma onye mmekọ ya nche Alan Lithgow nwere ike ịkwapụ n'azụ.
rows.reference: Ọgbụgba Keaghan Jacobs mere zutere onye na-eche goolu Craig Halkett mana onye mgbachibido otu ya Alan Lithgow nwere naanị ike ịgbafu ya n’azụ.

rows.source: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers nwetara njikwa mana ọ dị ka enwere olileanya karịa nkwenye gbasara egwuregwu ha na nkeji ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Rangers nwetara njikwa mana ọ dịka enwere olile anya karịa ka enwere nkwenye ka otu ha si agba na ngwucha nke atọ.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos nwere ike ịhụ na ọ kwesịrị inwe ntaramahụhụ n'oge nkeji iri na ise ka ọ na-agba ọsọ ma na-akọwa Steven Lawless, ma onye na-ahụ maka egwuregwu Steven Thomson jụrụ arịrụ ụka ya.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos chere na ọ kwesịrị ịgba penaliti n’akara nkeji iri na ise ka ya na Steven Lawless kụtara mana onye njikwa egwuregwu Steven Thomson lefere mkpesa onye Columbia ahụ anya.

rows.source: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers nwetara naanị ihe mgbaru ọsọ abụọ n'ime ọkara mbụ, mana onye bụbu onye nche Ibrox Liam Kelly nwere obere nsogbu site na isi Lassana Coulibaly na iberibe Ovie Ejaria.
rows.reference: Rangers gbalịrị naanị ịgbata na postu ugboro abụọ n’ọkara nke mbu mana onye na-echeburu ndị Ibrox goolu Liam Kelly enweghị ihe mmekpa ahụ ọ bụla na nke Lassana Coulibaly jiri isi kụọ yana ọgbụgba adaghị ụda Ovie Ejaria gbara.

rows.source: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.
rows.output: N'oge nke 34 nke Livi, onye na-eme ihe n'agbata oge, ọ dịghị onye nwere ike ịjụ na ha kwesịrị ya maka mbọ ha na-arụ naanị.
rows.reference: Ebe goolu nkeji 34th ndị Livi gbara nwere ike bụrụ ndapụta, ọ nweghị onye ga-ekwu na ọ dabarọ ha naanị maka mbọ ha gbara.

rows.source: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.
rows.output: Ozugbo Rangers enweghị ike ijikwa Jacobs set-ibe dị omimi.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa Rangers enweghị ike metụta ọkpụkpa Jacob miri emi.

rows.source: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.
rows.output: Scott Arfield emeghị ka Declan Gallagher tinyere bọọlụ ahụ n'ime Scott Robinson, onye jiri nlezianya were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were
rows.reference: Scott Arfield enweghị ihe ọ mere ka Declan Gallagher gbanyere Scott Robinson bọọlụ, bụ onye dara juu were họrọ Menga maka ịgbachapụ ya.

rows.source: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.
rows.output: Gerrard rụrụ ọrụ n'oge ezumike ka ọ gbanwee Coulibaly maka Ryan Kent na mgbanwe ahụ mere ka ọ pụta ìhè ozugbo ka onye na-agba ọsọ ahụ tinyere Morelos mana Kelly pụtaworo n'ahịrị ya iji gbochie ya.
rows.reference: Gerrard megharịrị na oge ezumike dị ka o jiri Ryan Kent gbanwee Coulibaly nke metụrụ mmetụta ozugbo, ka onye nke na-agba n’akụkụ fanyere Morelos mana Kelly na-agba nke ọma gbara ọsọ site na ebe ọ nọ bịa gbochie.

rows.source: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.
rows.output: Ma Livingston gara n'ihu na-aṅụ ndị ọbịa ahụ n'ime egwuregwu nke ụdị ha na-enwe mmasị, na Lithgow na Halkett na-eme ka bọọl ogologo ogologo.
rows.reference: Mana Livingston gara n’ihu ime ka ndị ọbịa ahụ na-agba ụdị egwuregwu na-amasị ha, ebe Lithgow na Halkett na-agba bọọlụ ote aka kwa mgbe.

rows.source: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.
rows.output: N'akụkụ Holt nwere ike ịgbatị isi ha n'oge ikpeazụ mana McGregor mere nke ọma iji gbochie Jacobs. Mgbe ahụ, Lithgow tụbara n'akụkụ.
rows.reference: Akụkụ Holt kaara ịgbatị mmeri ha n’oge ikpeazụ mana McGregor kwuchiri wee jụ Jacobs, tupu Lithgow ewere isi kụpụ bọọlụ n’akụkụ.

rows.source: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.
rows.output: Onye na-anọchi anya Rangers Glenn Middleton nwere ihe ọzọ na-ata ahụhụ n'oge na-adịghị anya tupu ọ na-akpakọrịta na Jacobs mana ọzụzụ Thomson ọzọ.
rows.reference: Onye nnọchite nke Rangers Glenn Middleton nwere mkpesa maka penaliti nke abịaghị n’oge ka ya na Jacobs kụkọrọ mana Thomson lefere anya ọzọkwa.

rows.source: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter
rows.output: Almanac: Onye chepụtara igwe na-ahụ maka Geiger
rows.reference: Almanak: Onye mepụtara ngụ Geiger

rows.source: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.
rows.output: Na ugbu a, ibé si n'ibé anyị "Sunday Morning" Almanac: Septemba 30, 1882, afọ 136 gara aga taa, na COUNTING ... ụbọchị ọmụmụ onye na-ahụ maka physics Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger na Germany.
rows.reference: N’Ugbu a otu ibe sitere na Almanak “Ụtụtụ Sọnde” anyị: Septemba 30, 1882, afọ136 gara aga taa, wee Na-agụ ... ụbọchị nke amụrụ onye nke ga-abụ onye fiziks n’ọdịnihu Johannes Wilhem “Hans” na Germany.

rows.source: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.
rows.output: Geiger mepụtara ụzọ esi achọpụta na ịtuleba radieshon, ihe eji eme ihe nke butere ngwahịa a maara dị ka Geiger Counter.
rows.reference: Geiger mepụtara ụzọ esi achọpụta ma lelee nha redioaktiviti, nchọpụta nke mechara bute ngwa a na-akpọ Ngụ Geiger.

rows.source: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:
rows.output: Otu n'ime isi ihe na-eme ka sayensị na-aga n'ihu, bụ Geiger Counter, ghọrọ ihe a ma ama n'omenala, dịka na ihe nkiri "Bells of Coronado" nke e mere na 1950, nke gosipụtara ndị na-eme ihe nkiri Roy Rogers na Dale Evans bụ ndị na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri.
rows.reference: Ebe ndabere sayensi kemgbe, Ngụ Geiger mechara bụrụkwa ndabere agbụrụ ọhụrụ, dịka n’ihe nkiri 1950 “Bells of Coronado.” ndị nọ na ya adịchaghị ka ndị nyocha sayensi na-achị ehi Roy Rogers na Dale Evans:

rows.source: Man: "What in the world is that?"
rows.output: Nwoke: "Gịnị ka ọ bụ n'ụwa?"
rows.reference: Nwoke: “Ọ gịnị n’elu ụwa nke a bụ ihe ahụ?”

rows.source: Rogers: "It's a Geiger Counter, used to locate radioactive minerals, such as uranium.
rows.output: Rogers: "Ọ bụ igwe na-ahụ maka radieshon, eji achọta ihe ndị na-eme radieshon, dị ka uranium.
rows.reference: Rogers: “Ọ bụ ihe Ngụ Geiger, ejiri achọpụta ebe ihe nnweta dị n’ala nọ dịka uranium.

rows.source: When you put these earphones on, you can actually hear the effects of the atoms given off by the radioactivity in the minerals."
rows.output: Mgbe ị na-etinye ihe ndị a na ntị, ị nwere ike ịnụ n'ezie mmetụta nke atom ndị e nyere site na radieshon na mineral.
rows.reference: Mgbe ịgbanwuru ngwa nti a, i nwere ike ịnụ nsonazụ atọm na-enye sitere na redioaktiviti dị na ihe nnweta dị n’ala.”

rows.source: Evans: "Say, it sure is popping now!"
rows.output: Evans: "Gwa, ọ na-afụ ụfụ ugbu a!"
rows.reference: Evans: “Kwuo, ọ na-eme eme ugbu a!”

rows.source: "Hans" Geiger died in 1945, just a few days short of his 63rd birthday.
rows.output: "Hans" Geiger nwụrụ na 1945, naanị ụbọchị ole na ole tupu ụbọchị ọmụmụ ya nke iri isii na atọ.
rows.reference: “Hans” Geiger nwụrụ n’afọ 1945, naanị mkpụrụ ụbọchị ole ma ole ruo ụbọchị ọmụmụ 63 ya.

rows.source: But the invention that bears his name lives on.
rows.output: Ma ihe eji mara ya ka na-adị ndụ.
rows.reference: Mana nchọpụta nke bu aha ya dịịrị gaba.

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells
rows.output: Vaccine ọrịa cancer ọhụrụ nwere ike kuziere usoro mgbarapụta ahụ ka ọ 'hụ' mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-emegide ya
rows.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ ọhụrụ nwere ike ikuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ka ọ “hụ” selụ na-emebi ihe

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells and kill them
rows.output: Vaccine ọrịa cancer ọhụrụ nwere ike kuziere usoro mgbochi ahụ ka ọ hụta mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-adịghị mma ma gbuo ha
rows.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ ọhụrụ nwere ike ikuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ka ọ “hụ” selụ na-emebi ihe ma gbuo ha

rows.source: Vaccine teaches immune system to recognise rogue cells as part of treatment
rows.output: Vaccine na-akụzi usoro mgbarịta ahụ ka ọ mata mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-adịghị mma dị ka akụkụ nke ọgwụgwọ
rows.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi na-akuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ka ọ mata selụ na-emebi ihe dịka ụzọ ọgwụgwọ ọrịa

rows.source: Method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in lab
rows.output: Usoro ahụ gụnyere ịwepụta mkpalịta ndị na-egbochi ọrịa n'aka onye ọrịa, na-agbanwe ha n'ụlọ nyocha
rows.reference: Ụzọ a tinyere ịmịpụta selụ nchekwa ahụ n’ahụ onye ọrịa, were gbanwee ya n’ụlọ nyocha

rows.source: They can then 'see' a protein common to many cancers and then reinjected
rows.output: Ha nwere ike ịhụ protein a na-ahụ n'ọtụtụ ọrịa cancer wee laghachi n'ime ya
rows.reference: Ha nwere ike ‘ịhụ’ protin na-adịkarị n’ọtụtụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ, were gbaghachi ya azụ

rows.source: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.
rows.output: Nnwale ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa na-egosi nsonaazụ dị mma n'ime ndị ọrịa nwere ụdị ọrịa cancer dị iche iche.
rows.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi eji eme nlele na-egosi ndapụta nyere afọ ojuju na ndị ọrịa nwere ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ dị iche iche.

rows.source: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.
rows.output: Nwanyị otu onye a gwọrụ ọgwụ, nke na-akụzi usoro mgbarịta ahụ ka ọ mata mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-adịghị mma, hụrụ na ọrịa cancer ovarian ya pụọla ihe karịrị ọnwa 18 na ọkara.
rows.reference: Otu nwanyị ejiri ọgwụ mgbochi ahụ were gwọ, nke na-akuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ịmata selụ na-emebi ihe, hụrụ ka ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ nke akpa akwa ya pụrụ ihe karịrị ọnwa 18.

rows.source: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.
rows.output: Usoro ahụ gụnyere ịwepụta mkpalịta ndị na-adịghị ike n'ụzọ dị mfe, na-agbanwe ha n'ụlọ nyocha ka ha wee nwee ike "hụ" protein a na-ahụkarị n'ọtụtụ ọrịa kansa a na-akpọ HER2, ma mesịa tinye ha azụ.
rows.reference: Ụzọ ahụ tinyere ịmịpụta selụ nchekwa ahụ n’ahụ onye ọrịa, were gbanwee ya n’ụlọ nyocha ka ha were ‘hụ’ protin na-adịkarị n’ọtụtụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ a na-akpọ HER2, wee gbaghachi selụ ndị ahụ azụ.

rows.source: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."
rows.output: Onye prọfesọ Jay Berzofsky, nke Ụlọ Ọrụ Cancer nke United States dị na Bethesda, Maryland, kwuru: "Nsonaazụ anyị na-atụ aro na anyị nwere ọgwụ mgbochi na-enye olileanya."
rows.reference: Ọkammụta Jay Berzofsky nke US National Cancer Institute dị na Bethesda Maryland, kwuru: “Ndapụta anyị na-egosi na anyị nwere ọgwụ mgbochi nyere afọ ojuju.”

rows.source: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.
rows.output: HER2 "na-akpalite uto nke ọtụtụ ụdị ọrịa kansa," gụnyere ọrịa ara, ovarian, ọrịa akpa ume na ọrịa colorectal, ka Prọfesọ Berzofsky kọwara.
rows.reference: HER2 ”na-akwa uto nke ọtụtụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ,” tinyere ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ nke ara, akpa akwa, ngu na ọwa nsi, Ọkammụta Berzofsky kọwara.

rows.source: A similar approach of taking immune cells out of patients and "teaching" them how to target cancer cells has worked in treating a type of leukaemia.
rows.output: Usoro yiri nke ịwepụta mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-ahọpụta ndị ọrịa na "kuziere" ha ka ha na-elekwasị anya na mkpụrụ ndụ kansa arụọla ọrụ n'ibelata otu ụdị leukemia.
rows.reference: Usoro yitebere inwepụ selụ nchekwa ahụ n’ahụ onye ọrịa were “kuziere” ha ka-esi achọpụta selụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ arụọla ọrụ n’ịgwọ otu ụdị ọrịa ụmị ọkpụkpụ.

rows.source: Kanye West Embarked on a Pro-Trump Diatribe, Wearing a MAGA Hat, After his SNL Appearance.
rows.output: Kanye West malitere nkwupụta ndị na-akwado Trump, na-eyi Hat MAGA, mgbe ọ pụtara na SNL.
rows.reference: Kanye West Gara Njem Okwu Iwe Binyere Trump, Yiri Okpu MAGA, Ka Ọ Pụtachara na SNL.

rows.source: It Didn't Go Well
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mma
rows.reference: Ọ Gaghị Nke Ọma

rows.source: Kanye West was booed in the studio during a Saturday Night Live after a rambling performance in which he praised U.S. President Donald Trump and said he would run for office in 2020.
rows.output: Kanye West bụ onye a na-akwa emo n'ụlọ ihe nkiri n'oge Saturday Night Live mgbe ihe ngosi ya na-agwụ agwụ, ebe ọ na-eto Onye isi ala United States Donald Trump ma kwuo na ya ga-azọ ọkwa n'afọ 2020.
rows.reference: Etikporo Kanye West mkpu n’ụlọ egwu ahụ n’oge Saturday Night Live ka ọ mechara ihe nkiri ọ na-atagheri ọnụ nke otoro Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump nke U.S. were kwuo na ọ ga-apụta zọọ ọkwa na 2020.

rows.source: After performing his third song of the night, called Ghost Town in which he was wearing a Make America Great cap, he went on a rant against the Democrats and reiterated his support for Trump.
rows.output: Mgbe ọ rụchara egwu nke atọ ya n'abalị ahụ, nke a na-akpọ Ghost Town, ebe ọ na-eyi Make America Great cap, ọ gara n'ihu na-akatọ ndị Democrats ma mesie nkwado ya maka Trump.
rows.reference: Ka ọ gụchara egwu nke atọ ya n’abalị ahụ, akpọrọ Ghost Town nke oyi okpu Make America Great, ọ gara n’ihu ikwutọ ndị Demokrat were kwuputakwa nkwado ya maka Trump.

rows.source: "So many times I talk to a white person and they say: "How could you like Trump, he's racist?"
rows.output: "Ọtụtụ ugboro ana m agakwuru onye ọcha ma ha na-ekwu: "Olee otú ị ga-esi masị Trump, ọ bụ onye na-emegbu mmadụ?"
rows.reference: “Ọtụtụ oge m na onye ọcha kparịtara ụka, ha ekwuo: “Kedu ka isi nwee mmasị na Trump, ọ bụ onye kpọrọ onye isi ojii asị?”

rows.source: Well, if I was concerned about racism I would've moved out of America a long time ago," he said.
rows.output: Ọ dị mma, ọ bụrụ na m na-echegbu onwe m banyere ịkpa ókè agbụrụ, agagharịla m America ogologo oge gara aga," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: N’ezie, ọ bụrụ na omume ịkpọ onye isi ojii asị na-emetụta m, agaara m apụ na America kemgbe.” o kwuru.

rows.source: SNL started the show with a skit starring Matt Damon in which the Hollywood star made fun of Brett Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judicial Committee on sexual assault claims made by Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: SNL malitere ihe ngosi ahụ na ihe nkiri nke Matt Damon, bụ́ nke kpọrụ Brett Kavanaugh n'ihu kọmitii ikpe ikpe nke Senate na ebubo nke mmehie mmekọahụ nke Christine Blasey Ford mere.
rows.reference: SNL jiri obere ihe ịkpa ọchị wee malite ihe nkiri ahụ nwere Matt Damon, ebe onye ama ama nke Hollywood ahụ mere akaja nkwuputa Brett Kavanaugh n’ihu Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe nke Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu maka ebubo mwakpo nwanyị Christine Blasey Ford boro ya.

rows.source: Although it was not broadcast, the footage of West's rant was uploaded to social media by comedian Chris Rock.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na a n'ebubeghi ya, ihe onyonyo nke West's rant ka etinyeghị na mgbasa ozi ọha site n'aka onye na-akpa ọchị Chris Rock.
rows.reference: N’agbanyeghị na agbasaghị ya n’ikuku, onye mkpa ọchị Chris Rock bugoro ihe nkiri okwu iwe West ahụ na ụzọ mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta ọha.

rows.source: It is unclear if Rock was trying to mock West with the posting.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị ka Rock na-agbalị ịkpọasị West na mgbasa ozi ahụ.
rows.reference: O doghị anya ma Rock ọ chọrọ ime West akaja site na mbusa ozi ahụ.

rows.source: Also, West had complained to the audience that he had got a hard time backstage about his head wear.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, West mere mkpesa nye ndị na-ege ntị na ọ nwere oge siri ike n'azụ ihe nkiri gbasara uwe isi ya.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa, West kpesara ndị n’elele ihe nkiri ahụ na emechuru ya ihu n’azụ ụlọ banyere okpu isi ya.

rows.source: "They bullied me backstage.
rows.output: Ha gburu m n'azụ ụlọ ihe nkiri.
rows.reference: “Ha gwara okwu m ọjọọ n’azụ ụlọ.

rows.source: They said, 'don't go out there with that hat on.'
rows.output: Ha kwuru, 'agaghi esi n'ebe ahụ pụta na okpu ahụ.'
rows.reference: Ha sịrị, ‘eyikwala okpu ahụ were pụọ ebe ahụ.’

rows.source: They bullied me!
rows.output: Ha gburu m!
rows.reference: Ha gwara m okwu ọjọọ!

rows.source: And then they say I'm in a sunken place," he said, according to the Washington Examiner.
rows.output: Ọzụzụ, ha na-ekwu na m nọ n'ebe dị ala, "ka o kwuru, dị ka Washington Examiner si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ha wee kwukwa ọzọ, na m nọ n’ime ebe omimi.” o kwuru, dabere na Washington Examiner.

rows.source: West went on: "You wanna see the sunken place?" saying that he would "put my superman cape on, because this means you can't tell me what to do. You want the world to move forward?
rows.output: West gara n'ihu: "Ị chọrọ ịhụ ebe a na-efunarị?" na-ekwu na ya ga "tinye uwe m nke superman, n'ihi na nke a pụtara na ị gaghị enwe ike ịgwa m ihe m ga-eme. Ị chọrọ ka ụwa gaa n'ihu?
rows.reference: West gara n’ihu. “Ị chọrọ ịhụ ebe ihe omimi ahụ?” na-ekwu na ya ga-eyibe uwe superman ya, nke pụtara na ịgaghị agwa m ihe m ga-eme. Ị chọrọ ka ụwa gaa n’ihu?

rows.source: Try love."
rows.output: Gbalịa ịhụnanya."
rows.reference: Nwalee ịhụnanya.”

rows.source: His comments drew boos at least twice from the audience and SNL cast members appeared to be embarrassed, Variety reported, with one person there telling the publication: "The entire studio fell dead silent."
rows.output: Nkwupụta ya mere ka ndị na-ege ntị na-akwa ákwá ma ọ dịkarịa ala ugboro abụọ, ndị otu SNL yikwara ka ha na-ewute, dị ka Variety si kwuo, otu onye nọ ebe ahụ gwara akwụkwọ akụkọ ahụ: "Ụlọ ihe nkiri ahụ dara jụụ kpamkpam."
rows.reference: Okwu ya kpalitere mkpu site na ndị n’elele ihe nkiri ahụ opekempe ugboro abụọ na ndị ọrụ SNL mere ka ndị emechuru ihu, Variety na-ekwu, nke otu onye na-agwa akwụkwọ ozi ahụ: “Ụlọ egwu ahụ niile dara juu.”

rows.source: West had been brought in as a late replacement for singer Ariana Grande, whose former boyfriend, the rapper Mac Miller had died a few days ago.
rows.output: Ọwụwa e wetere n'ime oge dị ka onye nnọchi anya onye na-abụ abụ Ariana Grande, onye bụ enyi ya na onye rapper Mac Miller nwụrụ ụbọchị ole na ole gara aga.
rows.reference: Ewebatara West dịka onye nnọchi anya onye ọgụ egwu Ariana Grande n’oge ikpeazụ, bụ onye nke enyi ya nwoke na mbu, na-akụ egwu rap Mac Miller nwụrụ na mkpụrụ ụbọchị ole ma ole gara aga.

rows.source: West puzzled many with a performance of the song I Love it, dressed as a Perrier Bottle.
rows.output: Ọdịda Anyanwụ tụrụ ọtụtụ mmadụ n'anya na ihe ngosi nke abụ ahụ, M hụrụ ya n'anya, yi uwe dị ka karama Perrier.

rows.reference: West nwetara nkwado site na onye isi otu TPUSA, Candace Turner, bụ onye nke dere na twitter: “Maka otu n’ime ndị nwere mmụọ siri ike: DAALỤ MAKA ỊKWỤGIDE N’IHU NDỊ IGWE MMADỤ.”

rows.source: But talk show host Karen Hunter tweeted that West was simply "being who he is and that's absolutely wonderful."
rows.output: Ma onye na-eme ihe ngosi okwu Karen Hunter tweeted na West bụ naanị "ịbụ onye ọ bụ na nke ahụ bụ ihe magburu onwe ya."
rows.reference: Mana onye nchịkọba ihe nkiri okwu Karen Hunter dere na twitter na West naanị “bụ onye ọ bụ, na nke a bụ ihe mara oke mma.”

rows.source: "But I chose NOT to reward someone (by purchasing his music or clothing or supporting his "art") who I believe is embracing and spewing ideology that is harmful to my community.
rows.output: "Ma mụ na-ahọrọghị inye onye (site n'ịzụta egwu ya ma ọ bụ uwe ya ma ọ bụ ịkwado "nka" ya) bụ onye m kwenyere na ọ na-anabata na ịgbasa echiche na-emerụ obodo m.
rows.reference: “Mana A họrọ m na m “AGAGHỊ” enye mmadụ elele (site na ịzụ egwu ya ma ọ bụ uwe ya ma ọ bụ kwado “nka” ya} bụ Onye nke m kwenyere na ọ na-amakọ ma na-ekwuputa nkwenye dị mmerụ ahụ n’obodo.

rows.source: He is free.
rows.output: Ọ dị nnọọ mma.
rows.reference: Ọ nwegoro onwe ya.

rows.source: So are we," she added.
rows.output: Ya mere, anyị na-eme," ka o tinyere.
rows.reference: Yabụ ma anyị onwe anyị,” ọ gbakwunyere.

rows.source: Before the show, the rapper announced on Twitter that he had changed his name, saying that he was now "the being formally known as Kanye West."
rows.output: Tupu ihe ngosi ahụ, onye rapper ahụ kwupụtara na Twitter na ọ gbanwere aha ya, na-ekwu na ọ bụ ugbu a "ihe a na-akpọbu Kanye West."
rows.reference: Tupu ihe nkiri ahụ onye ọkụ egwu rap a, kwuputara na Twitter na ya agbanwego aha ya,na-ekwu na ọ bụ “onye nke amaara na mbu ka Kanye West.”

rows.source: He is not the first artist to change their name and follows in the footsteps of Diddy, also known as Puff Daddy, Puffy and P Diddy.
rows.output: Ọ bụghị onye na-ese ihe mbụ na-agbanwe aha ya ma soro n'ụzọ Diddy, nke a makwaara dị ka Puff Daddy, Puffy na P Diddy.
rows.reference: Ọ bụghị onye na-eme ihe egwuregwu izizi nke gbanwere aha ya, na-esonye na nzọ ụkwụ Diddy, onye amakwara ka Puff Daddy, Puffy na P.Diddy.

rows.source: Fellow rapper, Snoop Dogg has had the name Snoop Lion and of course the late music legend Prince, changed his name to a symbol and then the artist previously known as Prince.
rows.output: Onye rapper ibe ya, Snoop Dogg ejirila aha Snoop Lion, na n'ezie, onye egwu ama ama nke nwụrụ anwụ, Prince, gbanwere aha ya ka ọ bụrụ akara wee bụrụ onye na-ese ihe gara aga nke a maara dị ka Prince.
rows.reference: Onye ọkụ egwu rap ibe ya, Snoop Dogg enwela mgbe ọ zara Snoop Lion, ọzọkwa onye ọkụ egwu bụ ọkaibe Prince, gbanwere aha ya ka ọ bụrụ akara yana onye na-eme ihe egwuregwu amaburu dịka Prince.

rows.source: Attempted murder charge over Belfast restaurant stabbing
rows.output: Ntọala igbu mmadụ na Belfast
rows.reference: Ịgba akwụkwọ maka ịnwa igbu ọchụ n’ihi ịsụ mma n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ Belfast.

rows.source: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in a restaurant in east Belfast on Friday.
rows.output: Nwoke dị afọ iri anọ na ise ka a na-ebo ebubo igbu ọchụ mgbe a wụrụ otu nwoke n'ụlọ nri dị n'ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ Belfast na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Agbaala otu nwoke dị afọ 45 akwụkwọ maka ịnwa igbu ọchụ, ka asụchara otu nwoke mma n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dị na ọwụwa anyanwụ Belfast na Fraịde.

rows.source: The incident happened in Ballyhackamore, police said.
rows.output: Ihe mere n'ebe Ballyhackamore, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.
rows.reference: Ihe mmereme ahụ mere na Ballyhackamore, onye uwe ojii kwuru.

rows.source: The defendant is expected to appear before Belfast Magistrates' Court on Monday.
rows.output: A na-atụ anya na onye na-agbachitere ga-apụta n'ihu Ụlọikpe Magistrate Belfast na Mọnde.
rows.reference: A tụrụ anya na onye ahụ nke na-agọrọ onwe ya ga-abịa n’obere ụlọ ikpe Belfast na Mọnde.

rows.source: The charges will be reviewed by the Public Prosecution Service.
rows.output: A ga-enyocha ikpe ahụ site na Ụlọ Ọrụ Nchekwube Ọha.
rows.reference: Ndị Ọrụ Ịgba Akwụkwọ Ọhaneze ga-enyocha akwụkwọ ahụ agbara.

rows.source: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington hits out at toxic masculinity
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri na Game of Thrones, Kit Harington, na-akụda mmadụ ka ha ghara ịbawanye nwoke.
rows.reference: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri Game of Thrones Kit Harrington akụsuola n’ihi ọrụ dịrị nwoke dị njọ

rows.source: Kit Harington is known for his sword-swinging role as Jon Snow in HBO's violent medieval fantasy series Game of Thrones.
rows.output: A maara Kit Harington maka ọrụ ya dị ka Jon Snow na usoro ihe nkiri nke HBO, Game of Thrones, bụ nke na-eme ihe ike na akụkọ ifo nke oge ochie.
rows.reference: Ejiri ịpịa mma mara Kit Harrington dịka Jon Snow na ihe nkiri HBO Game of Thrones nwere ihe egwu nke dabere na echiche agba ochie.

rows.source: But the actor, 31, has hit out at the stereotype of the macho hero, saying such roles on screen mean young boys often feel like they have to be tough to be respected.
rows.output: Mana onye na-eme ihe nkiri ahụ, dị afọ iri atọ na otu, ekpughere ihe atụ nke di na nwunye, na-ekwu na ụdị ọrụ dị otú ahụ na ihuenyo na-eme ka ụmụ nwoke na-eto eto na-eche na ha ga-adị ike ka a na-asọpụrụ ha.
rows.reference: Mana nwoke ahụ na-eme ihe nkiri a, 31, akụsuola ejirimara enwere maka ndị dike, na-ekwu na ụdị ime ejije a n’ihuenyo pụtara na ụmụaka ndị nwoke ga-eche na ha kwesịrị isi ike tupu ha enweta nsọpụrụ.

rows.source: Speaking to The Sunday Times Culture, Kit said he believes 'something's gone wrong' and questioned how to tackle the problem of toxic masculinity in the #MeToo era.
rows.output: N'ikwurịta okwu na The Sunday Times Culture, Kit kwuru na ya kwenyere na "ihe na-emejọ" na ajụjụ ya bụ otu esi emeso nwoke na nwanyị ihe n'oge #MeToo.
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ na-agwa The Sunday Times Culture, Kit kwuru na ọ kwenyere ‘n’ihe emebiela’ wee jụọ ka a ga-esi were luso nsogbu ọrụ dịrị nwoke dị njọ ọgụ n’oge #MeToo.

rows.source: Kit, who recently married his Game of Thrones co-star Rose Leslie, also 31, admitted he feels 'quite strongly' about addressing the issue.
rows.output: Kit, onye lụrụ onye otu ya na Game of Thrones, Rose Leslie, onye dị afọ 31, kwetara na ọ na-enwe mmetụta "n'ụzọ siri ike" banyere okwu ahụ.
rows.reference: Kit, onye nke lụrụ onye ya na ya na-emekọ ihe nkiri Game of Thrones Rose Leslie, dịkwa 31, kwetara na ọ ‘na-emetụta ya nke ukwuu’ banyere ịkpatụ aka n’okwu ahụ.

rows.source: 'I feel personally, quite strongly, at the moment - where have we gone wrong with masculinity?,' he said.
rows.output: "Ọ na-adị m ka m na-enwe mmetụta nke ukwuu, n'oge a - kedu ebe anyị na-aga n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi na nwoke?," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: ‘N’onwe m, ọ na-emetụta m nke ukwuu, ugbu a - kedu ebe anyị gabigara n’ọrụ dịrị nwoke?,’ o kwuru.

rows.source: 'What have we been teaching men when they're growing up, in terms of the problem we see now?'
rows.output: 'Gịnị ka anyị na-akụzi ụmụ nwoke mgbe ha na-etolite, n'ihe gbasara nsogbu anyị na-ahụ ugbu a?'
rows.reference: ‘Kedu ihe anyị na-akuziri ụmụ-nwoke mgbe ha na-etolite etolite, n’ihe banyere nsogbu anyị na-ahụ ugbu a?’

rows.source: Kit believes television may be partly responsible for the rise in toxic masculinity thanks to its very masculine characters.
rows.output: Kit kwenyere na telivishọn nwere ike ịbụ akụkụ nke na-ahụ maka ịrị elu nke àgwà nwoke na-adịghị mma n'ihi àgwà nwoke ya nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Kit kwenyere na igwe ihe nkiri ketere obere oke maka mbawanye ọrụ dịrị nwoke dị njọ, ekele dịịrị agwa ụmụ-nwoke n’ihe nkiri.

rows.source: He continued: 'What's innate and what's taught?
rows.output: Ọ gara n'ihu: 'Gịnị ka a mụrụ ya na ihe a kụziri?
rows.reference: Ọ gara n’ihu: ‘Kedu ihe bụ ọnatarachi na nke akuziri akuzi?

rows.source: What is taught on TV, and in the streets, that makes young boys feel they have to be this certain side of being a man?
rows.output: Gịnị ka a na-akụzi n'ụlọ ihe nkiri na n'okporo ámá, nke na-eme ka ụmụ nwoke na-eto eto nwee mmetụta na ha ga-abụ akụkụ a kapịrị ọnụ nke ịbụ nwoke?
rows.reference: Kedu ihe a na-akuzi n’igwe ihe nkiri, yana n’ime ogbe na-eme ka ụmụaka ndị nwoke chee na ha kwesịrị ịdị ụdị akụkụ a na nwoke?

rows.source: I think that's really one of the big questions in our time - how do we change that?
rows.output: Echere m na nke ahụ bụ otu n'ime ajụjụ ndị dị mkpa n'oge anyị a - kedu ka anyị ga-esi gbanwee nke ahụ?
rows.reference: A na m eche na nke ahụ bụ nnukwu ajụjụ n’oge anyị a -kedu ka anyị ga-esi gbanwee ya?

rows.source: Because clearly something has gone wrong for young men.'
rows.output: N'ihi na ihe na-ezighị ezi mere maka ndị na-eto eto.
rows.reference: N’ihi o doro anya na ọ nwela ihe mebiri n’ụmụaka ndị nwoke anyị.’

rows.source: In the interview he also admitted that he wouldn't be doing any Game of Thrones prequels or sequels when the series comes to an end next summer, saying he is 'done with battlefields and horses'.
rows.output: N'ime ajụjụ ọnụ ahụ, o kwetara na ya agaghị eme ihe ọ bụla nke Game of Thrones ma ọ bụ ihe na-esote ya mgbe usoro ahụ gwụchara n'okpomoku nke na-abịa n'okpomoku, na-ekwu na ọ "mechara na agha na ịnyịnya".
rows.reference: N’ajụjụ ọnụ ahụ ọ kwetara na ya agaghị eme akụkọ mmalite ma ọ bụ nke nsochi Game of Thrones ma ejije ahụ bịa na njedebe n’oge okpomọkụ na-abịa, na-ekwu na ya na ama ịlụ agha na ịnyịnya emechela’.

rows.source: From November Kit will star in a revival of Sam Shepard's True West which is the story of a film producer and his brother, who is a robber.
rows.output: Site na Nọvemba Kit ga-ahapụta na mmalite nke Sam Shepard's True West nke bụ akụkọ banyere onye na-emepụta ihe nkiri na nwanne ya nwoke, bụ onye ohi.
rows.reference: Site na na Novemba Kit ga-apụta na mmegharị Sam Shepard True West nke bụ akụkọ maka onye na-emepụta ihe nkiri na nwanne ya nwoke, bụ onye ohi.

rows.source: The actor recently revealed that he considers meeting his wife Rose to be the best thing to come out of Game of Thrones.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri ahụ na-akọ na ọ na-ewere izute nwunye ya Rose dị ka ihe kacha mma na-abịa site na Game of Thrones.
rows.reference: Nwoke ahụ na-eme ihe nkiri kwuputara n’oge adịghị anya na ọ na-eche na izute nwunye ya Rose bụ ihe kachasị mma mere ya na Game of Thrones.

rows.source: 'I met my wife in this show, so in that way it gave me my future family, and my life from here on in,' he said.
rows.output: 'Zutara m di ya n'ihe ngosi a, ya mere n'ụzọ ahụ o nyere m ezinụlọ n'ọdịnihu m, na ndụ m site ugbu a gaa n'ihu,' ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: ‘Ezutere m nwunye m n’ihe nkiri a, yabụ n’ụzọ nke ahụ o nyere m ezinụlọ m n’ọdịnihu, ya na ndụ m were dịrị gaba.’ o kwuru.

rows.source: Rose played Ygritte, the love interest of Kit's character Jon Snow, in the Emmy award-winning fantasy series.
rows.output: Rose gbara Ygritte, onye hụrụ Jon Snow n'anya, agwa Kit, na usoro fantasy nke nwetara ihe nrite Emmy.
rows.reference: Rose mere Ygritte, bụ onye Kit na eṅomi, Jon Snow hụrụ n’anya, n’ejije nwetara awọdụ Emmy.

rows.source: The couple married in June 2018 on the grounds of Leslie's family estate in Scotland.
rows.output: Di na nwunye ahụ lụrụ na June 2018 n'ogige ụlọ ezinụlọ Leslie dị na Scotland.
rows.reference: Di na nwunye ahụ lụrụ na Juun 2018 n’ala ogige be Leslie na Scotland.

rows.source: HIV/Aids: China reports 14% surge in new cases
rows.output: HIV/Aids: China na-akọ na 14% mụba n'ihe ndị ọhụrụ
rows.reference: HIV/Ọrịa obiri n’aja ọcha: China n’akọ na-enwere mgbali 14% n’okwu ọhụrụ

rows.source: China has announced a 14% jump in the number of its citizens who are living with HIV and Aids.
rows.output: China ekwupụtala mmụba 14% na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị China bi na ya nwere HIV na AIDS.
rows.reference: China mara ọkwa na-enwere mgbali 14% n’ọnụọgụ ndị amaala ya nwere HIV na Ọrịa obiri n’aja ọcha.

rows.source: More than 820,000 people are affected in the country, health officials say.
rows.output: Karịa 820,000 mmadụ metụtara na mba ahụ, ndị ọrụ ahụike kwuru.
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị mmadụ 820,000 ka ọ metụtara n’obodo ahụ, ndị ọrụ ahụike na-ekwu.

rows.source: About 40,000 new cases were reported in the second quarter of 2018 alone.
rows.output: Ihe dị ka puku iri anọ na puku iri anọ na abụọ, a kọrọ na nke abụọ nke afọ 2018.
rows.reference: Ihe ruru okwu 40,000 ọhụrụ ka ekpesara naanị n’ime agba nke abụọ na nkeji anọ 2018.

rows.source: The vast majority of new cases were transmitted through sex, marking a change from the past.
rows.output: Ihe ka ọtụtụ n'ime ndị ọhụrụ ahụ bụ site n'ikpere mmadụ, na-egosi mgbanwe n'ihe gbasara gburugburu ebe obibi.
rows.reference: Ọtụtụ n’ime okwu ọhụrụ a bụ site na n’ụzọ mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị ka esiri bufee ya, na-egosi mgbanwe n’oge gara aga.

rows.source: Traditionally, HIV spread rapidly through some parts of China as a result of infected blood transfusions.
rows.output: N'ụzọ ọdịnala, HIV na-agbasa ngwa ngwa n'akụkụ ụfọdụ nke China n'ihi mgbapụta ọbara metụtara ya.
rows.reference: N’omenala, HIV gbasara ngwangwa n’akụkụ ụfọdụ China n’ihi ọbara ndị butere ọrịa agbanyere ha.

rows.source: But the number of people contracting HIV in this way had been reduced to almost zero, Chinese health officials said at a conference in Yunnan province.
rows.output: Mana ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-arịa ọrịa HIV n'ụzọ a ebelatala ruo ihe fọrọ n'otu n'otu, ndị ọrụ ahụike China kwuru na nzukọ na Yunnan.
rows.reference: Mana ọnụọgụ ndị na-ebute HIV n’ụzọ a, ebelatala ihe ruru efu, ndị ọrụ ahụike China kwuru n’ọgbakọ emere n’okirikiri Yunnan.

rows.source: Year-on-year, however, the number of those living with HIV and Aids in China has risen by 100,000 people.
rows.output: N'afọ n'afọ, ọ bụghịkwa na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bi na China nwere HIV na AIDS amụbaala site na mmadụ 100,000.
rows.reference: Afọ n’elu afọ, kosiladị, ọnụọgụ ndị nwere HIV na Ọrịa obiri n’aja ọcha ejirila mmadụ 100,000 gbalie.

rows.source: HIV transmission through sex is an acute issue in China's LGBT community.
rows.output: Mgbasa nke HIV site na mmekọahụ bụ nsogbu dị oke mkpa n'ime obodo LGBT nke China.
rows.reference: Nbufe HIV site na mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị bụ okwu siri ike n’ogbe LGBT ndị China.

rows.source: Homosexuality was decriminalised in China in 1997, but discrimination against LGBT people is said to be rife.
rows.output: Mmanụ nwoke na nwanyị ka a na-akwadoghị na China na 1997, ma na-ekwu na a na-emegbu ndị LGBT.
rows.reference: Ewepuru ịda iwu dị n’okwu mmekọrịta nwoke na nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị na nwaanyị na China na 1997, mana mkpachapụ ndị LGBT ka dị nnukwu.

rows.source: Because of the country's conservative values, studies have estimated that 70-90% of men who have sex with men will eventually marry women.
rows.output: N'ihi ụkpụrụ ndị na-ekwesị ekwesị nke obodo ahụ, ọmụmụ ihe na-atụ anya na 70-90% nke ndị nwoke na-enwe mmekọahụ na ndị nwoke ga-alụ ụmụ nwanyị n'oge na-adịghị anya.
rows.reference: N’ihi ụkpụrụ nchekwa nke obodo ahụ, mmụta nyocha na-ama amụma n’ihe ruru 70-90% ụmụ nwoke ndị na-enwe mmekọrịta nwoke na nwoke ga-emecha lụọ nwanyị.

rows.source: Many of the transmissions of the diseases come from inadequate sexual protections in these relationships.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ n'ime mgbasa nke ọrịa ndị a sitere na nchekwa mmekọahụ ezughị oke n'ime mmekọrịta ndị a.
rows.reference: Ọtụtụ n’ime mbufe ọrịa ndị ahụ na esite na-emeghị mkpuchi mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị zuru oke n’ime ịme enyi ndị a.

rows.source: Since 2003, China's government has promised universal access to HIV medication as part of an effort to tackle the issue.
rows.output: N'afọ 2003, gọọmentị China kwere nkwa ịnweta ọgwụ HIV n'ozuzu ya dị ka akụkụ nke mbọ iji lebara okwu ahụ anya.
rows.reference: Kemgbe 2003, gọọmentị China ekwela nkwa nweta ọgwụ HIV bụ ozurumba dịka mbọ ha imegide okwu ahụ.

rows.source: Maxine Waters denies staffer leaked GOP senators' data, blasts 'dangerous lies' and 'conspiracy theories'
rows.output: Maxine Waters jụrụ na onye ọrụ ya gburu GOP senators' data, na-akụda 'ihe egwu na-ezighị ezi' na 'okpokoro okwu'.
rows.reference: Maxine Waters agọla agụgọ na onye ọrụ ya bụ onye busara data ndị ọmebe iwu GOP, kwutọọ ‘asị ọjọọ’ na ‘amụma ịkpa nkata’

rows.source: U.S. Rep. Maxine Waters on Saturday denounced allegations that a member of her staff had posted the personal information of three Republican U.S. senators onto the lawmakers' Wikipedia pages.
rows.output: Onye nnọchi anya U.S. Maxine Waters na Satọde katọrụ ebubo na onye otu ndị ọrụ ya tinyere ozi nkeonwe nke ndị Republican U.S. atọ n'ime ibe Wikipedia ha.
rows.reference: U.S. Onye ọmebe iwu Maxine Waters na Satọde gọnarịrị ebubo na otu onye ọrụ ya tinyere ozi nkeonwe nke ndị ọmebe iwu atọ Repọblikan U.S. na ibe ọmebe iwu Wikipedia.

rows.source: The Los Angeles Democrat asserted that the claims were being pedaled by "ultra-right wing" pundits and websites.
rows.output: Onye Democrat Los Angeles kwuru na ebubo ahụ bụ ndị "ultra-right wing" na-ekwu okwu na webụsaịtị.
rows.reference: Onye Los Angeles Demokrat ahụ kwusiri ike na ndị na-ebusa ebubo ahụ bụ ndị otu “ultra-right wing” na ndị websaịtị.

rows.source: "Lies, lies, and more despicable lies," Waters said in a statement on Twitter.
rows.output: "Ọghọm, ọghọm, na ọghọm ndị ọzọ na-adịghị mma," Waters kwuru n'okwu Twitter.
rows.reference: “Asị, asị, na asị ọjọọ,” Waters kwuru na nkwuputa na Twitter.

rows.source: The released information reportedly included the home addresses and phone numbers for U.S. Sens. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, and Mike Lee and Orrin Hatch, both of Utah.
rows.output: A na-ekwu na ozi e wepụtara gụnyere adreesị ụlọ na nọmba ekwentị maka Sinetọ U.S. Lindsey Graham nke South Carolina, na Mike Lee na Orrin Hatch, abụọ nke Utah.
rows.reference: Ozi nke ahụ ewepụtara nwere adreesị ụlọ na akara ekwentị maka Ndị Ọmebe Iwu U.S Lindsey Graham nke South Carolina, na Mike Lee yana Orrin Hatch, ha abụọ bụ ndị Utah.

rows.source: The information appeared online Thursday, posted by an unknown person on Capitol Hill during a Senate panel's hearing on the sexual misconduct allegations against Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Ozi ahụ pụtara n'ịntanetị na Tọzdee, e bipụtara ya site n'aka onye a na-amaghị aha na Capitol Hill n'oge nnọkọ Senate na-ekwu maka ebubo nke mmekọahụ na-ezighị ezi megide onye a họpụtara n'ọkwa Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Ozi ahụ pụtara n’ịntanetị na Tọsde, nke amaghị onye tinyere ya na Capitol Hill n’oge nnụrịta ụka ọgbakọ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu banyere ebubo mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị eboro onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: The leak came sometime after the three senators had questioned Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Mgbapụta ahụ mere mgbe ndị Sinetọ atọ ahụ jụrụ Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Mbusa ahụ pụtara mgbe ndị ọmebe iwu mmadụ atọ gbara Kavanaugh ajụjụ.

rows.source: Conservative sites such as Gateway Pundit and RedState reported that the IP address that identifies the source of the posts was associated with Waters" office and released the information of a member of Waters' staff, the Hill reported.
rows.output: Ndị na-akwado ndị na-akwado dị ka Gateway Pundit na RedState kwuru na adreesị IP nke na-akọwa ebe a na-esi na ya pụta bụ nke ụlọ ọrụ Waters na-ekpughe ozi nke onye ọrụ Waters, akwụkwọ akụkọ Hill kwuru.
rows.reference: Ndị saịtị nchekwa ụkpụrụ dịka Gateway Pundit na Redstate kwuputara na adreesị IP ejiri mara ebe ozi ahụ siri busa metụtara ụlọ ọrụ Waters, wee wepụta ozi nke onye ọrụ Waters, Hill kwuputara.

rows.source: "This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie," Waters continued.
rows.output: "Nkwupụta a na-enweghị isi bụ nke zuru oke na ụgha na ọ bụghị eziokwu," Waters gara n'ihu.
rows.reference: “Ebubo a n’enwegh isi bụ ụgha kpamkpam yana asị zuru ezu,”Waters gara n’ihu.

rows.source: "The member of my staff - whose identity, personal information, and safety have been compromised as a result of these fraudulent and false allegations - was in no way responsible for the leak of this information.
rows.output: "Otu onye ọrụ m - onye a na-amaghị aha ya, ozi nkeonwe ya, na nchekwa ya na-emerụ ahụ n'ihi ebubo ndị aghọtaghachiri na ụgha - enweghị ihe ọ bụla jikọrọ ya na mgbasa ozi a.
rows.reference: “Onye ọrụ m nke emebigoro nzuzo onye ọ bụ, ozi nkeonwe na nchekwa ya n’ihi ebubo aghụghọ na ụgha ndị a - enweghị ka aka ya siri dị na mbusa ozi ahụ.

rows.source: This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie."
rows.output: Nke a bụ nkwupụta na-enweghị isi, nke zuru oke bụ ụgha na ụgha zuru oke."
rows.reference: Ebubo a n’enweghị isi bụ ụgha kpamkpam yana asị zuru ezu.”

rows.source: Waters' statement quickly drew criticism online, including from former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer.
rows.output: Nkwupụta nke Waters mere ka a na-enwe nkatọ n'ịntanetị, gụnyere site n'aka onye bụ onye na-ekwu okwu White House gara aga, Ari Fleischer.
rows.reference: Nkwuputa Waters kpalitere nkọcha ozugbo n’ịntanetị, tinyere onye n’ahụ maka mgbasa ozi White House gara aga Ari Fleischer.

rows.source: "This denial is angry," Fleischer wrote.
rows.output: "Nkwenye a na-akpasu iwe," Fleischer dere.
rows.reference: “Ngọnarị a dị iwe,” Fleischer dere.

rows.source: "This suggests she doesn't have the temperment to be a Member of Congress.
rows.output: "Nke a na-egosi na ọ nweghị àgwà dị mkpa ịbụ Onye Omebe iwu.
rows.reference: “Nke a pụtara na ọ nweghị ụdị mmụọ eji a bụ Onye Ọmebe Iwu.

rows.source: When someone is accused of something they didn't do, they must not be angry.
rows.output: Mgbe onye a na-ebo ebubo na ọ dịghị ihe o mere, ha ekwesịghị iwe.
rows.reference: Mgbe eboro mmadụ ihe ha emeghị, ha ekwesịghị iwe iwe.

rows.source: They must not be defiant.
rows.output: Ha ekwesịghị ịjupụta.
rows.reference: Ha ekwesịghị ịrụ ụka.

rows.source: They must not question the motives of the accuser.
rows.output: Ha ekwesịghị ịjụ ihe kpatara onye na-ekwu okwu.
rows.reference: Ha ekwesịghị ịjụ ebumnuche onye boro ebubo.

rows.source: They must be calm and serene."
rows.output: Ha ga-adị jụụ na udo."
rows.reference: Ha kwesịrị ịdị nwayọọ ma daa jụụ.”

rows.source: Fleischer was appearing to compare Waters' reaction to the Democrats' criticism of Judge Kavanaugh, who was accused by critics of seeming too angry during Thursday's hearing.
rows.output: Fleischer na-egosi na-atụnyere mmeghachi omume nke Waters na nkatọ ndị Democrats banyere onye ọka ikpe Kavanaugh, onye ndị na-emegide ya boro ebubo na ọ na-adị ya ka ọ na-ewe iwe n'oge a na-anụ na Tuzdee.
rows.reference: Ọ bịara dịka Fleischer na-atule omume Waters na nkọcha ndị Demokrat mere Ọka Ikpe Kavanaugh, bụ onye nke ndị nkọcha boro ebubo na ọ dịka ọ were nnukwu iwe n’oge nnụrịta ụka Tọsde.

rows.source: Omar Navarro, a Republican candidate running to unseat Waters in the midterm elections, also voiced his thoughts on Twitter.
rows.output: Omar Navarro, onye Republican na-agba ọsọ na-azọ ọkwa na ntuli aka nke etiti oge, kwuru echiche ya na Twitter.
rows.reference: Omar Navarro, bụ onye nke Repọblikan na-achọ ịnapụ Waters oche n’oge ntuli aka ọkara ọchịchị, kwuputakwara echiche ya na Twitter.

rows.source: "Big if true," he tweeted.
rows.output: "Ọ bụrụ eziokwu, ọ bụ nnukwu ihe," ka o kwuru na Twitter.
rows.reference: “Nnukwu ma ọ bụrụ eziokwu,” ọ dere.

rows.source: In her statement, Waters said her office had alerted "the appropriate authorities and law enforcement entities of these fraudulent claims.
rows.output: N'okwu ya, Waters kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ya enyela "ndị ọrụ na ndị ọrụ iwu ndị kwesịrị ekwesị ozi gbasara ihe ndị a na-eme n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi."
rows.reference: Na nkwuputa ya, Waters kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ya akpọturugo “ ndị ikike dị n’aka na ndị mmanye iwu banyere ebubo ụgha ndị a.

rows.source: "We will ensure that the perpetrators will be revealed," she continued, "and that they will be held legally liable for all of their actions that are destructible and dangerous to any and all members of my staff."
rows.output: "Anyị ga-eme ka ndị mere ihe ahụ pụta ìhè," ka o kwuru, "na ha ga-ata ha ahụhụ n'ụzọ iwu maka ihe niile ha mere nke na-emerụ ahụ ma dị ize ndụ nye onye ọ bụla nọ n'ọrụ m."
rows.reference: “Anyị ga-ahụ na ndị mere ya ga-apụta ihie,” ọ gara n’ihu “na iwu ga-ejide ha maka omume ha niile nke na-emerụ ahụ ma dị egwu ebe onye na ndị ọrụ m niile nọ.

rows.source: Johnny English Strikes Again review - underpowered Rowan Atkinson spy spoof
rows.output: Nyochaa Johnny English Strikes Again - ihe na-adịghị ike nke Rowan Atkinson spy parody
rows.reference: Nyocha Johnny English Strikes Again - buturu ihe nkiri nzuzo ịkpa ọchị Rowan Atkinson

rows.source: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.
rows.output: Ọ bụ ihe a na-eme ugbu a ileba anya maka ihe Brexit pụtara n'ihe nkiri ọ bụla ọhụrụ nwere ntụpọ Britain, na nke ahụ yiri ka ọ dabara na ihe nkiri a na-eme ka Johnny English na-eme ihe nkiri na ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme ihe nkiri na-eme
rows.reference: Ọ bụ omenala ugbu a ịchọ mkpa Brexit n’ihe nkiri ọhụrụ ọ bụla nwere nribama Britain, na nke a dịka ọ metụtara mmegharị ihe nkiri ịkpa ọchị nke Johnny English - bụ nke ejiri Johnny English malite na 2003, wee laghachikwa azụ na 2011 ka Johnny English Reborn.

rows.source: Will tongue-in-cheek self-satire on the subject of how obviously rubbish we are be the nation's new export opportunity?
rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ ohere mbupụ mba ahụ?
rows.reference: Ọ pụtara na ihe nkiri njakịrị nke isiokwu otu anyị siri bụrụ ndị iberibe pụtara ihie, bụzi oghere nbufe ahịa ọhụrụ anyị?

rows.source: At any rate, the pop-eyed, rubber-faced incompetent Johnny English has had his licence to cock things up renewed for the second time - that name of his signalling more than anything else that he is a broad comic creation designed for non-English-speaking cinemagoing territories.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị nke ahụ, onye nwere anya pop, ihu rọba na onye na-adịghị arụ ọrụ Johnny English enwetala ikike ịgbanye ihe na-eme ka ọ dị njọ maka oge nke abụọ - aha ya na-egosi ihe karịrị ihe ọ bụla na ọ bụ ihe okike na-akpa ọchị nke e mere maka ógbè ndị na-asụghị Bekee na-ekiri ihe nkiri.
rows.reference: Kosiladị, onye nzuzu anya ọkpụ, ihu rọba Johnny English emegharịala ikike ya ịkwalite ihe nke ugboro abụọ - aha ya karịa ihe ọ bụla na-egosi na ọ bụ nchepụta ihe ịkpa ọchị emebere maka akụkụ obodo ndị anaghị asụ Bekee.

rows.source: He is of course the daft secret agent who despite his bizarre pretensions to smoothie glamour has got a little bit of Clouseau, a dash of Mr Bean and a dollop of that chap contributing a single note to the Chariots of Fire theme tune at the London 2012 Olympics opening ceremony.
rows.output: Ọ bụ onye ọrụ nzuzo nzuzu nke n'agbanyeghị na ọ na-eme ka ọ dị mma na ihe nkiri dị iche iche, o nwere ntụmadị Clouseau, ntụmadị Mr Bean na dollop nke onye ahụ na-enye otu ihe na egwu Chariots of Fire na mmemme mmalite nke Olympics London 2012.
rows.reference: N’ezie ọ bụ onye iberibe ọrụ nzuzo nke agbanyeghị ṅṅomi ya gbagwojuru anya, nwere obere Clouseau, ntakịrị Mr Bean na nfechalụ nke nwoke ahụ n’etinye otu olu na isiokwu Chariots of Fire na mmalite mmemme Olympics London 2012.

rows.source: He's also originally based on the traveller and international man of mystery Atkinson once played in the now forgotten Barclaycard TV ads, leaving chaos in his wake.
rows.output: Ọ bụkwa nke mbụ dabere na onye njem na onye nzuzo mba ụwa Atkinson gbara na mbadamba TV Barclaycard a na-echefu echefu, na-ahapụ ihe mgbu n'azụ ya.
rows.reference: N’izizi ọ dabere n’onye njem yana nwoke nzuzo mba ụwa Atkinson nke emere na ihe mgbasa ozi Barclaycard TV echefugoro, na-ahapu ọgbaghara n’azụ ya.

rows.source: There are one or two nice moments in this latest JE outing.
rows.output: Enwere otu ma ọ bụ abụọ dị mma n'ime njem JE a na-adịghị anya.
rows.reference: Enwere otu oge ma ọ bụ abụọ mara mma na JE ọhụrụ a.

rows.source: I loved Johnny English approaching a helicopter while dressed in a medieval suit of armour and the rotor blades briefly clanging against his helmet.
rows.output: M hụrụ Johnny English n'anya ka ọ na-eru n'elu ụgbọ elu ebe ọ na-eyi uwe mwụda oge ochie ma na-akụda mgbịrịgba na-emetụ n'okpu ya.
rows.reference: Ọ masịrị m ka Johnny English na-erute nso n’ụgbọ elu ebe oyi uwe agha ndị agba ochie, igwe nkucha were na-akụta n’okpu agha ya.

rows.source: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị iche, Atkinson nwere nkà na ihe nkiri na-akpa ọchị, mana ihe ọchị ahụ na-adị ka ọ na-adịghị ike ma na-adịghị mma, karịsịa ebe ihe nkiri "nke dị njọ" dị ka 007 na Mission Impossible na-enye ihe ọchị ugbu a dị ka ihe dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Onyinye Atkinson nwere maka ịkpa ọchị a na-ahụ anya pụtara ihie, mana ịkpa ọchị ahụ esighi ike ma mafee oke, tụmadị ihe nkiri ndị ahụ “anaghị akpa ọchị” dịka 007 na Mission Impossible n’onwe ha na-enwekwa ihe ịkpa ọchị n’ime ya ugbu a.

rows.source: The humour feels as if it is pitched at kids rather than adults, and for me Johnny English's wacky misadventures aren't as inventive and focused as Atkinson's silent-movie gags in the persona of Bean.
rows.output: Ọchị ọchị ahụ na-adị ka a na-atụ ya n'aka ụmụaka kama ndị okenye, na maka m Johnny English's wacky misadventures abụghị ihe ọhụrụ na-elekwasị anya dị ka Atkinson's silent-movie gags na Bean's persona.
rows.reference: Ihe ịkpa ọchị ahụ dịka ọ bụ ụmụaka ka emebere ya karịa ndị okenye, maka mụ onwe m njegheri Johnny English enweghị ihe nchepụta pụrụ iche yana ebumnuche ya dịka ihe nkiri anaghị ekwu okwu nke Atkinson, n’onye nke Bean.

rows.source: The perennially topical premise now is that Great Britain is in serious trouble.
rows.output: Isiokwu na-adịgide adịgide ugbu a bụ na Great Britain nọ n'ọnọdụ dị oke egwu.
rows.reference: Ebe mgbado ukwu isiokwu ugbu a bụ na Great Britain nọ n’oke nsogbu.

rows.source: A cyber-hacker has infiltrated Britain's super-secret web network of spies, revealing the identities of all Britain's agents in the field, to the dismay of the agent on duty - a regrettably small role for Kevin Eldon.
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka kọmputa agbapụla n'ime netwọkụ webụ Britain nke ndị ọrụ nchekwube, na-ekpughe njirimara nke ndị ọrụ Britain niile nọ n'ọrụ, nke na-akpasu onye ọrụ nọ n'ọrụ - ọrụ dị ntakịrị maka Kevin Eldon.
rows.reference: Onye nbanye ịntanetị anataghị ikike banyere na netwọk ndị ọrụ nzuzo kachasị dị nzuzo nke Britain, kpughee ndị ọrụ nzuzo niile nọ n’ọrụ, na mgbagwoju anya onye ọrụ nzuzo nọ ọrụ - obere ihe omume maka Kelvin Eldon.

rows.source: It's the last straw for a prime minister who is a pompous and embattled figure, already suffering a complete meltdown of political unpopularity: Emma Thompson does her very best with this quasi-Teresa-May character but there's nothing much in the script to work with.
rows.output: Ọ bụ ihe na-erughị eru maka onye isi ala onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na-ewute ya, onye na
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nke ikpeazụ maka onye isi ala bụ onye mpako nwere nsogbu, nke enweghịzi nkwado ọchịchị ọ bụla kpamkpam: Emma Thompson nwara ike ya na ime ihe omume a yitebere Teresa-May mana enwekebeghị ihe dị n’akwụkwọ ọ ga-eji rụọ ọrụ.

rows.source: Her intelligence advisers inform her that as every single active spy has been compromised, she will have to bring someone out of retirement.
rows.output: Ndị ndụmọdụ ya gbasara ọgụgụ isi ya gwara ya na ebe ọ bụla a na-ahụ maka ndị ọrụ nchekwa na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ, ọ ga-adị mkpa ka ọ kpọọ onye nọ n'izu ike.
rows.reference: Ndị na-enye ya ndụmọdụ nchekwa gwara ya na ebe amagoro ndị ọrụ nzuzo ya niile, ọ ga-akpọpụta onye lagoro ezumike nka.

rows.source: And that means bumbling Johnny English himself, now employed as a schoolmaster in some posh establishment, but giving off-the-record lessons in how to be an undercover operative: some nice gags here, as English offers a School of Rock-type academy of spying.
rows.output: Na nke ahụ pụtara Johnny English na-eme ihe na-enweghị isi, ugbu a na-arụ ọrụ dị ka onye nkuzi n'ụlọ akwụkwọ dị elu, ma na-enye nkuzi na-enweghị ndekọ na otu esi bụrụ onye ọrụ nchekwube: ụfọdụ gags dị mma ebe a, ka English na-enye ụlọ akwụkwọ School of Rock-type nke ịzụ ahịa.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ pụtara Johnny English na-emegheri emegheri n’onwe ya, onye nke ewere n’ọrụ dịka onye nkuzi n’ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị ọgaranya, mana na-enye nkuzi nke adịghị n’akwụkwọ ka-esi a bụ onye ọrụ nzuzo: ọmalịcha odide ebe a, dịka English nyere ụdị ụlọ akwụkwọ nzuzo School of Rock.

rows.source: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.
rows.output: A na-eweghachi Bekee azụ na Whitehall maka mkparịta ụka mberede ma jikọta ya ọzọ na onye na-eme ihe nkiri ya na onye na-eme ihe nkiri Bough, nke Ben Miller na-egwu ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ebughachiri English na Whitehall maka inye ntuziaka ntụmadị were zukọta yana onye nke abụọ ya tagbugoro onwe ya n’ahụhụ Bough, bụ Ben Miller mere ya ọzọ.

rows.source: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.
rows.output: Bough bụ nwoke lụrụ di na nwunye ugbu a, lụrụ onye isi ụgbọ mmiri, ọrụ egwuregwu hockey nke Vicki Pepperdine na-ejighị nke ọma.
rows.reference: Bough abụrụla onye lụrụ nwunye, ejikọrọ ya na onye isi ngwa ọgụ mmiri, bụ ihe omume onye nwere agba Vicki Pepperdine mere ka onye mmanya na-egbu.

rows.source: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.
rows.output: Ya mere, Batman na Robin nke na-eme ihe na-ezighị ezi na Her Majesty's Secret Service na-alọghachikwuru, na-ezute Ophelia Bulletova mara mma nke Olga Kurylenko.
rows.reference: Yabụ na Batman na Robin nke na emebi ihe mgbe niile N’ọrụ Nzuzo Her Majesty amalitekwala, na-ezute Olga Kurylenko dịka ọmalicha Ophelia Bulletova.

rows.source: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.
rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, onye isi ala na-adaba n'ihe ize ndụ n'okpuru ihe ịchọ mgbapụta nke onye ọchụnta ego teknụzụ na-adọrọ mmasị bụ onye na-ekwu na ọ nwere ike dozie nsogbu kọmputa Britain: onye na-adịghị mma Jason Volta, nke Jake Lacy na-arụ.
rows.reference: Kosiladị, onye isi ala na-adanye na anwansi nke onye ọgaranya tech, bụ onye nke kwuru na ọ nwere ike idozi nsogbu kọmputa ndị Britain nwere: onye ọjọọ Jason Volta bụ Jake Lacy mere ya.

rows.source: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.
rows.output: English na Bough malitere njem ha nke ihe ọchị na ihe ọchị: e ji uwe mwụda chọọ ya, ha na-amanye ọkụ n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ French na-awụfu; ha na-emepụta ihe na-akpaghasị ihe mgbe ha na-abanye n'ụgbọ mmiri Volta nke ọma; na English na-akpalite ihe na-adịghị mma mgbe ọ na-agbalị iji ihe nkiri eziokwu iji mara onwe ya n'ime ụlọ Volta.
rows.reference: English na Bough malitere njem nke egwuregwu nzuzu ịkpa ọchị ha: gbanwee dịka onye na-eke nri, ha mụnyere ọkụ n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ French; ha butere ọgbaghara izunye onwe ha n’ime ụgbọ mmiri ezumike Volta; English kpalitere mgbagwoju anya ka ọ nwara iji ngwa isi Virtual Reality nwere mata ime ụlọ Volta.

rows.source: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.
rows.output: Ihe niile na-eme ka ọ dị mma maka usoro ikpeazụ ahụ, mana dị ka ọ na-adị mma na nke na-akpa ọchị, e nwere ọtụtụ ihe nkiri ụmụaka gbasara ihe niile.
rows.reference: Eji ihe niile were mee agba nke ikpeazụ ahụ, ma obi uto na egwumegwu niile dị ya, enwere obere TV ụmụaka dị n’ihe niile ahụ.

rows.source: Pretty moderate stuff.
rows.output: Ihe dị mma.
rows.reference: Ọmalịcha ihe agafeghị oke.

rows.source: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?
rows.output: Na dị ka na Johnny English ndị ọzọ ihe nkiri, enweghị m ike ịghọta: ọ̀ nwere ike ime ka ụlọ ọrụ ihe nkiri Britain nye Rowan Atkinson ọrụ nke na-eme ezigbo ikpe maka ikike ya?
rows.reference: Dịka n’ihe nkiri Johnny English ndị ọzọ, ọ naghaghị m ịche: ndị na-eme ihe nkiri nke Britain enweghi ike nye Rowan Atkinson ihe omume ga-ebuputa onyinye ya nke ọma?

rows.source: Labour denies it is devising a plan for Britons to work a four day week but be paid for five days
rows.output: Ndị Labour na-ekwu na ha na-eme atụmatụ ka ndị Britain na-arụ ọrụ izu anọ ma na-akwụ ụgwọ maka ụbọchị ise
rows.reference: Labour na-agọnarị na ha anaghị akpa nkata atụmatụ ka ndị Britain na-arụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu ma nara ụgwọ ọrụ maka ụbọchị ise

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is to consider a radical plan which will see Britons working a four day week - but getting paid for five.
rows.output: Ndị Labour Party nke Jeremy Corbyn na-eme atụmatụ ịtụle atụmatụ dị egwu nke ga-eme ka ndị Britain na-arụ ọrụ izu anọ - mana na-enweta ụgwọ maka ise.
rows.reference: Labour Party nke Jeremy Corbyn na-atule atụmatụ ga-agbanwe ihe nke ga-ahụ na ndị Britain rụọ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu ha anara ụgwọ ọrụ maka ụbọchị ise.

rows.source: The party reportedly wants company bosses to pass on savings made through the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution to workers by giving them an extra day off.
rows.output: Ndị otu ahụ na-ekwu na ha chọrọ ka ndị isi ụlọ ọrụ nyere ndị ọrụ aka site n'inyekwu ha ụbọchị ezumike ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ndị otu a chọrọ ka ndị isi nwe ụlọ ọrụ na-enyefe akụ ha chekwabara n’aka ndị ọrụ siterena mgbanwe artificial intelligence (AI) site na inye ha ụbọchị ụma agaghị arụ ọrụ.

rows.source: It would see employees enjoy a three-day weekend - but still take home the same pay.
rows.output: Ọ ga-ahụ ndị ọrụ na-enwe ụbọchị izu ike nke atọ - ma ka na-enweta ụgwọ otu.
rows.reference: Ọ ga-eme na ndị na-arụ ọrụ ga-erite elele ụbọchị atọ n’izu ụka ma welakwaa otu ụgwọ ọnwa.

rows.source: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.
rows.output: Isi iyi kwuru na echiche ahụ ga-adaba na atụmatụ akụ na ụba otu pati ahụ na atụmatụ ịgbanwe mba ahụ n'ụzọ ndị ọrụ.
rows.reference: Ndị nzuputa okwu kwuru na echiche a “ga-adaba” na ebumnuche yana atụmatụ akụnụba nke otu a ime ka ọ dabaara ndị ọrụ.

rows.source: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.
rows.output: Mgbanwe na izu anọ na-arụ ọrụ ka ndị otu Trade Union Congress kwadoro dị ka ụzọ ndị ọrụ ga-esi jiri ya mee ihe n'ụzọ dị iche iche nke akụ na ụba na-agbanwe.
rows.reference: Ndị otu Trades Union Congress akwadola ịmalite ụbọchị anọ n’ime izu dịka ụzọ ndị ọrụ ga-esi rite elele na akụnụba na-agbanwe.

rows.source: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.
rows.output: Otu onye isi otu Labour Party gwara The Sunday Times: "A na-atụ anya na a ga-ekwupụta nyocha amụma tupu njedebe nke afọ.
rows.reference: Onye senịọ nzuputa okwu nke Labour Party gwara Sunday Times: ‘A na-atu anya ịma ọkwa nyocha amụma tupu ngwucha afọ a.

rows.source: 'It won't happen overnight but a four-day working week is an aspiration that fits in with the party's approach to rebalancing the economy in favour of the worker as well as the party's overall industrial strategy.'
rows.output: 'Ọ gaghị eme n'abalị, mana izu ọrụ anọ bụ ihe a na-achọsi ike nke dabara na ụzọ pati ahụ si emeso akụ na ụba na-adabara onye ọrụ na nke pati ahụ n'ozuzu ya na atụmatụ ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ.'
rows.reference: ‘Ọ gaghị eme ozugbo mana ịrụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu bụ ebumnobi ndị otu a dabara n’usoro ihazi akụnụba ka ọ dabaara ndị ọrụ yana mkpokota ụzọ nrụpụta ihe nke ndị otu ahụ.’

rows.source: The Labour Party would not be the first to endorse such an idea, with the Green Party pledging a four-day working week during its 2017 general election campaign.
rows.output: Ndị Labour Party agaghị abụ ndị mbụ kwadoro echiche dị otú ahụ, ebe ndị Green Party kwere nkwa izu ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n'oge mgbasa ozi ntuli aka ha n'afọ 2017.
rows.reference: Labour Party agaghị abụ ndị izizi kwadoro echiche a, ebe Green Party kwere nkwa ịrụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu n’ime oge ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị 2017.

rows.source: The aspiration is currently not being endorsed by the Labour Party as a whole, however.
rows.output: A na-achọ ka a na-akwado ya ugbu a, mana ọ bụghị pati Labour niile kwadoro ya.
rows.reference: Labour Party anaghị akwado ebumnuche ahụ ugbu a dịka otu, kosiladị.

rows.source: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'
rows.output: Onye na-ekwu okwu otu Labour kwuru: "Ụbọchị ọrụ ụbọchị anọ abụghị iwu otu pati ma a n'atụghị ya."
rows.reference: Onye nkwuchite okwu Labour Party kwuru: ‘Ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu abughị amụma ndị otu a nke na ndị otu a anaghị atule ya.’

rows.source: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.
rows.output: Onye isi oche John McDonnell ji izu ụka gara aga mee ka ọ pụta ìhè n'echiche ya maka mgbanwe socialist na akụ na ụba.
rows.reference: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell jiri ọgbakọ Labour mere izu gara aga were kọwapụta echiche ya maka mgbanwe na akụnụba.

rows.source: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.
rows.output: Onye isi oche McDonnell kwuru na ya na-agbasi mbọ ike iji ike n'ala n'aka ndị 'ndị na-enweghị ihu' na 'ndị na-erite uru' na ụlọ ọrụ na-enye ọrụ.
rows.reference: Mazị McDonnell kwuru na o kpebiri iweghachite ikike site na n’aka ndị ‘isi ụlọ ọrụ amaghị’ yana “ndị nrite oke uru’ n’ụlọ ọrụ ndị eji ebi ndụ.

rows.source: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.
rows.output: Onye isi oche na-ahụ maka onye isi oche na atụmatụ ya na-eme ka ndị na-etinye ego ugbu a na ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ghọta na ha agaghị enwetaghachi ego ha niile dị ka gọọmentị Labour nwere ike ime 'mwepụ' n'ihi mmebi iwu.
rows.reference: Atụmatụ shadow chancellor ahụ pụtakwara na ndị nwere oke n’ụlọ ọrụ mmiri nwere ike ha agaghị enwetacha isi ego ha, maka gọọmentị Labour nwere ike ‘ime mwepu’ na ndabere ebumnobi ihe ezighi ezi.

rows.source: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.
rows.output: Ọ kọọrọ atụmatụ itinye ndị ọrụ n'ụzọ dị iche iche n'ụzọ dị iche iche n'ụzọ dị iche iche, na-emepụta Inclusive Ownership Funds iji nye ndị ọrụ 10 pasent nke ụlọ ọrụ nkeonwe, ndị na-adị njikere inweta dividends kwa afọ nke ruru £500.
rows.reference: O kwuputakwara atụmatụ itinye ndị ọrụ na bọdụ ụlọ ọrụ ma mepụta Inclusive Ownership Fund ga-enyefe pesenti 10 n’oke ụlọ ọrụ ndị nkịtị n’aka ndị ọrụ, ndị nwere ike inweta uru isi ego ruru £500.

rows.source: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds
rows.output: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy gwara "60 Minutes" ma ọ bụ nyocha FBI banyere Kavanaugh nwere ike ịgbanwe echiche ha
rows.reference: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy gwa “60 minutes” ma nyocha ndị FBI enwere ike ịgbanwe obi ha

rows.source: The FBI investigation into accusations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed a final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court by at least a week, and raises the question of whether the bureau's findings could sway any Republican senators into pulling their support.
rows.output: Nnyocha FBI banyere ebubo e boro onye ọka ikpe Brett Kavanaugh emeela ka a na-atụ anya na a ga-eme ntuli aka ikpeazụ maka nhọpụta ya n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu nke oge a, ma ọ dịkarịa ala otu izu, ma na-ewelite ajụjụ ma ihe ndị FBI chọpụtara nwere ike ime ka ndị Republican ọ bụla na-akwado ya wepụ nkwado ha.
rows.reference: Nyocha ndị FBI na-eme banyere ebubo eboro Ọka Ikpe Brett Kavanaugh egbuola oge ime ntuli aka ikpeazụ na nhọpụta ya maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu opekempe otu izu, wee bulite ajụjụ na nchọpụta ụlọ ọrụ ahụ enwere ike ịgbanwe obi ndị ọmebe iwu Repọblikan ịdọrọkwa nkwado ha.

rows.source: In an interview airing Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pelley asked Republicans Sens. John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham whether the FBI could unearth anything that would lead them to change their minds.
rows.output: N'ajụjụ ọnụ na-aga n'ihu na Sọnde, onye nta akụkọ "60 Minutes" bụ Scott Pelley jụrụ ndị Republican Senators John Kennedy na Lindsey Graham ma ọ bụrụ na FBI nwere ike ịchọta ihe ọ bụla ga-eme ka ha gbanwee echiche ha.
rows.reference: N’ajụjụ ga-eme na Sọnde, onye akụkọ “60 Minutes” Scott Pelley jụrụ ndị Ọmebe Iwu Repọblikan John Kennedy na Lindsey Graham ma FBI enwere ike bọlite ihe ọ bụla ga-eme ka ha gbanwee obi ha.

rows.source: Kennedy appeared more open than his colleague from South Carolina.
rows.output: Kennedy pụtara na ọ dịkwuo n'ihu karịa onye òtù ya si South Carolina.
rows.reference: Kennedy meghere onwe ya karịa onye otu ya si South Carolina.

rows.source: "I mean, of course," said Kennedy.
rows.output: "Ọ bụ ihe m na-ekwu, n'ezie," ka Kennedy kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ana m eche, ee,” Kennedy kwuru.

rows.source: "I said going into the hearing, I said, I've talked to Judge Kavanaugh.
rows.output: "Agwara m na-aga n'ihu n'ikpe ahụ, agwara m, agwawala m onye ọka ikpe Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: “E kwuru m na nbanye na nnụrịta ụka ahụ, E kwuru m, A gwara m Ọka Ikpe Kavanaugh okwu.

rows.source: I called him after this happened, that allegation came out, said, 'Did you do it?'
rows.output: M kpọrụ ya ka ihe a mere, na ebubo ahụ pụtara, wee sị, 'Ị mere ya?'
rows.reference: Akpọrọ m ya ka nke a mechara, ka ebubo ahụ pụtara, kwuo sị, ‘Ị mere ya?

rows.source: He was resolute, determined, unequivocal."
rows.output: Ọ dị njikere, na-eme atụmatụ, na-enweghị mgbagha."
rows.reference: Ọ kụjaghị, ọ nwere mkpebi, na enweghị mgbagha.”

rows.source: Graham's vote, however, appears set in stone.
rows.output: Vootu Graham, n'agbanyeghị, dị ka a ga-asị na ọ dị n'elu nkume.
rows.reference: Ntuli aka Graham, kosiladị, dịka edeela ya ede.

rows.source: "My mind's made up about Brett Kavanaugh and it would take a dynamite accusation," he said.
rows.output: "Obi m adịla njikere maka Brett Kavanaugh na ọ ga-ewekwu ihe na-ekwu na ọ bụ ihe na-adịghị mma."
rows.reference: “Obi m ekpebiela gbasara Brett Kavanaugh, na ọ ga-ewe ebubo dasiri ike,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett denied it vigorously," Graham added, referring to Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: "Dọkịta Ford, amaghị m ihe mere, mana ama m nke a: Brett jụrụ ya nke ukwuu," Graham gbakwara, na-ezo aka na Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.reference: “Dr. Ford, Amaghị m ihe mere mana a ama m nke a: Brett gọnarịrị nke ukwuu,” Graham gbakwunyere, na-arụta Christine Blasey Ford aka.

rows.source: "And everybody she names couldn't verify it.
rows.output: "Ma onye ọ bụla ọ kpọrọ aha enweghị ike ịkwado ya.
rows.reference: “Na ndị niile ọkpọrọ aha enweghị onye kwetara ya.

rows.source: It's 36 years old.
rows.output: Ọ dị afọ iri atọ na isii.
rows.reference: Ọ gbaala afọ 36.

rows.source: I don't see anything new changing."
rows.output: Anaghị m ahụ ihe ọ bụla ọhụrụ na-agbanwe."
rows.reference: Anaghị m ahụ ihe ọhụrụ na-agbanwe.”

rows.source: What is the Global Citizen Festival and Has it Done Anything to Decrease Poverty?
rows.output: Kedu ihe Global Citizen Festival bụ na Ọ na-eme ihe ọ bụla iji belata ịda ogbenye?
rows.reference: Gịnị bụ Mmemme Global Citizen, na Ọ nwela Ihe Ọ Bụla Ọ Mere Iji Belata Ụbịam?

rows.source: This Saturday New York will host the Global Citizen Festival, an annual music event which has a hugely impressive line-up of stars performing and an equally impressive mission; ending world poverty.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọdee a, New York ga-anabatakwa emume Global Citizen Festival, ihe omume egwu nke na-eme kwa afọ nke nwere usoro ndị na-eti egwu na-eme ihe ngosi na ebumnuche dị egwu; ịkwatu ịda ogbenye n'ụwa.
rows.reference: Satọde nke a New York ga-achịkọba Global Citizen Festival,emume ịgụ egwu a na-eme kwa afọ nke na-enwe ahịrị ndị ama ama na-atụ n’anya nke ukwuu na-eme ihe nkiri, yana ebumnobi dịkwa ịtụnanya; ịkwụsị ụbịam n’ụwa.

rows.source: Now in its seventh year, the Global Citizen Festival will see tens of thousands of people flock to Central Park's Great Lawn to not only enjoy acts such as Janet Jackson, Cardi B and Shawn Mendes, but also to raise awareness for the event's true goal of ending extreme poverty by 2030.
rows.output: Ugbu a n'afọ nke asaa, emume Global Citizen ga-ahụ ọtụtụ puku mmadụ na-aga n'ogige Great Lawn nke Central Park ka ha ghara naanị ịnụ ụtọ ihe ngosi dị ka Janet Jackson, Cardi B na Shawn Mendes, kamakwa ka ha mee ka a mata ihe omume ahụ bụ n'ezie bụ ime ka ịda ogbenye dịkwuo mma site n'afọ 2030.
rows.reference: Ugbu a n’afọ nke asaa ya, Global Citizen Festival ga-ahụ puku kwụrụ puku mmadụ ga-ezute na Ama Central Park, nke abụghị naanị inweta ọṅụ n’ihe nkiri ndị a dịka Janet Jackson, Cardi B, Shawn Mendes, ma ka ha kwalitekwa mmata ezigbo ebumnuche mmemme ịkwụsị ụbịam na 2030.

rows.source: The Global Citizen Festival, which stated in 2012, is an extension of the Global Poverty Project, an international advocacy group hoping to end poverty by increasing the number of people actively fighting against it.
