rows.reference: Ndị Rangers na anabata Rapid Vienna na Tọsde, mara na mmeri n’elu ndị Austria ahụ, sotere egwu onye laba onye laba mara mma agbara na Spain n’etiti Villareal na mbido ọnwa a, ga-etinye ha n’ọnọdụ siri ike iji tozue pụta na Otu G nke Europa League.

rows.source: A knee injury prevented midfielder Graham Dorrans from making his first appearance of the season until the 2-2 draw with Villarreal but he believes Rangers can use that result as a springboard to greater things.
rows.output: Mmerụ ahụ n'ikpere kụrụ onye etinyeghị aka na egwuregwu n'oge a ruo mgbe a gbara 2-2 na Villarreal, ma ọ kwenyere na Rangers nwere ike iji nsonaazụ ahụ dị ka ihe na-akpali mmụọ iji nweta ihe ịga nke ọma.
rows.reference: Ahụ mmerụ n’ikpere gbochiri onye etiti Graham Dorrans n’ime mpụta izizi nke afọ asọmpi ahụ ruo mgbe egwuregwu 2-2 dị n’etiti Villareal mana ọ kwenyere Rangers nwere ike iji nsonaazụ ahụ dị ka nzọụkwụ iji mee ihe ndị dị egwu.

rows.source: "It was a good point for us because Villarreal are a good side," said the 31-year-old.
rows.output: "Ọ bụ isi ike maka anyị n'ihi na Villarreal bụ otu dị mma," ka onye dị afọ 31 kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ ezigbo akara maka anyị n’ihi Villareal bụ ezigbo akụkụ,” nke onye afọ 31 ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: "We went into the game believing we could get something and came away with a point.
rows.output: Anyị banyere n'otu egwuregwu ahụ na-ekwere na anyị nwere ike nweta ihe ma pụọ ​​n'ebe ahụ na otu isi.
rows.reference: “Anyị banyere egwuregwu ahụ kwete na anyị nwere ike ịnwete ihe ma jiri otu akara wee pụta.

rows.source: Maybe we could have nicked it in the end but, overall, a draw was probably a fair result.
rows.output: Ma eleghị anya, anyị nwere ike ịtọ ya n'ikpeazụ, ma n'ozuzu, otu n'otu bụ ihe e ji mara.
rows.reference: Ikekwe anyị kwesịrị ịnweta mmeri na ngwụcha mana, na nchịkọta, onye laba onye laba bụkwa nsonaazụ dị mma.

rows.source: They were probably better in the first half and we came out in the second half and were the better side.
rows.output: Ha nwere ike ime nke ọma na ọkara nke mbụ, anyị wee pụta na ọkara nke abụọ wee bụrụ akụkụ kacha mma.
rows.reference: Ọ dị ka ha aka mma n’ọkara nke izizi, ma anyị pụtara n’ọkara nke abụọ ma bụrụ akụkụ ka mma.

rows.source: Going into Thursday, it's another big European night.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Tọzdee, ọ bụ abalị ọzọ dị mkpa na Europe.
rows.reference: Ịbanye Tọsde, ọ bụ nnukwu abalị Europe ọzọ.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can get three points but that will be tough game because they had a good result in their last game but, with the crowd behind us, I'm sure we can push on and get a positive result.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị mma, anyị nwere ike nweta isi atọ mana nke ahụ ga-abụ egwuregwu siri ike n'ihi na ha nwere ezigbo nsonaazụ n'ụzọ ikpeazụ ha, mana, na ndị na-akwado anyị n'azụ, ejighị m n'aka na anyị nwere ike ịkwaga ma nweta nsonaazụ dị mma.
rows.reference: N’olile anya, anyị nwere ike ịnweta akara atọ mana ọ ga-esi ike n’ihi ha nwetara nsonaazụ mara mma n’egwuregwu ikpeazụ ha mana, ndị igwe mmadụ nọnyere anyị, adị m njikere na anyị nwere ike ịga n’ihu ma nweta nsonaazụ mara mma.

rows.source: Last year was definitely tough, between everything that happened with my injuries and the changes at the club itself but there's a feelgood factor about the place now.
rows.output: Afọ gara aga bụ nke siri ike, n'etiti ihe niile mere na mmerụ ahụ m na mgbanwe ndị dị na klọb n'onwe ya mana e nwere ihe dị mma gbasara ebe ahụ ugbu a.
rows.reference: Afọ ikpeazụ siri nnukwu ike, n’ime ihe niile mere ma ahụ mmerụ m yana mgbanwe n’otu asọmpi ahụ n’onwe ya mana enwere ezi mmụọ gbasara ebe ahụ ugbu a.

rows.source: The squad's good and the boys are really enjoying it; the training's good.
rows.output: Otu ahụ dị mma ma ụmụ okoro na-enwe obi ụtọ; ọzụzụ ahụ dị mma.
rows.reference: Otu egwuregwu ahụ dị mma, ndị otu m nwoke na enwe ọhụụ ya; ọzụzụ dị mma.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can push on now, put last season behind us and be successful."
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị mma, anyị nwere ike ịga n'ihu ugbu a, hapụ oge gara aga n'azụ anyị ma nwee ihe ịga nke ọma."
rows.reference: N’olile anya, anyị nwere ike ịkwara gaba n’ihu ugbu a, tinye afọ asọmpi gara n’azụ anyị ma mee nke ọma.”

rows.source: Women are losing sleep over this retirement savings fear
rows.output: Ụmụ nwanyị na-ata ahụhụ n'ihi ụjọ nke ego ezumike n'ụra
rows.reference: Ụmụ nwanyị na agbakasị ahụ n’ihi ụjọ ego nchekwa oge ezumike nka

rows.source: Despite the fact that survey participants had a clear idea of how they wanted to be cared for, few people were talking to their family members about it.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ndị sonyere na nyocha ahụ nwere echiche doro anya banyere otu ha chọrọ ka a na-elekọta ha, ndị mmadụ ole na ole na-ekwu okwu na ndị òtù ezinụlọ ha gbasara ya.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị n’eziokwu ndị sonyere na nyocha ahụ nwere alo doro anya otu ha siri chọọ ka elekọta ha, ndị mmadụ ole ma ole nọ na agwa ndị otu ezinụlọ okwu maka ya.

rows.source: About half of the individuals in the Nationwide study said they were speaking with their spouses about the cost of long-term care.
rows.output: Ihe dị ka ọkara nke ndị mmadụ n'ọmụmụ ihe mba ahụ kwuru na ha na ndị òtù ezinụlọ ha na-ekwu maka ego nke nlekọta ogologo oge.
rows.reference: Ihe dị ka okara nke ndị mmadụ ahụ na mmụta Nationwide emere kwuru na ha na agwa di ma ọ bụ nwunye ha okwu gbasara ụgwọ nke nlekọta ogologo oge.

rows.source: Only 10 percent said they spoke with their kids about it.
rows.output: Naanị pasentị iri nke ndị ahụ kwuru na ha na ụmụaka ha na-ekwu maka ya.
rows.reference: Naanị pasentị 10 kwuru na ha gwara ụmụaka ha maka ya.

rows.source: "People want a family member to care for them, but they aren't taking the steps to have the conversation," said Holly Snyder, vice president of Nationwide's life insurance business.
rows.output: "Ndị mmadụ chọrọ onye òtù ezinụlọ ka na-elekọta ha, ma ha anaghị ewetara ihe ndị dị mkpa iji nwee mkparịta ụka ahụ," ka Holly Snyder, onye isi ụlọ ọrụ mkpanaka ndụ nke obodo.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ chọrọ ka onye otu ezinụlọ ha lekọta ha, mana ha anaghị eme ihe ọ bụla iji kpaa nkata ahụ,” Holly Snyder kwuru, osote onye isi nke azụmahịa nchekwa ndụ nke Nationwide.

rows.source: Here's where to begin.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ebe ị ga-amalite.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ ebe ị ga-ebido.

rows.source: Talk to your spouse and the kids: You can't prepare your family to provide care if you don't make your wishes known well ahead of time.
rows.output: Gwa di na ụmụ gị: Ị gaghị enwe ike ịkwadebe ezinụlọ gị inye nlekọta ma ọ bụrụ na ị naghị eme ihe ọ bụla gbasara ihe ị chọrọ tupu oge eruo.
rows.reference: Gwa nwunye ma ọ bụ dị gị yana ụmụaka: Ị nweghị ike ịkwadobe ezinụlọ gị iji nye nlekọta ma ọ bụrụ na i kwuputeghi ihe ndị ị chọrọ n’oge.

rows.source: Work with your advisor and your family to discuss where and how to receive care, as those choices can be a significant factor in determining the cost.
rows.output: Na-arụkọ ọrụ na onye ndụmọdụ gị na ezinụlọ gị ka ị kọwaa ebe na otu esi enwetaghị nlekọta, ebe nhọrọ ndị a nwere ike imetụta nnukwu ihe na-emetụta ego ahụ.
rows.reference: Gị na onye ndụmọdụ gị na ezinụlọ gị rụkọta ọrụ iji kpakọrịta ebe yana otu a ga-esi nweta nlekọta, ebe nhọrọ ndị ahụ nwere ike ịbụ ihe ndị dị mkpa na ikpebi ụgwọ ya.

rows.source: Bring in your financial advisor: Your advisor can also help you come up with a way to pay for those expenses.
rows.output: Weta onye ndụmọdụ gị gbasara ego: Onye ndụmọdụ gị nwere ike inye aka na ịmata ụzọ ị ga-esi kwụọ ụgwọ ndị ahụ.
rows.reference: Webata onye ndụmọdụ ego gị: Onye ndụmọdụ nwekwara ike ịnyere gị aka ịtụnye ụzọ iji kwụọ ụgwọ maka mmefu ego ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Your funding choices for long-term care can include a traditional long-term care insurance policy, a hybrid cash-value life insurance policy to help cover these expenses or self-insuring with your own wealth - as long as you have the money.
rows.output: Nhọrọ ego gị maka nlekọta ogologo oge nwere ike ịgụnye atụmatụ nlekọta ogologo oge, atụmatụ ndụ ego hybrid iji nyere aka kpuchie ihe ndị a na-azọpụta onwe gị na akụ gị - ma ọ bụrụhaala na ị nwere ego.
rows.reference: Nhọrọ ego gị maka nlekọta ogologo oge nwere ike ịgụnye iwu nchekwa nlekọta ogologo oge dị adị, iwu nchekwa ndụ uru-ego achịkọtara ọnụ iji nyere gị aka kpuchie mmefu ego ndị a ma ọ bụ nchekwa-onwe site na iji akụ nke gị - ma ị nwee ego ahụ.

rows.source: Hammer out your legal documents: Head off legal battles at the pass.
rows.output: Kụọ akwụkwọ iwu gị: Gbanarị ọgụ iwu n'isi.
rows.reference: Kpaa maka akwụkwọ iwu gị: Kpebie nsogbu iwu n’ohere ahụ.

rows.source: Get a health-care proxy in place so that you designate a trusted individual to oversee your medical care and ensure that professionals comply with your wishes in case you're unable to communicate.
rows.output: Nweta onye na-ahụ maka nlekọta ahụike n'ọnọdụ ka ịhọpụta onye a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi ka ọ na-elekọta ahụike gị ma hụ na ndị ọkachamara na-emezu ọchịchọ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike ịkparịta ụka.
rows.reference: Dowe ihe nnọchite nlekọta-ahụike na njikere ka ị nwee ike ịkenye ya mmadụ atụkwasịrị obi iji hụ maka nlekọta ahụike gị ma gbaa mbọ hụ ndị ọkachamara mezuru na mmasị gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike ikwukọrịta okwu.

rows.source: Also, consider a power of attorney for your finances.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, tụlee ikike nke iwu maka ego gị.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa, tụlee ikike nke ọkaiwu maka ego gị.

rows.source: You would select a trusted person to make financial decisions for you and ensure your bills get paid if you're incapacitated.
rows.output: Ị ga-ahụ onye a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi ka ọ mee mkpebi gbasara ego gị ma hụ na a na-akwụ ụgwọ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike.
rows.reference: Ị ga-ahọpụta otu onye atụkwasịrị obi iji meere gị mkpebi ego ma hụ na akwụrụ ụgwọ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike.

rows.source: Don't forget the small details: Imagine that your elderly parent has a medical emergency and is on the way to the hospital.
rows.output: Echefula nkọwa ndị dị ntakịrị: Chee echiche na nne ma ọ bụ nna ochie gị nwere ihe mberede ahụike ma na-aga n'ụlọ ọgwụ.
rows.reference: Echefuna obere ihe: Chee echiche na nne na nna gị kara nka nwere ihe mberede ahụike ma nọrọ n’ụzọ na aga n’ụlọ ọgwụ.

rows.source: Would you be able to answer questions on medications and allergies?
rows.output: Ị nwere ike ịza ajụjụ gbasara ọgwụ na ihe na-akpasu gị ihe?
rows.reference: Ị ga-enwe ike ịza ajụjụ maka ọgwụ na ihe ndị ha na ezere?

rows.source: Spell out those details in a written plan so that you're ready.
rows.output: Debe nkọwa ndị ahụ n'akwụkwọ atụmatụ ka ị dị njikere.
rows.reference: Kwupute nkọwapụta ndị a n’atụmatụ edere ede ka ị nwee dị njikere.

rows.source: "It's not just the financials that are in play, but who are the doctors?" asked Martin.
rows.output: "Ọ bụghị naanị ego ka dị na ya, ma onye bụ ndị dọkịta?" Martin jụrụ.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị naanị ego ka a na ekwu maka ya, mana kedu ndị bụ dọkịnta ya?” Martin jụrụ.

rows.source: "What are the medications?
rows.output: "Kedu ọgwụ ndị ahụ?
rows.reference: “Gịnị hụ ọgwụ ndị ahụ?

rows.source: Who will care for the dog?
rows.output: Ònyé ga-elekọta nkịta ahụ?
rows.reference: Onye ga-elekọta nkịta?

rows.source: Have that plan in place."
rows.output: Nwee atụmatụ ahụ n'ọnọdụ."
rows.reference: Hazie atụmatụ ahụ."

rows.source: Man shot multiple times with air rifle in Ilfracombe
rows.output: Nwoke ahụ e gburu ọtụtụ ugboro na egwuregwu ikuku n'Ilfracombe
rows.reference: Eji egbe ikuku gbaa otu nwoke ọtụtụ oge na llfracombe

rows.source: A man has been shot multiple times with an air rifle as he walked home from a night out.
rows.output: Otu nwoke e gburu ya ugboro ugboro na egbugbere ọnụ ya ka ọ na-aga n'ụlọ site na abalị.
rows.reference: Ejirila egbe ikuku wee gbaa otu nwoke ọtụtụ oge ka o ji ụkwụ alaghachi ụlọ ka ọ pụchara n’abalị.

rows.source: The victim, in his 40s, was in the Oxford Grove area of Ilfracombe, Devon, when he was shot in the chest, abdomen and hand.
rows.output: Onye ahụ a tọọrụ, n'afọ iri anọ ya, n'ógbè Oxford Grove nke Ilfracombe, Devon, ka a gbara ya n'ubu, afọ na aka.
rows.reference: Onye ọ metụtara, nọ n’afọ 40, nọ n’ogige Oxford Grove nke llfracombe, Devon, mgbe agbara ya egbe n’obi, afọ yana aka.

rows.source: Officers described the shooting, which took place at about 02:30 BST, as a "random act."
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii kọwara ogbugba ahụ, nke mere ihe dị ka elekere abụọ na iri atọ n'ụtụtụ, dị ka "omume na-enweghị isi."
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii kọwara ọgbụgba egbe ahụ, nke mere n’ihe dị ka 02:30 BST, ka “omume na enweghị kpatara ya.”

rows.source: The victim did not see his attacker.
rows.output: Onye ahụ a tọọrụ n’agbataaghị onye gburu ya.
rows.reference: Onye ihe ahụ metụtara ahụghị onye makporo ya.

rows.source: His injuries are not life-threatening and police have appealed for witnesses.
rows.output: Mmerụ ahụ ya adịghị egwu ndụ ma ndị uwe ojii agbalịla ịkpọ ndị akaebe.
rows.reference: Ahụ mmerụ ya abụghị ihe ga-egbu ya, ndị uwe ojii arịọla maka ndị akaebe.

rows.source: Earthquakes and tsunamis in Indonesia
rows.output: Mgbụsị akwụkwọ na idei mmiri na Indonesia
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji na tsunami na Indonesia

rows.source: At least 384 people have been killed by a powerful earthquake and tsunami that hit the Indonesian city of Palu on Friday, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.
rows.output: N'afọ 384, ndị mmadụ e gburu site n'ikpochapụ ala ala na tsunami nke dakwasịrị obodo Palu nke Indonesia na Fraịde, ndị ọrụ kwuru, na ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnwụ a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-abawanye.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe ndị mmadụ 384 nwụrụ ka nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami dara n’obodo Palu nke Indonesia na Fraịde, ndị ọrụ kwuru, atụrụ anya na ọnụọgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ ga-agbakọ.

rows.source: With communications knocked out, relief officials have not been able to get any information from Donggala regency, an area north of Palu that is closer to the epicenter of the 7.5 magnitude quake.
rows.output: N'ihi na nkwukọriri na-anọghị, ndị ọrụ enyemaka enweghị ike nweta ozi ọ bụla site na Donggala regency, mpaghara dị n'ebe ugwu nke Palu nke dị nso n'etiti etiti ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala nke ala
rows.reference: Ka akụpụrụ ụzọ nkwukọrịta, ndị ọrụ enyemaka enwebeghị ike ịnweta ozi ọ bụla n’aka ala ọchịchị Donggala, mpaghara ugwu nke Palu nọketere nso na etiti nke ala ọmajiji 7.5 ahụ.

rows.source: In Palu, more than 16,000 people were evacuated after the disaster struck.
rows.output: N'ime Palu, ihe karịrị mmadụ 16,000 ebugara n'ebe dị nche mgbe ihe mberede ahụ mere.
rows.reference: Na Palu, karịa ndị mmadụ 16,000 kwapụrụ n’ụlọ ka ọdachi ahụ mere.

rows.source: Here are some key facts about Palu and Donggala, on the island of Sulawesi:
rows.output: Nke a bụ ụfọdụ ihe ndị dị mkpa gbasara Palu na Donggala, n'agwaetiti Sulawesi:
rows.reference: Ndị a bụ ụfọdụ eziokwu gbasara Palu na Donggala, n’agwaetiti nke Sulawesi:

rows.source: Palu is the capital of Central Sulawesi province, located at the end of a narrow bay on the west coast of Sulawesi island, with an estimated population of 379,800 in 2017.
rows.output: Palu bụ isi obodo nke Central Sulawesi, dị na njedebe nke ọdụ mmiri dị warara n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke agwaetiti Sulawesi, nwere ihe dị ka mmadụ 379,800 na 2017.
rows.reference: Palụ bụ isi ala nke ogige Central Sulawesi, dị na ngwụcha nke warawara ọnụ mmiri dị na akụkụ mmiri ọdịda anyanwụ agwaetiti Sulawesi, nwere ọnụọgụgụ ndị mmadụ 379,800 na 2017.

rows.source: The city was celebrating its 40th anniversary when the quake and tsunami hit.
rows.output: Obodo ahụ na-eme mmemme nke iri anọ ya mgbe ala ọma jijiji na tsunami mere.
rows.reference: Obodo ahụ nọ na eme emume ncheta 40 ya mgbe ala ọmajiji na tsunami ahụ dara.

rows.source: Donggala is a regency stretching along more than 300 km (180 miles) of coastline in the northwest of Sulawesi island.
rows.output: Donggala bụ ọchịchị na-agbatị n'akụkụ osimiri dị ihe karịrị 300 km (180 kilomita) n'ebe ugwu ọdịda anyanwụ nke agwaetiti Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Donggala bụ ala ọchịchị dọtịrị n’ogologo 300 km (maịlụ 180) nke akụkụ osimiri dị na ọdịda anyanwụ na ugwu nke agwaetiti Sulawesi.

rows.source: The regency, an administrative region below a province, had an estimated population of 299,200 in 2017.
rows.output: Ọchịchị, ógbè ọchịchị dị n'okpuru ógbè, nwere ihe dị ka mmadụ 299,200 n'afọ 2017.
rows.reference: Ala ọchịchị ahụ, mpaghara nchịkwa dị n’okpuru ogige, nwere ọnụọgụgụ ndị mmadụ ekpebiri na 299,200 na 2017.

rows.source: Fishing and farming are the mainstays of the Central Sulawesi province's economy, especially the coastal region of Donggala.
rows.output: Ịkụ azụ na ọrụ ugbo bụ isi ihe na-akwado akụ na ụba nke steeti Central Sulawesi, karịsịa mpaghara ọwụwa anyanwụ nke Donggala.
rows.reference: Ịkọ azụ na ịkọ ugbo bụ isi ọrụ nke akụnụba ogige Central Sulawesi, karịchara mpaghara akụkụ mmiri nke Donggala.

rows.source: Nickel mining is also important in the province, but is mostly concentrated in Morowali, on the opposite coast of Sulawesi.
rows.output: Mmanụ nickel dịkwa mkpa na mpaghara ahụ, mana ọ bụkarị na Morowali, n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Ngwụpụta nickel bụkwa mkpa n’ogige ahụ, mana agbakojuru karịa na Morowali, na nchebe ihu nke Sulawesi.

rows.source: Palu and Donggala have been hit by tsunamis several times in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.
rows.output: Palu na Donggala enweela ọtụtụ idei mmiri n'ime afọ 100 gara aga, dị ka ndị ọrụ na-ahụ maka ihe mberede nke Indonesia siri kwuo.
rows.reference: Tsunami adaala na Palu na Dongalla ọtụtụ oge n’afọ 100 gara aga, nke Ụlọ Ọrụ Mgbochi Ọdachi nke Indonedia kwuru.

rows.source: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of houses in Donggala.
rows.output: N'afọ 1938, ide mmiri ahụ gburu ihe karịrị mmadụ 200 ma bibie ọtụtụ ụlọ n'obodo Donggala.
rows.reference: Na 1938, tsunami gburu karịa ndị mmadụ 200 ma mebie narị kwụrụ narị ụlọ na Donggala.

rows.source: A tsunami also struck western Donggala in 1996, killing nine.
rows.output: Mmiri tsunami dakwara n'ebe ugwu Donggala n'afọ 1996, gburu mmadụ itoolu.
rows.reference: Otu tsunami dakwara n’akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ Donggala na 1996, na egbu itoolu.

rows.source: Indonesia sits on the seismically Pacific Ring of Fire and is regularly hit by earthquakes.
rows.output: Indonishia nọ n'elu Pacific Ring of Fire nke na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe na-eme ka ọ na-eme ihe
rows.reference: Indonesia tukwu n’etiti Pacific Ring of Fire, ala ọmajiji na akụ ya kwa oge.

rows.source: Here are some of the major quakes and tsunamis in recent years:
rows.output: Nke a bụ ụfọdụ n'ime ihe ndị dị mkpa mere n'afọ ndị na-adịbeghị anya:
rows.reference: Ndị bụ ụfọdụ nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami n’afọ nso nso:

rows.source: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: Mgbagha dị ukwuu n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke Indonesia's Aceh Province na northern Sumatra na Disemba 26 kpalitere tsunami nke metụrụ mba 14, na-egbu mmadụ 226,000 n'akụkụ oké osimiri India, ihe karịrị ọkara n'ime ha n'Aceh.
rows.reference: 2004: Nnukwu ala ọmajiji n’akụkụ osimiri ọdịda anyanwụ nke ogige Aceh Indonesia dị n’akụkụ ugwu Sumatra na Dis. 26 kpalitere tsunami kụrụ obodo 14, na egbu ndị mmadụ 226,000 n’ogologo akụkụ osimiri nke Nnukwu Osimiri India, karịa ọkara ha nọ na Aceh.

rows.source: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.
rows.output: 2005: Otu usoro nke nnukwu ala ọma jijiji kụrụ n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke Sumatra n'oge ikpeazụ nke Maachị na mmalite nke Eprel.
rows.reference: 2005: Nsotanso nnukwu ala ọmajiji kụrụ akụkụ osimiri ọdịda anyanwụ nke Sumatra na ngwụcha Machị yana na mbido Eprel.

rows.source: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.
rows.output: Puku ndị mmadụ nwụrụ na agwaetiti Nias, n'akụkụ ọwụwa anyanwụ nke Sumatra.
rows.reference: Narị kwụrụ narị nwụrụ na Agwaetiti Nias, na mpụga akụkụ osimiri nke Sumatra.

rows.source: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.
rows.output: 2006: Mmetụta 6.8 n'ogologo mere n'ebe ndịda nke Java, agwaetiti Indonesia nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ kasị ukwuu, na-ebute idei mmiri nke gburu ihe dị ka mmadụ 700 n'akụkụ ndịda.
rows.reference: 2006: Ọmajiji 6.8 kụrụ akụkụ ndịda nke Java, agwaetiti nke Indonesia kachasị nwee mmadụ, na akpalite tsunami jiri iwe daa na akụkụ osimiri nke ndịda, na egbu ihe ruru ndị mmadụ 700.

rows.source: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.
rows.output: 2009: Mgbọrọgwụ ala nke 7.6 mere n'akụkụ obodo Padang, isi obodo West Sumatra.
rows.reference: 2009: Ala ọmajiji ruru 7.6 dara n’akụkụ obodo Padang, isi ala nke ogige West Sumatra.

rows.source: More than 1,100 people were killed.
rows.output: Karịa mmadụ 1,100 nwụrụ.
rows.reference: Egburu ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ 1,100.

rows.source: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.
rows.output: 2010: Mgbọrọgwụ ala nke 7.5 n'ogologo mere n'otu n'ime agwaetiti Mentawai, n'akụkụ Sumatra, na-ebute oke idei mmiri nke ruru 10 mita nke bibiri ọtụtụ obodo ma gbuo ihe dị ka mmadụ 300.
rows.reference: 2010: Ọmajiji 7.5 dara n’otu agwaetiti Mentawai, na mpụga Sumatra, na akpalite tsunami ruru mita 10 nke mebiri ọtụtụ ime obodo ma gbuo ndị mmadụ ruru 300.

rows.source: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.
rows.output: 2016: Mgbagwojuru ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala ala
rows.reference: 2016: Obere ọmajiji kụrụ ala ọchịchị Pidie Jaya dị na Aceh, na ebute mmebi na ọgbaghara na echetere ndị mmadụ mmebi nke ọmajiji na tsunami 2004 gburu ọtụtụ.

rows.source: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị tsunami ebugara n'oge a, mana ihe karịrị 100 nwụrụ site na ihe ndị dara.
rows.reference: Enweghị tsunami akpalitere n’oge a, mana ụlọ ndị na ada gburu karịa ndị mmadụ 100.

rows.source: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.
rows.output: 2018: Mgbụsị akwụkwọ buru ibu mere n'agwaetiti Lombok nke ndị njem nleta nke Indonesia, gburu ihe karịrị mmadụ 500, nke ka ukwuu n'akụkụ ugwu nke agwaetiti ahụ.
rows.reference: 2018: Nnukwu ọla ọmajiji dara n’agwaetiti ndị njem nke Lombok dị na Indonesia, na egbu karịa ndị mmadụ 500, karịchara n’akụkụ ugwu nke agwaetiti ahụ.

rows.source: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.
rows.output: Mgbagha ahụ bibiri puku puku ụlọ ma hapụ puku puku ndị njem nleta ka ha nọrọ n'ụgbọ mmiri.
rows.reference: Ọmajiji ahụ mebiri puku kwụrụ puku ụlọ ma hapụ ụfọdụ ndị njem na nsogbu ntakịrị oge.

rows.source: Sarah Palin's Eldest Son Arrested on Domestic Violence Charges
rows.output: Nwunye Sarah Palin, bụ́ nwanyị mbụ nke Alaska, bụ́ Sarah Palin, ka a nwụchirila maka ebubo ime ihe ike n'ime ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ejidere Nwa Nwoke Sarah Palin Tọchara N’ihi Ebubo Ịmekwasị Mmadụ Ihe Ike

rows.source: Track Palin, the eldest son of former Alaska governor and vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on assault charges.
rows.output: Nwoke Palin, nwa mbụ nke onye bụbu gọvanọ Alaska na onye na-azọ ọkwa onye isi ala Sarah Palin, ejidela maka ebubo mwakpo.
rows.reference: Track Palin, nwa nwoke tọchara nke gọvanọ Alaska gara aga yana osote onye nhọpụta isi ala Sarah Palin, ka ejidere maka ebubo ịmekwasị mmadụ ihe ike.

rows.source: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on suspicion of domestic violence, interfering with a report of domestic violence and resisting arrest, according to a report released Saturday by Alaska State Troopers.
rows.output: Palin, 29, nke Wasilla, Alaska, ka nwudoro n'ihi na a na-enyo enyo na ọ na-emegbu mmadụ n'ime ụlọ, na-egbochi akụkọ banyere ime ihe ike n'ime ụlọ, na ịgbanarị ijide ya, dị ka akụkọ e wepụtara na Satọdee site n'aka Alaska State Troopers.
rows.reference: Ejidere Palin, 29, nke Wasilla, Alaska, na nyocha nke ịmekwasị mmadụ ihe ike, na etinye aka na mkpesa nke mmekwasị ihe ike yana igbochi njide, site na mkpesa Alaska State Troopers buputere na Satọde.

rows.source: According to the police report, when a female acquaintance attempted to call police to report the alleged crimes, he took her phone from her.
rows.output: N'ime akụkọ ndị uwe ojii, mgbe otu nwanyị na-akọwata ya nwaa ịkpọ ndị uwe ojii ka ha kọọ ebubo ahụ, o wepụrụ ekwentị ya.
rows.reference: Site na mkpesa ndị uwe ojii ahụ, mgbe otu enyi nwanyị nwara ịkpọ ndị uwe ojii iji kpesa mpụ eboro na ebubo, ọ were ekwentị ya n’aka ya.

rows.source: Palin is being remanded in Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 unsecured bond, reported KTUU.
rows.output: A na-ejide Palin n'ụlọ mkpọrọ Mat-Su Pretrial ma na-ejigide ya n'ụgwọ $500 na-enweghị ihe mkpuchi, dị ka KTUU si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ejidere Palin na Ewumewu Tupu-Ikpe Mat-Su, ejidere ya na bọnd na enweghị nchekwa $500, nke kTUU kpesara.

rows.source: He appeared in court Saturday, where he declared himself "not guilty, for sure" when asked his plea, reported the network.
rows.output: Ọ pụtaworo n'ụlọikpe n'ụbọchị Satọdee, ebe o kwuru na ya bụ "enweghị ikpe, n'ezie" mgbe a jụrụ ya maka ikpe ya, ka netwọkọ ahụ kọrọ.
rows.reference: Ọ pụtara n’ụlọ ikpe na Satọde, ebe ọ kọwara onwe ya “ka ọ onye aka dị ọcha, n’ezie” mgbe ajụrụ ya arịrịọ ya, netwọk ahụ kpesara.

rows.source: Palin faces three Class A misdemeanours, meaning he could be imprisoned for up to a year and fined $250,000.
rows.output: Palin na-eche ihu na mpụ klaasị A atọ, nke pụtara na ọ nwere ike ịnọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ ruo afọ otu na ụgwọ $250,000.
rows.reference: Palin na eche mpụ Klaasị A ato, ọ pụtara enwere ike ịtụ ya nga ruo otu afọ ma ọ bụ daa ya nra $250,000.

rows.source: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.
rows.output: Ọ na-ebo ebubo maka mpụ klaasị B, nke a na-akwụ ụgwọ site n'ụbọchị nga na ụgwọ $2,000.
rows.reference: Eboola ya ebubo nke mpụ Klaasị B, enwere ike iji otu ụbọchị n’ime nga ma ọ bụ nra $2,000 wee nye ntaramahụhụ ya.

rows.source: It is not the first time criminal charges have been filed against Palin.
rows.output: Ọ bụghị oge mbụ e debere ebubo mpụ megide Palin.
rows.reference: Ọ bụghị ebubo mpụ nke izizi a na etinye maka Palin.

rows.source: In December 2017, he was accused of assaulting his father, Todd Palin.
rows.output: N'ọnwa Disemba afọ 2017, a na-ebo ya ebubo na ọ na-akpagbu nna ya, Todd Palin.
rows.reference: Na Disemba 2017, eboro ya ebubo nke ịmekwasị nna ya ihe ike, Todd Palin.

rows.source: His mother, Sarah Palin, called police to report the alleged attack.
rows.output: Nne ya, Sarah Palin, mere ka ndị uwe ojii kpọọ ka ha kọọ ihe mere.
rows.reference: Nne ya, Sarah Palin, kpọrọ ndị uwe ojii iji kpesa mbuso agha ahụ eboro n’ebubo.

rows.source: The case is currently before Alaska's Veteran's Court.
rows.output: Ihe a na-ekwu ugbu a n'ihu Ụlọikpe ndị agha Alaska.
rows.reference: Okwu ahụ nọ n’ihu Ụlọ Ikpe nke Ndị Agha Ochie nke Alaska.

rows.source: In January 2016 he was charged with domestic assault, interfering with the report of a domestic violence crime, and possessing a weapon while intoxicated in connection with the incident.
rows.output: N'ọnwa Jenụwarị afọ 2016, a mara ya ikpe maka ịwakpo n'ụlọ, ime ka a kọọ ihe gbasara ime ihe ike n'ụlọ, na inwe ngwa agha mgbe ọ na-aṅụbiga mmanya ókè n'ihe metụtara ihe ahụ.
rows.reference: Na Jenụwarị 2016 agbara ya akwụkwọ maka ịmekwasị mmadụ ihe ike, itinye aka na mpụ ịmekwasị mmadụ ihe ihe, yana iji ngwaọgụ ka mmanya na egbu ya na njikọ nke okwu ahụ.

rows.source: His girlfriend had alleged that he punched her in the face.
rows.output: Nwunye ya kwuru na ọ kụrụ ya ihu.
rows.reference: Enyi ya nwanyị boro ya ebubo na ọ kụrụ ya ọkpọ n’ihu.

rows.source: Sarah Palin was criticised by veterans groups in 2016 after linking her son's violent behaviour to PTSD stemming from his service in Iraq.
rows.output: N'afọ 2016, ndị otu ndị agha katara Sarah Palin maka na ọ na-ejikọta omume ime ihe ike nke nwa ya nwoke na PTSD nke sitere na ọrụ ya na Iraq.
rows.reference: Ndị agha ochie kọtọrọ Sarah Palin na 2016 ka ejikọchara omume ihe ike nwa ya na PTSD bidoro n’ọrụ ya na Iraq.

rows.source: Indonesia earthquake tsunami: hundreds killed
rows.output: Mgbụsị akwụkwọ ala ala Indonesia: ọtụtụ ndị e gburu
rows.reference: Tsunami ala ọmajiji Indonesia: egburu narị

rows.source: At least 384 people have died after an earthquake hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi on Friday.
rows.output: N'afọ 384, ndị mmadụ nwụrụ ka ala ọma jijiji dakwasịrị agwaetiti Sulawesi nke Indonesia na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe ndị mmadụ 384 anwụọla ka ala ọmajiji dara na agwaetiti nke Sulawesi nke Indonesia na Fraịde.

rows.source: The 7.5-magnitude earthquake triggered a tsunami and has destroyed thousands of homes.
rows.output: Mgbụsị akwụkwọ 7.5-magnitude ahụ kpalitere tsunami ma bibie puku ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji ruru ike 7.5 kpalitere tsunami ma mebie puku kwụrụ puku n’ụlọ.

rows.source: Electricity and communication networks are down with death tolls expected to rise in coming days.
rows.output: Ọkụ eletrik na netwọkụ nkwurịta okwu agbanyụrụ, a na-atụ anya na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ ga-abawanye n'ụbọchị ndị na-abịa.
rows.reference: Netwọk latrik na nkwukọrịta mebiri emebi, ebe atụrụ anya na ndị nwụrụ anwụ ga-agbago n’ụbọchị ndị na-abịa.

rows.source: The earthquake hit just off central Sulawesi which is northeast of the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.
rows.output: Mgbụsị ahụ ahụ kụrụ n'akụkụ etiti Sulawesi, nke dị n'ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ nke isi obodo Indonesia, Jakarta.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji ahụ dara na obere mpụga etiti Sulawesi nke bụ akụkụ ọwụwa anyanwụ na ugwu nke isi ala Indonesia, Jakarta.

rows.source: Videos are circulating on social media showing the moment of impact.
rows.output: Vidiyo na-aga n'ihu na mgbasa ozi ọha na eze na-egosi oge mmetụta.
rows.reference: Vidio ndị na agagharị n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze gosiri oge ọ dara.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a beach festival in the city of Palu when the tsunami smashed on shore.
rows.output: Ndị mmadụ nọ n'ọtụtụ narị mmadụ gbakọtara maka mmemme n'akụkụ osimiri n'obodo Palu mgbe tsunami ahụ dakwasịrị n'akụkụ osimiri.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ narị ndị mmadụ kpokọtara maka emume akụkụ osimiri n’obodo nke Palu mgbe tsunami ji iwe daa n’akụkụ mmiri ahu.

rows.source: Federal prosecutors seeking rare death penalty for NYC terror attack suspect
rows.output: Ndị ọka ikpe gọọmentị na-achọ ikpe ọnwụ dị oke egwu maka onye a na-enyo enyo na mwakpo ime ihe ike na NYC
rows.reference: Ndị ọkaikpe etiti obodo na achụ ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ maka onye a na enyo enyo maka agha ụjọ mere na NYC

rows.source: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.
rows.output: Ndị ọka iwu gọọmentị etiti na New York na-achọ ikpe ọnwụ maka Sayfullo Saipov, onye a na-enyo enyo maka mwakpo iyi ọha egwu na New York City nke gburu mmadụ asatọ -- ikpe ọnwụ na-adịghị eme na steeti ahụ maka mpụ gọọmentị etiti kemgbe 1953.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkaikpe nọ na New York na achọ ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ maka Sayfullo Saipov, onye a na enyo enyo na agha ụjọ mere na New York nke gburu ndị mmadụ asatọ -- ntaramahụhụ na adịkabeghị nke emebeghị na steeti ahụ maka mpụ etiti obodo ọ bụla kemgbe 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, 30, allegedly used a Home Depot rental truck to carry out an attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, mowing down pedestrians and cyclist in his path on Oct.
rows.output: Saipov, iri atọ, bụ onye a na-ebo ebubo na o ji ụgbọ ala ụlọ Depot Home mee ihe n'ụzọ ụgbọ ala dị n'akụkụ West Side na Lower Manhattan, na-akụtu ndị na-agagharị n'okporo ụzọ na onye na-agba igwe n'ụzọ ya na Ọktoba.
rows.reference: Saipov, 30, eboro ya ebubo ji gwongworo mgbaziri Home Depot wee mee ihe egwu ahụ n’ụzọ anyịnya igwe dị n’ogologo West Highway dị na Lower Manhattan, na ebetu ndị ji ụkwụ aga yana ndị na akwọ anyịnya igwe n’ụzọ ya na Ọkt.

rows.source: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.
rows.output: Iji mee ka ikpe ọnwụ, ndị ọka iwu ga-enwe ihe akaebe na Saipov "n'uche" gburu ndị mmadụ asatọ ahụ na "n'uche" kpatara mmerụ ahụ siri ike, dị ka akwụkwọ a na-ekwu na ha chọrọ ikpe ọnwụ, edebere na Southern District of New York.
rows.reference: Iji gosi ihe kpatara ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ ji dị mma, ndị ọkaikpe ga-egosi na Saipov “kpachara anya” gbuo ndị mmadụ asatọ ma “kpachara anya” merụọ ndị mmadụ nnukwu ahụ, site n’ọkwa nke ebumnuche iji chọọ ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ, nke Southern District nke New York gbara n’akwụkwọ.

rows.source: Both of those counts carry a possibly death sentence, according to the court document.
rows.output: Ha abụọ ahụ nwere ihe dị ka ikpe ọnwụ, dị ka akwụkwọ ikpe ahụ si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ebubo abụọ ndị a nwere ike ibu ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ, site n’aka akwụkwọ ụlọ ikpe ahụ.

rows.source: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.
rows.output: Mgbe mwakpo ahụ gasịrị, otu ndị ọka ikpe etiti nyere Saipov ikpe 22, nke gụnyere ikpe asatọ nke igbu mmadụ n'enyemaka nke racketeering, nke a na-ejikarị ndị ọka ikpe etiti na ikpe mpụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Izu sotechara mbuso agha ahụ, ndị otu ikpe etiti obodo manyere Saipov ebubo ngụ-22 nke gụnyere ebubo asatọ maka igbu mmadụ n’enyemaka nke izu oyi, nke ndị ọkaikpe etiti obodo na ejikarị n’okwu ajọ mpu, yana ebubo nke ihe ike na mmebi nke ụgbọ ala.

rows.source: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."
rows.output: Mwakpo ahụ chọrọ "atụmatụ dị ukwuu na atụmatụ," ndị ọka iwu kwuru, na-akọwa ụdị nke Saipov mere ya dị ka "ihe ọjọọ, obi ọjọọ na obi ọjọọ."
rows.reference: Mbuso agha ahụ chọrọ “nhazi na ntụle echiche dị ọkpụrụkpụ,” ndị ọkaikpe kwuru, na akọwara omume nke Saipov jiri mee ya ka “arụ, jọrọ njọ na mmetọ.”

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.
rows.output: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov kpatara mmerụ ahụ, mmerụ ahụ, na mfu nye ezinụlọ na ndị enyi nke Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, na Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," o kwuru na nkwupụta nke ebumnobi.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov butere mmerụ ahụ, mmekpa ahụ, na mbibi maka ezinụlọ na ndị enyi nke Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, na Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," ọkwa nke ebumnuche kwuru.

rows.source: Five of the victims were tourists from Argentina.
rows.output: Ndị mmadụ ise ahụ bụ ndị njem nleta si Argentina.
rows.reference: Mmadụ ise nke ndị ahụ emetụtara bụ ndị njem si Argentina bịara ịlegharị anya.

rows.source: It has been a decade since the Southern District of New York last prosecuted a death penalty case.
rows.output: Ọ dịla afọ iri kemgbe mpaghara ndịda nke New York gbara ikpe ikpe ọnwụ ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụla otu afọ iri kemgbe Southern District nke New York kpere ikpe okwu ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ.

rows.source: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was convicted of murdering two drug suppliers but was ultimately sentenced to life in prison in September 2009.
rows.output: Onye ikpe, Khalid Barnes, mara ikpe maka igbu mmadụ abụọ na-enye ọgwụ, mana n'ikpeazụ, a mara ya ikpe ka ọ nọrọ ndụ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ na Septemba 2009.
rows.reference: Onye ahụ eboro ebubo, Khalid Barnes, nwetara amamikpe nke igbu mmadu abụọ na ere ọgwụ ike mana emechara tụọ ya nga ndụ ya niile n’ikpeazụ na Septamba 2009.

rows.source: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.
rows.output: Oge ikpeazụ e ji ikpe ọnwụ mee na ikpe gọọmentị etiti dị na New York bụ na 1953 maka Julius na Ethel Rosenberg, di na nwunye a mara ikpe maka ịbọ ọbọ maka Soviet Union n'oge Agha Nzuzo afọ abụọ tupu.
rows.reference: Oge ikpeazụ emere ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ na okwu etiti obodo nke New York bụ na 1953 maka Julius na Ethel Rosenberg, di na nwunye egburu ka amachara ha ikpe maka ịkpa nkata iji mee ọrụ sabo maka Soviet Union n’oge Cold War afọ abụọ ya gara aga.

rows.source: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.output: Ndị Rosenbergs abụọ ahụ e gburu ha site n'iji oche eletrik na June 19, 1953.
rows.reference: Eji oche latrik wee gbuo Rosenberg abụọ ahụ na Juun 19, 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, a native of Uzbekistan, demonstrated a lack of remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.
rows.output: Saipov, onye si mụrụ na Uzbekistan, egosighi mwute n'ime ụbọchị na ọnwa ndị na-esote mwakpo ahụ, dị ka akwụkwọ ikpe si kwuo.
rows.reference: Saipov, onye amaala nke Uzbekistan, gosiri enweghị obi mmadụ n’ụbọchị na ọnwa sotere mbuso agha ahụ, nke akwụkwọ ụlọ ikpe gosipụtara.

rows.source: He stated to investigators that he felt good about what he had done, police said.
rows.output: Ọ gwara ndị nchọpụta na ọ nwere obi ụtọ maka ihe o mere, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.
rows.reference: Ọ gwara ndị nyocha na ihe ọ mere dị ya mma, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.

rows.source: Saipov told authorities he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the indictment.
rows.output: Saipov gwara ndị ọchịchị na ọ bụ ISIS videos mere ka o kwenye ime mwakpo ahụ, dị ka ebubo ahụ si kwuo.
rows.reference: Saipov gwara ndị ikikere na ihe kpalitere ya ịme mbuso agha ahụ bụ ka ọ lelechara vidio ndị ISIS n’ekwentị ya, nke ebubo ahụ gosiri.

rows.source: He also requested to display the ISIS flag in his hospital room, police said.
rows.output: Ọ rịọkwara ka e gosi ọkachamara ISIS n'ime ụlọ ọgwụ ya, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.
rows.reference: Ọ rịọkwara ka o gosipụta ọkọlọtọ ISIS n’ime ụlọ ọgwụ ya, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.

rows.source: He has pleaded not guilty to the 22-count indictment.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwu na ọ bụghị onye ikpe mara ikpe iri abụọ na abụọ.
rows.reference: Ọ rịọla na aka ya dị ọcha n’ebubo ngụ-22 ahụ.

rows.source: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders representing Saipov, said they are "obviously disappointed" with the prosecution's decision.
rows.output: David Patton, otu n'ime ndị na-ahụ maka ikpe n'ụlọ ikpe etiti na-anọchi anya Saipov, kwuru na ha "n'ụzọ doro anya na-ewute" maka mkpebi ikpe ikpe.
rows.reference: David Patton, otu n’ime ndị mgbachite etiti obodo maka ọhaneze na anọchite Saipov, kwuru ha nwere “nnukwu mwute” maka mkpebi nke ikpe ahụ.

rows.source: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.
rows.output: "Anyị kwenyere na mkpebi ị chọọ ikpe ọnwụ kama ịnakwere ikpe ikpe na ndụ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ na-enweghị ohere ịhapụ ga-eme ka ahụmihe mgbu nke ihe omume ndị a na-adịgide adịgide maka onye ọ bụla metụtara," Patton kwuru.
rows.reference: “Anyị chere na mkpebi iji chọọ ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ kama ịnara arịrịọ ikpe ọmụma maka ndụ niile n’ime nga na enweghị ohere nke nhapụ naanị ga-adọtịkwu ụjọ nke mmemme ndị ahụ maka mmadụ niile emetụtara,” Patton kwuru.

rows.source: Saipov's defense team had previously asked prosecutors not to seek the death penalty.
rows.output: Otu ndị ọka iwu Saipov jụrụ ndị ọka ikpe ka ha gharaịchọ ikpe ọnwụ.
rows.reference: Otu mgbachite nke Saipov arịọbuola ndị ọkaikpe ka ha hapụ ịchọ ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ.

rows.source: Tory MP says NIGEL FARAGE should be put in charge of Brexit negotiations
rows.output: Onye otu pati Tory kwuru na e kwesịrị itinye NIGEL FARAGE n'isi mkparita ụka Brexit
rows.reference: MP Tory kwuru na ekwesịrị itinye NIGEL FARAGE n’isi nke ụbụbọ Brexit

rows.source: Nigel Farage vowed to 'mobilise the people's army' today during a protest at the Tory conference.
rows.output: Nigel Farage kwere nkwa ịkpọku "ndị agha ndị mmadụ" taa n'oge ngagharị iwe na nzukọ ndị Tory.
rows.reference: Nigel Farage kwere nkwa “izukọta ndị agha nke igwe mmadụ’ taa n’oge ngagharị iwe n’ọgbakọ Tory.

rows.source: The former Ukip leader said politicians had to 'feel the heat' from Eurosceptics - as one of Theresa May's own MPs suggested he should be in charge of negotiations with the EU.
rows.output: Onye bụbu onye isi Ukip kwuru na ndị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị ga-enwe mmetụta 'okpomoku' site n'aka ndị na-emegide EU - dịka otu n'ime ndị otu Theresa May kwuru na ọ ga-abụ onye na-ahụ maka mkparịta ụka na EU.
rows.reference: Onye ndu Ukip gara aga kwuru na ndị ndọrọndọrọ kwesịrị ‘ịnweta okpomọkụ’ sitere n’aka ndị Eurosceptics - ebe otu n’ime ndị MP nke Theresa May tụnyere na ọ kwesịrị ị nọ n’isi nke ụbụbọ ahụ dị n’etiti EU.

rows.source: Conservative backbencher Peter Bone told the march in Birmingham that the UK 'would have been out' by now if Mr Farage was Brexit Secretary.
rows.output: Onye ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị Conservative Peter Bone gwara ndị na-eme njem na Birmingham na UK gaara "apụ" ugbu a ma ọ bụrụ na Mr Farage bụ onye Brexit Secretary.
rows.reference: Onye oche azụ Conservative Peter Bone gwara igwe mmadụ nọ na Birmingham na UK “ga-apụgo’ ma ọ bụrụ na Maazị Farage bụ Ọde Akwụkwọ Brexit.

rows.source: But the challenge Mrs May faces in reconciling her deeply divided ranks has been underlined by pro-Remain Tories joining a separate protest against Brexit in the city.
rows.output: Ma, ihe ịma aka Oriakụ May na-eme ka ndị otu ya dị n'otu, bụ nke e ji aka na-ewute ndị na-akwado Brexit na-eme ngagharị iwe na obodo ahụ.
rows.reference: Mana mgba Nwada May na eche bụ na ijikọtagharị ndị otu ya kewagoro ukwuu bụ ihe pụtara ihie ka ndị na akwado Ịnọrọ Na Tory sonyere ngagharị iwe dị iche na egbochi Brexit n’obodo ahụ.

rows.source: The premier is struggling to keep her Chequers compromise plan on track amid attacks from Brexiteers, Remainers and the EU.
rows.output: Onye isi ala ahụ na-agbasi mbọ ike ka ọ na-edobe atụmatụ Chequers ya na-aga n'ihu n'etiti mwakpo sitere n'aka ndị na-akwado Brexit, ndị na-emegide Brexit na EU.
rows.reference: Onye isi ahụ na enwe nhịahụ idowe atụmatụ nkwekọrịta Chequers ya n’usoro n’etiti mbuso agha sitere n’aka Brexiteers, Remainers na EU.

rows.source: Allies insisted she will push ahead with trying to strike a deal with Brussels despite the backlash - and force Eurosceptics and Labour to choose between her package and 'chaos'.
rows.output: Ndị otu ahụ na-arụsi ọrụ ike na ọ ga-aga n'ihu na-agbalị ime ka ọ dị mma na Brussels n'agbanyeghị azịza ya - ma mee ka ndị na-emegide Europe na Labour họrụ n'etiti ngwugwu ya na 'ọgba aghara'.
rows.reference: Ndị njikọ siri ọnwụ na ọ ga-aga n’ihu ịnwa ịnweta nkwekọrịta yana Brussels na agbanyeghị nkwutọ ahụ - ma manye Eurosceptics na Labour ịhọrọ n’ime ngwungwu ya na ‘ọgbaghara’.

rows.source: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.
rows.output: Mazi Bone gwara ndị na-eme mkpagharị na Solihull na ọ chọrọ "ịtụpụ Chequers".
rows.reference: Maazị Bone gwara otu mgbakọ Leave Means Leave na Solihull na ọ chọrọ ‘itufu Chequers’.

rows.source: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.
rows.output: O kwuru na a ga-eme Mr Farage onye ọka ikpe ma nye ya ọrụ maka ịkọrịta okwu na Brussels.
rows.reference: Ọ tụnyere na ekwesịrị ịme Maazị Farage onye otu ma nye ya ọrụ maka ụbụbọ dị n’etiti Brussels.

rows.source: 'If he had been in charge, we would have been out by now,' he said.
rows.output: 'Ọ bụrụ na ọ nọ n'isi, anyị ga-apụla ugbu a,' ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: ‘Ọ bụrụ na ọ nọ n’isi, anyị kwesịrị ịpụgo ugbu a,’ o kwuru.

rows.source: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'
rows.output: Onye nnọchi anya Wellingborough kwuru: 'M ga-anọgide na-akwado Brexit mana anyị kwesịrị ịtụpụ Chequers.'
rows.reference: MP Wellingborough ahụ tinyere: ‘M ga-akwụrụ ọtọ maka Brexit mana anyị kwesịrị itufu Chequers.’

rows.source: Setting out his opposition to the EU, he said: 'We didn't fight world wars to be subservient.
rows.output: N'ikwesị na EU, o kwuru: "Anyị akwụghị agha ụwa ka anyị bụrụ ndị na-arụ ọrụ.
rows.reference: Na ekwupute nkwugide ya maka EU, o kwuru: “Anyị alụghị ọgụ ụwa iji bụrụ ndị nrube isi.

rows.source: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'
rows.output: Anyị chọrọ ime iwu nke anyị n'obodo nke anyị.
rows.reference: Anyị chọrọ ịme iwu nke anyị n’obodo anyị.’

rows.source: Mr Bone dismissed suggestions that public opinion had changed since the 2016 vote: 'The idea that the British people have changed their minds and want to remain is completely untrue.'
rows.output: Mazi Bone jụrụ aro na echiche ọha na eze agbanweela kemgbe ntuli aka nke 2016: 'Echiche na ndị Britain agbanweela echiche ha ma chọọ ka ha nọrọ, bụ ihe na-ezighị ezi kpamkpam.'
rows.reference: Maazị Boone tufuru ntụnye na echiche ọhaneze agbanweela kemgbe ntuli aka 2016: ‘Alo na ndị Britain agbanweela uche ha ma chọọ ịnọrọ abụghị eziokwu ma ncha.’

rows.source: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was also at the march, telling reporters: 'I am simply saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.
rows.output: Onye na-akwado Brexit Tory Andrea Jenkyns nwekwara na ngagharị ahụ, na-ekwu na ndị nta akụkọ: 'Ana m asị: Onye isi ala, gee ntị n'oké ndị mmadụ.
rows.reference: Onye nkwado Brexit nke Tory Andrea Jenkyns nọkwa na mgbakọ ahụ, na agwa ndị nta akụkọ: ‘Naanị ihe m na ekwu: Praịm Minista, gee ndị mmadụ ntị.

rows.source: 'Chequers is unpopular with the general public, the Opposition's not going to vote for it, it's unpopular with our party and our activists who actually pound the streets and get us elected in the first place.
rows.output: Chequers adịghị ewu ewu n'etiti ọha mmadụ, ndị Opposition agaghị eme ya, ọ bụghị ewu ewu n'etiti pati anyị na ndị na-eme ihe n'okporo ámá bụ ndị na-eme ka anyị họpụta na mbụ.
rows.reference: ‘Ọtụtụ ndị ọhaneze amasịghị Chequers, Ndị Nkwugide agaghị atuli aka maka ya, ndị otu ndọrọndọrọ na ndị mmume anyị amasịghi ya, ndị nke na agagharị n’okporo ụzọ wee hụ na ahọpụtara anyị.

rows.source: Please drop Chequers and start listening.'
rows.output: Biko tụfuo Chequers ma malite ige ntị.'
rows.reference: Biko hapụ Chequers ma bido ịge ntị.’

rows.source: In a pointed message to Mrs May, she added: 'Prime ministers keep their jobs when they keep their promises.'
rows.output: N'okwu pụtara ìhè nye Oriakụ May, o tinyere: 'Ndị isi ala na-edebe ọrụ ha mgbe ha na-edobe nkwa ha.'
rows.reference: N’ozi atụrụ Nwada May, o kwuru: ‘Ndị praịm minista na edowe ọrụ ha mgbe ha dowere nkwa ha.’

rows.source: Mr Farage told the rally politicians must be made to 'feel the heat' if they were about to betray the decision made in the 2016 referendum.
rows.output: Nna-ukwu Farage gwara nnọkọ ahụ na ndị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị ga-enwe mmetụta "okpomoku" ma ọ bụrụ na ha na-atụ anya ịghọgbuo mkpebi e mere na ntuli aka nke afọ 2016.
rows.reference: Maazị Farage gwara ndị mgbakọ ahụ na ndị ndọrọndọrọ kwesịrị “ịnweta okpomọkụ ahụ’ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ ịgbarapụ mkpebi emere na nhọpụta 2016.

rows.source: 'This is now about a matter of trust between us - the people - and our political class,' he said.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ugbu a gbasara ntụkwasị obi n'etiti anyị - ndị mmadụ - na ndị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị anyị.
rows.reference: ‘Nke a ugbu a bụ okwu nke ntụkwasị obi n’etiti anyị - ndị mmadụ - yana otu ndị ndọrọndọrọ anyị,’ o kwuru.

rows.source: 'They are trying to betray Brexit and we are here today to tell them 'we won't let you get away with doing that'.'
rows.output: Ha na-agbalị ịghọgbuo Brexit na anyị nọ ebe a taa ịgwa ha 'agaghị anyị ekwe ka ị mee nke ahụ.'
rows.reference: ‘Ha na anwa ịgbarapụ Brexit mana anyị nọ ebe a taa iji gwa ha ‘anyị agaghị ahapụ unu ma unu mee nke ahụ’.’

rows.source: In a message to the enthusiastic crowd he added: 'I want you to make our political class, who are on the verge of betraying Brexit, feel the heat.
rows.output: N'okwu ozi nye ndị na-akwado ya, o tinyere: 'Achọrọ m ka ị mee ka klaasị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị anyị, ndị na-adị njikere ịghọgbuo Brexit, nwee ahụ ọkụ.
rows.reference: N’ozi maka igwe mmadụ mmụọ ha gbalitegoro o tinyere: ‘Achọrọ ka unu mee otu ndị ndọrọndọrọ anyị, ndị nọ n’isi nke ịgbarapụ Brexit, ka ha hụta okpomọkụ ahụ.

rows.source: 'We are mobilising the people's army of this country that gave us victory in Brexit and will never rest until we have become an independent, self-governing, proud United Kingdom.'
rows.output: Anyị na-eme ka ndị agha nke mba a nyere anyị mmeri na Brexit na-aga n'ihu ruo mgbe anyị ga-abụ mba nwere onwe ya, na-achị onwe ya, na-enwe obi ụtọ United Kingdom.
rows.reference: ‘Anyị na ezukọta ndị agha igwe mmadụ nke obodo a nyere anyị mmeri na Brexit, anyị agaghị ezu ike ruo mgbe anyị bụrụkwara United Kingdom nke nnwere onwe, na achịkwa onwe ya, nwere ugwu.’

rows.source: Meanwhile, Remainers marched through Birmingham before holding a two-hour rally in the city centre.
rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, ndị na-anọgide na-anọgide na-eme njem n'obodo Birmingham tupu ha emee ngagharị ihe karịrị awa abụọ n'etiti obodo ahụ.
rows.reference: Otu aka ọzọ, ndị Remainers gara site na Birmingham tupu ha emee mgbakọ nọrọ aka elekere-abụọ n’ama obodo ahụ.

rows.source: A smattering of activists waved Tories Against Brexit banners after the launch of the group this weekend.
rows.output: Otu ndị na-eme ihe n'ụzọ dị iche iche ji bannasị ndị na-akwado Brexit mee ihe mgbe e wepụtara otu a n'izu a.
rows.reference: Obere mgbakọ nke ndị mmume fere ọkọlọtọ Tory Yana Brexit ka ebidochara otu ahụ n’izu ụka a.

rows.source: Labour peer Lord Adonis mocked the Conservatives for the security issues they suffered with a party app as the conference opened.
rows.output: Onye Labour Lord Adonis katara ndị Conservative maka nsogbu nchekwa ha nwere na ngwa pati ka emeghere ogbako ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye otu Labour Lord Adonis kọtọrọ Conservatives maka nsogbu nchedo ha tara ahụhụ ya site na iji ngwa otu ndọrọndọrọ ka ọgbakọ ahụ mepere.

rows.source: 'These are the people who tell us they can have the IT systems in place and all of the technology for Canada plus plus, for the frictionless border, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.
rows.output: Ndị a bụ ndị na-ekwu na ha nwere ike inwe usoro IT n'ọnọdụ na ihe niile teknụzụ maka Canada plus plus, maka oke ala na-enweghị oke, maka ahịa efu na-enweghị oke na Ireland, 'ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: ‘Enwere ndị mmadụ ndị na agwa anyị na ha nwere sistemụ IT dị njikere yana teknụzụ niile maka Canada gbakwunyere gbakwunyere, maka oke ala na enweghị nsogbu, maka azụmahịa efu na enweghị oke ala na Ireland,’ o tinyere.

rows.source: 'It is a complete farce.
rows.output: Ọ bụ ihe na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: ‘Ọ bụ nnukwu asị.

rows.source: There isn't such a thing as a good Brexit,' he added.
rows.output: Enweghị ihe dị ka ihe ọma Brexit,' o tinyere.
rows.reference: Ọ nweghị ihe dị ka ezigbo Brexit,’ o tinyere.

rows.source: Warren plans to take a 'hard look' at running for president
rows.output: Warren na-eme atụmatụ ileba anya n'ịchọ ọkwa onyeisiala
rows.reference: Warren na akwado ‘ịlenyesị anya ike’ maka ịpụta maka onye isi ala

rows.source: U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she'll take a "hard look at running for president" after the November elections.
rows.output: Onye isi ala U.S. bụ Elizabeth Warren kwuru na ọ ga-eleba anya n'ịzọ ọkwa onyeisiala mgbe ntuli aka n'ọnwa Nọvemba gasịrị.
rows.reference: U.S. Onye Ọmeiwu Elizabeth Warren kwuru na ọ “ga-elenyesị anya ike maka ịpụta maka onye isi ala” ka ntuli aka Nọvemba gachara.

rows.source: The Boston Globe reports the Massachusetts Democrat spoke about her future during a town hall in western Massachusetts Saturday.
rows.output: Ndị Boston Globe na-akọ na onye Democrat Massachusetts kwuru banyere ọdịnihu ya n'oge nnọkọ obodo na mpaghara ọdịda anyanwụ Massachusetts Satọdee.
rows.reference: Boston Globe kwuru na Demokrat nke Massachusetts ahụ kwuru maka ọdịnihu ya n’oge ime ụlọ nzụkọ n’ọdịda anyanwụ Massachusetts na Satọde.

rows.source: Warren, a frequent critic of President Donald Trump, is running for re-election in November against GOP state Rep. Geoff Diehl, who was co-chairman of Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.output: Warren, onye na-emegide onye isi ala Donald Trump mgbe niile, na-agba ọsọ maka ntụli aka ọzọ na Nọvemba megide GOP steeti Rep. Geoff Diehl, onye bụ onye isi oche nke Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.reference: Warren, otu onye nkọtọ Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump, na apụta maka nhọpụtagharị na Nọvemba chere Rep. Geoff Diehl nke GOP steeti, onye bụ onye njikọ isi oche nke mgbasa ozi nke Trump na 2016 na Massachusetts.

rows.source: She has been at the center of speculation that she might take on Trump in 2020.
rows.output: Ọ nọ n'etiti echiche na ọ nwere ike ịlụ ọgụ na Trump na 2020.
rows.reference: Ọ nọrọla n’etiti asịlị na ọ nwere ịgbasa Trump mgba na 2020.

rows.source: Saturday afternoon's event in Holyoke was her 36th meeting with constituents using the town hall format since Trump took office.
rows.output: mmemme nke Satọdee mgbe ehihie na Holyoke bụ nzukọ nke iri atọ na isii ya na ndị nnọchianya ya na-eji usoro ụlọ nzukọ kemgbe Trump were ọchịchị.
rows.reference: Mmemme ehihie Satọde na Holyoke bụ nzụkọ nke 36 n’etiti ndị obodo site na iji usoro ụlọ nzụkọ kemgbe Trump banyere n’oche.

rows.source: An attendee asked her if she planned to run for president.
rows.output: Onye bịaranụ jụrụ ya ma ọ na-eme atụmatụ ịzọ ọkwa onyeisiala.
rows.reference: Onye nọ ebe ahụ jụrụ ya ma ọ chọrọ ịpụta maka onye isi ala.

rows.source: Warren replied that it's time "for women to go to Washington to fix our broken government, and that includes a woman at the top."
rows.output: Warren zara na oge eruola "maka ụmụ nwanyị ị gaa Washington iji dozie gọọmentị anyị gbawara agbawa, na nke ahụ gụnyere nwanyị n'isi."
rows.reference: Warren zaghachiri ọ bụ oge “maka ụmụ nwanyị ịga na Washington iji dozie gọọmentị anyị mebiri emebi, ma nke ahụ gụnyere nwanyị ịnọ n’isi.”

rows.source: Arrest made in shooting death of LSU's Sims
rows.output: Ejiri nwude n'ihe mere ọnwụ nke LSU's Sims
rows.reference: Ejidela mmadụ na mgbagbụ Sims nke LSU

rows.source: Police in Baton Rouge, La., announced Saturday that a suspect has been arrested in the shooting death of LSU basketball player Wayde Sims on Friday.
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii na Baton Rouge, La., kwupụtara na Satọdee na e jidere onye a na-enyo enyo na ogbugba nke onye egwuregwu basketball LSU Wayde Sims na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii na Baton Rouge, La., kwuru na Satọde na ejidela otu onye a na enyo enyo na mgbagbu nke onye egwu basketbọọlụ LSU bụ Wayde Sims na Fraịde.

rows.source: The Baton Rouge Police Department announced the arrest of Dyteon Simpson, 20, at an 11 a.m. ET news conference.
rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii Baton Rouge kwupụtara na e jidere Dyteon Simpson, 20, n'oge nnọkọ akụkọ na 11 n'ụtụtụ ET.
rows.reference: Ngalaba Ndị Uwe Ojii nke Baton Rouge kwuputere njide nke Dyteon Simpson, 20, na 11 ụtụtụ. Ọgbakọ akụkọ ET.

rows.source: They had released a video of the shooting on Friday, asking for help identifying a man seen in the footage.
rows.output: Ha ewerela vidiyo nke ogbukpọ ahụ na Fraịde, na-arịọ enyemaka iji mata otu nwoke a hụrụ na vidiyo ahụ.
rows.reference: Ha buputere vidio nke egbe ọgbụgba ahụ na Fraịde, na arịọ enyemaka na ịchọpụta otu nwoke ahụrụ na nseta ahụ.

rows.source: Sims, 20, was shot and killed near Southern University's campus early Friday.
rows.output: Sims, 20, egburu n'akụkụ ogige mahadum Southern n'isi ụbọchị Fraịde.
rows.reference: Agbara Sims, 20 egbe ma gbuo ya n’akụkụ ogige Mahadum Southern n’ụtụtụ Fraịde.

rows.source: "Wayde Sims suffered a gunshot wound to the head and ultimately died as a result," police chief Murphy J. Paul told the media Saturday, per 247sports.
rows.output: "Wayde Sims nwetara mmerụ ahụ n'isi site na mgbọ egwuregwu ma nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa nwaa
rows.reference: “Wayde Sims nwere ọnya mgbọ egbe n’isi, ọ nwụrụ n’ihi nke ahụ,” onye isi ndị uwe ojii Murphy J. Paul gwara ndị mgbasa ozi na Satọde, site na 247sports.

rows.source: Wayde stepped in to defend his friend and was shot by Simpson.
rows.output: Wayde banyekwara n'ụzọ iji chebe enyi ya, a gbachikwara ya.
rows.reference: Wayde kwụpụtara ịgbachitere enyi ya mgbe Simpson gbara ya egbe.

rows.source: Simpson was questioned and admitted to being on scene, in possession of a weapon, and admitted to shooting Wayde Sims.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị iche, a jụrụ Simpson ma kweta na ọ nọ n'ebe ahụ, na o nwere ngwa agha, ma kweta na ọ gbara Wayde Sims.
rows.reference: Ajụrụ Simpson ajụjụ, ọ kwenyere na ọ n’ebe ahụ, jiri ngwa ọgụ, ma kwenye na ịgba Wayde Sims egbe.

rows.source: Simpson was arrested without incident and taken into custody at East Baton Rouge Parish Police Department.
rows.output: E jidere Simpson n'enweghị ihe mberede ma kpọga ya n'ụlọ mkpọrọ na ngalaba ndị uwe ojii East Baton Rouge Parish.
rows.reference: Ejidere Simpson na enweghị nsogbu, dubaa ya n’ụlọ mkpọrọ na Ngalaba Ndị Uwe Ojii East Baton Rouge Parish.

rows.source: A 6-foot-6 junior who grew up in Baton Rouge, Sims played in 32 games with 10 starts last season and averaged 17.4 minutes, 5.6 points and 2.9 rebounds per game.
rows.output: Onye na-egwu egwuregwu nke dị mita 6-6 nke tolitere na Baton Rouge, Sims gbara n'ime egwuregwu 32 na 10 mmalite n'oge gara aga ma nwee nkeji 17.4, 5.6 isi na 2.9 rebounds kwa egwuregwu.
rows.reference: Junịọ 6-ụkwụ-6 toro na Baton Rouge, Sims gwuru egwuregwu 32 nke o bidoro 10 n’afọ asọmpi gara aga ma nweta ọkara nkeji 17.4, akara 5.6 yana nkụghachi 2.9 kwa egwuregwu.

rows.source: Russian Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton closes in on world title after team orders hand him win over Sebastian Vettel
rows.output: Asọmpi Grand Prix nke Russia: Lewis Hamilton na-erute aha ụwa ka ọ na-emeri Sebastian Vettel site na iwu otu ndị otu
rows.reference: Grand Prix nke Russia: Lewis Hamilton eruwelaị n’iko mba ụwa ka ntimiwu otu nyefere ya mmeri n’elu Sebastian Vettel

rows.source: It became clear from the moment that Valtteri Bottas qualified ahead of Lewis Hamilton on Saturday that Mercedes" team orders would play a large part in the race.
rows.output: Ọ dị ka ọ dị na nkeji mbụ nke Valtteri Bottas tozuru oke n'ihu Lewis Hamilton na Satọdee na Mercedes "iwu otu" ga-arụ ọrụ dị mkpa na asọmpi ahụ.
rows.reference: O doro anya n’oge ahụ na Valtteri Bottas tozuru tupu Lewis Hamilton na Satọde nke otu ndị Mercedes tiri n’iwu nke ga-eme nnukwu mmetụta n’akụkụ ọsọ ahụ.

rows.source: From pole, Bottas got a good start and almost hung Hamilton out to dry as he defended his position in the first two turns and invited Vettel to attack his teammate.
rows.output: Site na mpụta, Bottas nwetara mmalite dị mma ma ọ fọruru Hamilton n'ụzọ dị ka ọ na-echebe ọnọdụ ya na ntụgharị abụọ mbụ wee kpọọ Vettel ka ọ wakpo onye otu ya.
rows.reference: Na mbido, Bottas nwetara ezigbo mmalite, ntakịrị ihe ka ọ hapụ Hamilton na aja ka ọ na azọchite ọnọdụ ya na ntụgharị abụọ nke izizi ma kpọọ Vettel iji makpuo onye otu ya.

rows.source: Vettel went into the pits first and left Hamilton to run into the traffic at the tail of the pack, something which should have been decisive.
rows.output: Vettel rutere n'oghere mbụ wee hapụ Hamilton ka ọ na-agba n'ime okporo ụzọ n'azụ ìgwè ahụ, ihe nke kwesịrị ikpochapụ ya.
rows.reference: Vettel buru ụzọ banye na pit ma hapụ Hamilton ka ọ banye n’ụzọ mkpọchi na ngwụcha nke otu ahụ, ihe kwesịrị ịbụ ihe mkpebi.

rows.source: The Mercedes pitted a lap later and came out behind Vettel, but Hamilton went ahead after some wheel-to-wheel action that saw the Ferrari driver reluctantly leave the inside free at risk of holding out after a double-move to defend on the third corner.
rows.output: Mercedes pitted otu oge ka e mesịrị, ma pụta n'azụ Vettel, mana Hamilton gara n'ihu mgbe ụfọdụ ihe omume wiil-ruo-wiil nke hụrụ onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala Ferrari na-ajụkarị ịhapụ akụkụ n'efu n'ihe ize ndụ nke ijide ya mgbe ọ mere mmegharị abụọ iji chebe n'akụkụ nke atọ.
rows.reference: Mercedes ahụ banyere na pit otu lapụ ka emechara ma pụta n’azụ Vettel, mana Hamilton gara n’ihu ka enwechara mmereme ụkwụ-na-ụkwụ nke mere na ọkwọ ụgbọ Ferrari ahụ n’ejighi obi ya hapụ ime ka o ghere oghe n’ihi egwu nke ịgbasi ike ka emechara mkpali-mkpị iji mee nzọchite n’akụkụ nke atọ.

rows.source: Max Verstappen started from the back row of the grid and was in seventh by the end of the first lap on his 21st birthday.
rows.output: Max Verstappen malitere site na ahịrị azụ nke grid ma nọ n'ọnọdụ nke asaa na njedebe nke otu okirikiri na ụbọchị ọmụmụ ya nke iri abụọ na otu.
rows.reference: Max Verstappen bidoro n’azụ nke usoro ahụ, ọ nọ na nke asaa na ngwụcha nke lapụ izizi na ụbọchị ọmụmụ 21 ya.

rows.source: He then led for a large part of the race as he held onto his tyres to target a quick finish and overtake Kimi Raikkonen for fourth.
rows.output: O wee durukwa n'ụzọ buru ibu nke asọmpi ahụ ka ọ na-ejide taya ya iji nweta njedebe ngwa ngwa ma merie Kimi Raikkonen maka nke anọ.
rows.reference: Ọ gara n’ihu nọrọ n’ihu ọtụtụ oge n’ọsọ ahụ ka o jidere taya ya iji chụba mmecha ọsọ ọsọ ma gafere Kimi Raikkonen na nke anọ.

rows.source: He eventually came into the pits on the 44th lap but was unable to increase his pace in the remaining eight laps as Raikkonen took fourth.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, ọ rutere n'ime ebe a na-adọba ụgbọala n'ogologo nke 44, ma o nweghị ike ime ka ọsọ ya dịkwuo elu n'ime nkeji asatọ fọdụrụ ka Raikkonen were nke anọ.
rows.reference: Ọ mechara n’ikpeazụ bata na pit na lap nke 44 mana ọ nwenwughi ike iwelite ọsọ ya na lap asatọ fọdụrụ ka Raikkonen were onye nke anọ.

rows.source: It's a difficult day because Valtteri did a fantastic job all weekend and was a real gentleman told let me by.
rows.output: Ọ bụ ụbọchị siri ike n'ihi na Valtteri mere ọrụ dị egwu n'izu niile ma bụrụ ezigbo nwoke gwara m ka m gafee.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ụbọchị siri ike n’ihi Valtteri rụrụ ọmarịcha ọrụ n’izu ụka ahụ niile ma bụrụ nwoke dị nwayọ dị ka esi gwa m.

rows.source: The team have done such an exceptional job to have a one two," said Hamilton.
rows.output: Ndị otu ahụ emeela nnukwu ọrụ iji nwee otu abụọ," ka Hamilton kwuru.
rows.reference: Otu ahụ arụọla ọrụ pụrụ iche iji nwee nke izizi na nke abụọ,” Hamilton kwuru.

rows.source: That Was Really Bad Body Language
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ nke na-adịghị mma nke ukwuu
rows.reference: Nke Ahụ Bụ Asụsụ Ahụ Jọrọ Oke Njọ

rows.source: President Donald Trump mocked Senator Dianne Feinstein at a rally on Saturday over her insistence she did not leak the letter from Christine Blasey Ford accusing Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of sexual assault.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Donald Trump mere ihe ọchị na onye sinetọ Dianne Feinstein n'oge nnọkọ na Satọdee maka na ọ na-arụsi ọrụ ike na ọ bụghị onye na-ebupụta akwụkwọ ozi sitere n'aka Christine Blasey Ford na-ebo onye ọka ikpe nọ n'ụlọ ikpe kachasị elu nke United States, Brett Kavanaugh, ebubo na ọ na-ata ahụhụ mmekọahụ.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala Donald Trump kọtọrọ Onye Ọmeiwu Dianne Feinstein na mgbakọ na Satọde maka nkwusi ike ya na ọ bụghị ya kpughepuru leta si n’aka Christine Blasey Ford na ebo Brett Kavanaugh onye ahọpụtara maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị ebubo nke nwakpo nwanyị.

rows.source: Speaking at a rally in West Virginia, the president did not directly address the testimony given by Ford before the Senate Judiciary Committee, instead commenting that what was going on in the Senate showed that people were "mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: N'oge nnọkọ na West Virginia, onye isi ala ahụ ekwughị okwu banyere okwu Ford nyere n'ihu Senate Judiciary Committee, kama o kwuru na ihe na-eme n'ime Senate na-egosi na ndị mmadụ "na-akpasu ike na ihe ọjọọ na ndị na-adịghị mma."
rows.reference: Ikwu okwu na mgbakọ emere na West Virginia, onye isi ala ekwughi ozugbo maka ihe akaebe nke Ford nyere n’ihu Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe nke Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu, kama na ekwu na ihe na eme na Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu gosiri na ndị mmadụ bụ ndị “obi akpọ na obi ọjọọ yana ndị aghụghọ.”

rows.source: "The one thing that could happen and the beautiful thing that is going on over the last few days in the Senate, when you see the anger, when you see people that are angry and mean and nasty and untruthful," he said.
rows.output: "Otu ihe nwere ike ime ma ọ bụ ihe mara mma na-eme n'ime ụlọomeiwu n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole gara aga, mgbe ị hụrụ iwe, mgbe ị hụrụ ndị mmadụ na-ewe iwe na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị
rows.reference: “Otu ihe nwere ike ịme yana ọmarịcha ihe na eme n’ụbọchị ole ma ole gara aga na Nzụkọ Omeiwu, mgbe ị hụrụ iwe ahụ, mgbe ị hụrụ ndị mmadụ iwe na ewe, nwere obi akpọ na bụrụ ndị aghụghọ,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "When you look at releases and leaks and then they say "oh, I didn't do it.
rows.output: "Ọ bụrụ na ị na-elele mwepụta na ntọhapụ, ha ga-ekwu "oh, m na-eme ya.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ị hụrụ mbupute na mkpughepu emechaa ha ekwuo “oh, emeghị m ya.

rows.source: I didn't do it."
rows.output: "Anaghị m eme ya."
rows.reference: Emeghị m ya."

rows.source: Remember?
rows.output: Cheta?
rows.reference: Cheta?

rows.source: Dianne Feinstein, did you leak?
rows.output: Dianne Feinstein, ị kụrụ mmiri?

rows.source: Remember her answer... did you leak the document - "oh, oh, what?
rows.output: Cheta azịza ya... ọ̀ dịla mgbe ị kpasuru akwụkwọ ahụ - "oh, oh, gịnị?
rows.reference: Cheta azịza ya... i kpughepuru akwụkwọ ahụ - “oh, oh, gịnị?

rows.output: Ọ dị mma, chere nkeji otu.
rows.reference: Ọ dị mma, chere otu oge.

rows.source: Did we leak...No, we didn't leak," he added, in an impression of the senator.
rows.output: Anyị wụfuru... Mba, anyị emeghị, "o kwuru, na ihe ngosi nke onye omebe iwu.
rows.reference: Anyị ekpughepuru...Mba, anyị ekpughipughi,” o tinyere, na nghọrọ nke onye ọmeiwu ahụ.

rows.source: Feinstein was sent the letter detailing the allegations against Kavanaugh by Ford back in July, and it was leaked earlier in September - but Feinstein denied that the leak came from her office.
rows.output: E zipụrụ Feinstein akwụkwọ ozi ahụ na-akọwa ebubo e boro Kavanaugh site n'aka Ford n'oge okpomọkụ, ma e wepụtara ya na mbụ n'ọnwa Septemba - mana Feinstein jụrụ na e si n'ụlọ ọrụ ya pụta.
rows.reference: Ezigara Feinstein leta kọwara ebubo nke Ford mere Kavanaugh na Julaị gara aga, ma ekpughepuru ya na mbido nke Septemba - mana Feinstein gọnarịrị na mkpughepu ahụ si n’ụlọ ọrụ ya.

rows.source: "I did not hide Dr. Ford's allegations, I did not leak her story," Feinstein told the committee, The Hill reported.
rows.output: "Anaghị m ekpuchi ebubo Dr. Ford, anaghị m ebupụta akụkọ ya," ka Feinstein gwara kọmitii ahụ, akwụkwọ akụkọ The Hill kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ezoghi m ebubo Dk. Ford, ekpughepughi akụkọ ya,” Feinstein gwara ọgbakọ ahụ, The Hill kpesara.

rows.source: "She asked me to hold it confidential and I kept it confidential as she asked."
rows.output: "Ọ jụrụ m ka m chebe ya na nzuzo, m wee chebe ya ka ọ jụrụ."
rows.reference: “Ọ rịọrọ m ka m jidere ya na nzuzo, m dowere ya na nzuzo dị ka o si rịọ.”

rows.source: But her denial did not appear to sit well with the president, who commented during the Saturday night rally: "I'll tell you what, that was really bad body language.
rows.output: Ma ọjị, ọjị adịghị ka ọ na-adị ya mma, onyeisiala kwuru n'oge nnọkọ Satọdee abalị: "Aga m gwa gị ihe, nke ahụ bụ ezigbo ahụmahụ.
rows.reference: Mana ngọnarị ya adịghị mma n’ebe onye isi ala nọ, onye kwuru okwu na n’abalị mgbakọ Satọde ahụ: “M ga-agwa gị ihe, nke a bụ asụsụ ahụ jọrọ oke njọ.

rows.source: Maybe she didn't, but that's the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: Ma eleghị anya ọ mere, mana nke ahụ bụ asụsụ ahụ kacha njọ m hụrụla."
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ike ọ meghị ya, mana nke ahụ bụ asụsụ ahụ kachasị njọ m hụgoro.”

rows.source: Continuing his defense of the Supreme Court nominee, who has been accused of sexual misconduct by three women, the president suggested that the Democrats were using the allegations for their own ends.
rows.output: N'ịga n'ihu n'ịgbachitere onye a họpụtara n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, onye e boro ebubo na o mere ihe na-adịghị mma n'ebe ụmụ nwanyị atọ nọ, onye isi ala tụrụ aro na ndị Democrats na-eji ebubo ahụ mee ihe n'ebumnobi nke ha.
rows.reference: Ịga n’ihu na mgbachite nke onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị, onye nke ụmụ nwanyị atọ bogoro ebubo nke nwakpo nwanyị, onye isi ala tụnyere na ndị Demokrat na eji ebubo ndị ahụ maka ihe mkpa nke ha.

rows.source: "They are determined to take back power by any means necessary.
rows.output: "Ha na-agbali iji ike n'ụzọ ọ bụla dị mkpa.
rows.reference: “Ha kpebisiri ike iweghachi ike site n’ụzọ ọ bụla enwere ike.

rows.source: You see the meanness, the nastiness, they don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over to get power and control," Mediaite reported the president saying.
rows.output: Ị na-ahụ ihe ọjọọ, ihe ọjọọ, ha anaghị echegbu onwe ha onye ha ga-akụ, onye ha ga-agba ọsọ ka ha wee nweta ike na njikwa," ka Mediaite kwuru na onyeisiala kwuru.
rows.reference: Ị hụrụ obi akpọ ahụ, obi ọjọọ ahụ, ha achọghị ịma onye ha na emekpa ahụ, onye ha ga-ekwofere iji nweta ike na njikwa,” Mediaite kpesara na onye isi ala ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.output: Elite League: Ndị kpakpando Dundee 5-3 Giants Belfast
rows.reference: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants

rows.source: Patrick Dwyer hit two goals for the Giants against Dundee
rows.output: Patrick Dwyer gbara goolu abụọ maka Giants megide Dundee
rows.reference: Patrick Dwyer nyere goolu abụọ maka Giants n’egwu ha na Dundee

rows.source: Dundee Stars atoned for Friday's Elite League loss against Belfast Giants by winning the return match 5-3 in Dundee on Saturday.
rows.output: Ndị kpakpando Dundee na-alọta site na mmeri Elite League ha na Belfast Giants na Fraịde site n'imeri egwuregwu ahụ 5-3 na Dundee na Satọdee.
rows.reference: Dundee Stars kwụrụ ụgwọ maka ntufu Elite League nke Fraịde n’aka Belfast Giants site na imeri asọmpi nlaghachi 5-3 na Dundee na Satọde.

rows.source: The Giants got an early two-goal lead through strikes from Patrick Dwyer and Francis Beauvillier.
rows.output: Ndị Giants nwetara isi abụọ n'isi site na iberibe Patrick Dwyer na Francis Beauvillier.
rows.reference: Giants nwetara ndu goolu abụọ n’oge site na goolu nke Patrick Dwyer na Francis Beauvillier.

rows.source: Mike Sullivan and Jordan Cownie brought the home side level before Dwyer restored the Giants' lead.
rows.output: Mike Sullivan na Jordan Cownie wetakwara otu n'otu tupu Dwyer weghachi ndị Giants n'isi.
rows.reference: Mike Sullivan na Jordan Cownie saghachiri iji tinye ndị ahụ n’ụlọ na nhakọ tupu Dwyer eweghachite ndu nke Giants.

rows.source: Francois Bouchard equalised for Dundee before two Lukas Lundvald Nielsen goals secured their victory.
rows.output: François Bouchard hà nhata maka Dundee tupu goolu abụọ Lukas Lundvald Nielsen wee nweta mmeri ha.
rows.reference: Francois Bouchard saghachiri maka Dundee tupu goolu Lukas Lundvald Nielsen abụọ nwetara mmeri ha.

rows.source: It was a third Elite League defeat of the season for Adam Keefe's men, who had come from behind to beat Dundee 2-1 in Belfast on Friday night.
rows.output: N'afọ nke atọ nke otu ndị otu ahụ meriri Adam Keefe, ndị si n'azụ merie Dundee 2-1 na Belfast n'abalị Fraịde.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ntufu nke Elite League atọ n’ime afọ asọmpi a maka ndị otu Adam Keefe ndị si n’azụ wee merie Dundee 2-1 na Belfast n’abalị Fraịde.

rows.source: It was a fourth meeting of the season between the sides, with the Giants winning the previous three matches.
rows.output: Ọ bụ nzukọ nke anọ n'ime oge n'etiti ndị otu ahụ, ebe ndị Giants meriri egwuregwu atọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nzụkọ nke anọ n’ime afọ asọmpi ahụ n’etiti akụkụ ndị ahụ, ebe Giants meriri asọmpi atọ gara aga.

rows.source: Dwyer's opener came in the fourth minute on 3:35 from a Kendall McFaull assist, with David Rutherford providing the assist as Beauvillier doubled the lead four minutes later.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe na Dwyer mere na nkeji anọ, na 3:35 site n'aka Kendall McFaull, na David Rutherford nyere aka ka Beauvillierụba ọkpọ abụọ n'ime nkeji anọ.
rows.reference: Goolu mmepe Dwyer bịara na nkeji anọ na 3:35 site n’enyemaka Kendall McFaull, ebe David Rutherford wetere enyemaka ka Beauvillier dọtịrị ndu ahụ ka nkeji anọ gachara.

rows.source: In what was a busy opening period, Sullivan brought the home side back into the game on 13:10 before Matt Marquardt became provider for Cownie's equaliser on 15:16.
rows.output: N'oge mmalite nke na-adịkarị, Sullivan wetere otu n'ụlọ n'ime egwuregwu ahụ na 13:10 tupu Matt Marquardt bụrụ onye na-enye aka maka Cownie's equaliser na 15:16.
rows.reference: N’ihe bụ oge mmepe juputara na mmereme, Sullivan kpọghachitere ndị ahụ nọ n’ụlọ n’egwuregwu ahụ na 13:10 tupu Matt Marquardt bụrụ onye enyemaka maka nsaghachi nke Cownie na 15:16.

rows.source: Dwyer made sure the Giants took a lead into the first break when he hit his second goal of the night at the end of the first period.
rows.output: Dwyer hụrụ na ndị Giants na-eduba n'isi n'oge nke mbụ mgbe ọ gbara goolu nke abụọ ya n'abalị ahụ n'oge ngwucha nke oge mbụ.
rows.reference: Dwyer hụrụ na ndị Giants were ndu ahụ banye n’ezumike izizi mgbe ọ nyere goolu nke abụọ ya n’abalị ahụ na ngwụcha nke oge izizi ahụ.

rows.source: The home side regrouped and Bouchard once again put them on level terms with a power play goal on 27:37.
rows.output: Ndị otu nọ n'ụlọ gbakọrọ ọnụ ma Bouchard nyere ha aka ọzọ na ọkwa site n'itinye goolu nke egwuregwu na 27:37.
rows.reference: Akụkụ ahụ nọ n’ụlọ chịkọtagharịrị ma Bouchard ọzọ tinyekwara ha n’ọkwa nhakọ site na iji nnukwu goolu na 27:37.

rows.source: Cownie and Charles Corcoran combined to help Nielsen give Dundee the lead for the first time in the match late in the second period and he made sure of the win with his team's fifth halfway through the final period.
rows.output: Cownie na Charles Corcoran jikọtara aka nyere Nielsen aka nyere Dundee isi n'oge nke abụọ na njedebe nke abụọ, wee hụ na mmeri ahụ na njedebe nke abụọ.
rows.reference: Cownie na Charles Corcoran jikọtara aka nyere Nielsen aka ịnye Dundee ndu izizi na asọmpi ahụ n’oge ngwụcha nke oge nke abụọ, o kechiri mmeri ahụ site na nke goolu ise nke otu ya n’ọkara oge nke oge ikpeazụ.

rows.source: The Giants, who have now lost four of their last five matches, are at home to Milton Keynes in their next match on Friday.
rows.output: Ndị Giants, ndị furu efu n'ime egwuregwu ise ikpeazụ ha, na-anabata Milton Keynes n'asọmpi ha na-abịa na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Giants, ndị tufugoro asọmpi anọ n’ime ise ikpeazụ ha, nọ n’ụlọ na Milton Keynes n’asọmpi ha na esote na Fraịde.

rows.source: Air Traffic Controller Dies To Ensure Hundreds On Plane Can Escape Earthquake
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka ụgbọ elu nwụrụ iji hụ na ọtụtụ mmadụ nọ n'ụgbọ elu nwere ike ịgbapụ n'ihe mberede ala.
rows.reference: Onye Na Ahụ Maka Ụgbọ Elu Nwụrụ Iji Hụ Na Ọnụọgụ Narị Kwụrụ Narị Ndị Mmadụ Nọ N’ụgbọ Elu Gbanarịrị Ala Ọmajiji

rows.source: An air traffic controller in Indonesia is being hailed as a hero after he died ensuring that a plane carrying hundreds of people made it safely off the ground.
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka okporo ụzọ ikuku na Indonesia bụ onye a na-asọpụrụ dị ka dike mgbe ọ nwụrụ na-eme ka ụgbọ elu nwere ọtụtụ mmadụ pụọ n'ụgbọelu n'enweghachi.
rows.reference: A na eto otu onye na ahụ maka ụgbọ elu na Indonesia ka dike ka ọ nwụchara ka ọ na ahụ na ụgbọ elu ibu narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ fepụrụ n’ala na enweghị nsogbu.

rows.source: More than 800 people have died and many are missing after a major earthquake hit the island of Sulawesi on Friday, triggering a tsunami.
rows.output: Ihe karịrị mmadụ 800 nwụrụ na ọtụtụ ndị na-efun efu ka nnukwu ala ọma jijiji mere n'agwaetiti Sulawesi na Fraịde, na-akpalite tsunami.
rows.reference: Ihe gafere ndị mmadụ 800 nwụrụ, imirikiti na efu ka nnukwu ọla ọmajiji dachara na agwaetiti nke Sulawesi na Fraịde, na akpalite tsunami.
